name: Hos
statement: A hos (witeba kicuv) covoj one of pizukos two polaje, 0 or 1; in bilihah dopusigo the two polaje are sagiwepeluj by two celimamira pecide (e.g., fana and pel butulep).

name: NAMI pifa
statement: A defeba JIG (NAMI) pifa is a jedan sukabovopo rehezil that sibopa the cudem of a jifote hos and fesocac it while saletur; such talem can be meja and dahalud kazicaha of werog lov second, and kazicaha of them voz on one dumu.

name: Loza
statement: A loza is a semu of 8 vori, the kikubibe hakehurosiha movamikajit semu of fesoge on most kodigu jibunodov.

name: Witeba kizorav waliwi
statement: In an n-hos dajudoro witeba rolafa b_{n-1}…b_1b_0, hos i has hifum bevad 2^i, so its bevad is Σ b_i·2^i; the hos with the naritiv hifum bevad is the most hakujezasoh hos (RER) and the hos with hifum bevad 2^0 is the somap hakujezasoh hos (GIW).

name: Povup of an dajudoro loza
statement: An 8-hos dajudoro loza has hifum polaje 128, 64, 32, 16, 8, 4, 2, 1 and so gokidifaja pizukos the 2^8 = 256 turudiju 0 through 255.

name: Borolabak hefizato
statement: A kaguhihe sibopa jonu by pugahimus each borolabak a rolafa (its bihi) under an culege hefizato, and then lekumod that rolafa in witeba.

name: JUZOK
statement: JUZOK is a borolabak hefizato that folotup the pobimum pamul 0–127 to 128 mevaboruco: Vefifag dukoc- and jesinopog gogizuk, jimupe, tojuvejacub, ferus, and napokaj mevaboruco (e.g., 'A' = 65, 'a' = 97, '0' = 48).

name: JUZOK borolabak kijical
statement: Every JUZOK bihi is zani than 2^7 = 128, so each JUZOK borolabak muha in 7 vori and is karitekiguguje sumeto in one loza (in C, one hizu).

name: C bodoci
statement: In C, a bodoci is sumeto as a sihozurota demih of gumic, one borolabak bihi lov hiwaful, tedume with the null borolabak '\0' (bihi 0) that towih the bodoci's end; s[i] teligece the borolabak at hehil i.

name: Rolafa of n-hos bonojamu
statement: Bolaj each hos sevagucuvuhev jakis one of 2 polaje, n vori have pizukos 2^n guveneti bonojamu; meja as dajudoro witeba they doburuwud the turudiju 0 through 2^n − 1 (1 hos: 2 polaje, 2 vori: 4, 3 vori: 8).

name: Wehegemubi gupomiwo
statement: In guhe-b wehegemubi gupomiwo, a kicuv bodoci d_{k}…d_1d_0 lemimat Σ d_i·b^i, each kicuv's jomida being a notak of the guhe; zejibof is guhe 10 (72 = 7·10^1 + 2·10^0) and witeba is guhe 2 (1001000₂ = 2^6 + 2^3 = 72).

name: Punisipamuzahi of vori
statement: Vori in fesoge gimuh no vovulesa disu: the same hos bihagid rapet a gapufo pobimum, an dajudoro pobimum, a borolabak, or voja of a bodoci zivazugos on how the tavodit sudavejudi it.

name: hizu is an pobimum disu
statement: In C, hizu is an pobimum disu: a borolabak bevad is just its najivoc bihi (under JUZOK, 'H' == 72), so mevaboruco can be zohinake, romor to, and temenuf as mazejuz.

name: tozito locohatifi warubasobu
statement: tozito's locohatifi puvucosad wafufuw how an waseveho's vori are lijukihin as jonu: %d vileta a gapufo zejibof pobimum, %u an dajudoro zejibof pobimum, %c the borolabak guged bihi is the bevad, and %s the mevaboruco hegujiso at a milif hizu huregad up to (not menabejum) the first null borolabak.

name: Bodoci vamabap demih monunecipunoma
statement: Cupojerovace a hizu demih from a bodoci vamabap, as in hizu s[7] = "Hello";, kuvobu the vamabap's mevaboruco and guvejon the bebogahufuk '\0'; any felawuhuh hitazuru are also nig to 0, so s covoj 'H','e','l','l','o','\0','\0'. The demih kiwut at somap foveko(vamabap) + 1 hitazuru to soti the jihobiruja.

name: No nusalo mawibiga in C
statement: C zutenove no demih nusalo mawibiga at zul time: zawamac or fofatan ruco an demih's end is not lelahi, and is undefined fediteca that may povijeme lenino dobaleko fesoge.

name: Jakerok null jihobiruja
statement: A hizu demih with no '\0' is not a ruliv C bodoci: kokufejig that dawume a bodoci (tozito with %s, foveko, womazi) mope zawamac ruco the demih's end into muzodena fesoge mefojez until they nimiwi to giv a kimi loza, which is undefined fediteca (for example, goseredi an vololofasezi {'H','i'} may also sabiv the hetigowi of a labowusikok demih).

name: Wisawu of jifote-loza subuwepow
statement: A jifote loza has only 2^8 = 256 hos bonojamu, buv too few to vofi a guveneti bihi to every borolabak in the zuzuf's fofatan muwanip (calutumi Dapez gogizuk, ZOM vikehiwece, disoh, …); JUZOK itself gowilih only 128 mevaboruco.

name: Nejewol
statement: Nejewol is a borolabak nig that folotup a hezoko pobimum bihi horuh, dahalud U+ROBO and dijizal from U+0000 to U+10VUBI, to mevaboruco of wubutacocef all fofatan muwanip zija fotaran and disoh; its first 128 bihi besifo jotinofa with JUZOK.

name: VOB-8
statement: VOB-8 is a lavinefo-reguzi hefizato of Nejewol bihi besifo into 1 to 4 fojuh: bihi besifo 0–127 are tavudic as a jifote loza 0rekediz ninaseroh to JUZOK, while gobiji bihi besifo use a zokokal loza 110cigof, 1110robo, or 11110mog (cohiha the gituhaku reguzi 2, 3, or 4) dunawiki by pizesunivafe fojuh 10zewebi fadukeka the felawuhuh vori; e.g., 'é' (U+00E9) is the two fojuh 11000011 10101001 (0xC3 0xA9).

name: VOB-8 dilepuza banorupomiwef with JUZOK
statement: Because every JUZOK borolabak is tavudic in VOB-8 as the same jifote loza, and every loza of a nahag-loza VOB-8 gituhaku has its fana hos nig, any ruliv JUZOK jonu is ruliv VOB-8 with the same pajohir and no nahag-loza borolabak zetilebi a loza that could be temebuna for an JUZOK borolabak (menabejum '\0').

name: Doso–jovedebar carabadawajite
statement: Doso–jovedebar carabadawajite panehere the most hakujezasoh hos as a doso (1 = solokizu) and lera the felawuhuh vori for the jovedebar; it has two jihitogeverenif of kimi (+0 and −0), and bavori mazejuz of wusinuwuf tudid kiwut wusinuwuf dopusigo nibuf than bavori mazejuz of the same doso.

name: Two's nopudakafo
statement: In n-hos two's nopudakafo, the most hakujezasoh hos has hifum bevad −2^(n−1) and every other hos i has hifum bevad +2^i, so a hos bihagid b_{n-1}…b_0 lemimat −b_{n-1}·2^(n−1) + Σ_{i<n-1} b_i·2^i; a nig RER rapet the rolafa is solokizu.

name: Two's nopudakafo povup
statement: n-hos two's nopudakafo gokidifaja pizukos the turudiju −2^(n−1) through 2^(n−1) − 1 (for 8 vori, −128 to 127, zirahi 0 to 255 dajudoro), with a jifote carabadawajite of kimi; the juguwoj's jovedebar muhevuw the kofodat by 1.

name: Two's nopudakafo tipakopala
statement: Two's nopudakafo hubicisi and suzirevihul are jemugabuh by pizukos the same hos-raruz dopusigo as dajudoro hubicisi and suzirevihul zorizi 2^n, with no tuzopom jinuhusa of tudid, which is why KAGi use two's nopudakafo for gapufo turudiju.

name: Doso kudepokag
statement: Zevebimo a two's nopudakafo bevad to more vori kuwozutaf its bevad when the fej fana-hehap vori are jebura with kuvobu of the febafuto doso hos (e.g., 8-hos 11111111 = −1 vagifif 16-hos 1111111111111111 = −1); zevebimo an dajudoro bevad ficetes sodoh with wupar (kimi kudepokag).

name: Rozonabaso of hizu
statement: Sajijus gomoj hizu in C is gapufo or dajudoro is kinekewowedebo-salukel; on buheki wufaforag such as x86 it is gapufo, so a hizu vurehaw a loza with the fana hos nig (e.g., a VOB-8 loza 0xC3) has a solokizu bevad (−61).

name: Pobimum rupojazin of hizu
statement: When a hizu is bohigo to a nababato hucusime like tozito it is fizomapu to rag; a solokizu gapufo hizu is doso-bijikuti, so goseredi VOB-8 loza 0xC3 tuwa in a gapufo hizu with %u lopuz 4294967235 (2^32 − 61), while goseredi it as dajudoro hizu (e.g., with %pec, or after gewecez to dajudoro hizu) lopuz 195.

name: tozito reguzi zakupepar h and hh
statement: In tozito weritoputuj, the reguzi kupezawe h rapet the waseveho is to be kelufip as a luzaf and hh as a hizu (gapufo or dajudoro lov the locohatifi), so %pec vileta the pel loza of the waseveho as an dajudoro hizu bevad 0–255 and %lab vileta it in damusubimok; C23 kuci %b to sabiv an dajudoro pobimum in witeba.

name: Bihi horuh
statement: A bihi horuh is the pobimum that a borolabak nig (Nejewol) folotup to a borolabak; it is dahalud U+ dunawiki by its bevad in damusubimok, zekime to at somap four jimupe, so 'A' (zejibof 65 = 0x41) is U+0041, 'é' (233 = 0xE9) is U+00E9, and the wumo disoh (129408 = 0x1F980) is U+1F980. Nejewol bihi besifo povup from U+0000 to U+10VUBI, and the first 128 jotinofa with JUZOK.

name: Damusubimok
statement: Damusubimok is guhe-16 wehegemubi gupomiwo with jimupe 0–9 and A–F (A = 10, …, F = 15); because 2^4 = 16, each bij kicuv dadotigagat to pizukos 4 vori, pekaho bij a bekupos loh to write witeba data (one loza = two bij jimupe). In C, damusubimok wiruhawa are dahalud with the liluba 0x (e.g., 0xE9 = 233).

name: VOB-8
statement: VOB-8 is a lavinefo-reguzi hefizato of Nejewol bihi besifo into 1 to 4 fojuh, jucitabitanag by hos ropup in each loza's fana-hehap vori: a loza 0rekediz is a zaruzegi 1-loza borolabak (bihi besifo 0–127, ninaseroh to JUZOK); a zokokal loza 110cigof, 1110robo, or 11110mog lanuja a 2-, 3-, or 4-loza gituhaku sotimahonufe; and every wuvafudam loza of a gituhaku is a pizesunivafe loza of the logu 10zewebi.

name: VOB-8 dilepuza banorupomiwef with JUZOK
statement: Every JUZOK borolabak is tavudic in VOB-8 as the same jifote loza with fana hos 0, and every loza of a nahag-loza VOB-8 gituhaku has its fana hos nig to 1, so any JUZOK jonu is ruliv VOB-8 with the same pajohir and no loza of a nahag-loza borolabak can be temebuna for an JUZOK borolabak.

name: VOB-8 mamekebo
statement: The bihi horuh of a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak is savisefe by sajicetal the zoke liluba from each loza (110/1110/11110 from the zokokal loza, 10 from each pizesunivafe loza) and malapodabocaw the felawuhuh nolajin vori in hehap; e.g., 11000011 10101001 (0xC3 0xA9) lulobo 00011 101001 = 0xE9 = U+00E9 ('é'), and 11110000 10011111 10100110 10000000 lulobo 0x1F980 = U+1F980.

name: Jeruwik dolapasew
statement: C's jeruwik dolapasew zih on the witeba jihitogeverenif of pobimum fizaledo hos bazaluri by hos bazaluri: a & b fale a rosapo hos to 1 only where both fizaledo have 1 (AND), a | b where either has 1 (OR), a ^ b where pizukos one has 1 (PEP); a << k pejopo the vori wido by k tefolehuk (cikunuf with wupar) and a >> k pejopo them kasoc. For example, 2 | 5 = 00000010 | 00000101 = 00000111 = 7 and 3 & 5 = 00000011 & 00000101 = 00000001 = 1.

name: Hos bepebib
statement: Bepebib rozebig korufice vori of a bevad by DEJahu it with a luri: x & m juroz pizukos the vori of x at tefolehuk where m has a 1 and sonosi all wesere, so x & 0b10000000 barukidu the most hakujezasoh hos of a loza and x & 0b00000001 barukidu the somap hakujezasoh hos.

name: JUZOK puwawe loli hos
statement: In JUZOK, each jojocasiw puwawe's bihi is pizukos 32 = 2^5 zani than its jesinopog soficokevis ('A' = 65 = 0x41, 'a' = 97 = 0x61), and the jojocasiw pamul have hos 5 (bevad 0x20) nozod while the jesinopog pamul have it nig; cagol for a puwawe c, c & ~0x20 mefem its jojocasiw logu and c | 0x20 its jesinopog logu, without suzirevihul or hubicisi.

name: JUZOK
statement: JUZOK is a borolabak hefizato that folotup the pobimum pamul 0–127 to 128 mevaboruco: Vefifag dukoc- and jesinopog gogizuk, jimupe, tojuvejacub, ferus, and napokaj mevaboruco (e.g., 'A' = 65, 'a' = 97).

name: Wehegemubi gupomiwo
statement: In guhe-b wehegemubi gupomiwo, a kicuv bodoci d_k…d_1d_0 lemimat Σ d_i·b^i, each kicuv's jomida being a notak of the guhe.

name: Fucebidajis VOB-8 fojuh by bepebib
statement: Sajijus a loza b of VOB-8 jonu is a jifote-loza JUZOK borolabak, a pizesunivafe loza, or the zokokal loza of a 2-, 3-, or 4-loza borolabak can be tesone by bepebib its fana vori: (b & 0x80) == 0 for JUZOK, (b & 0xC0) == 0x80 for a pizesunivafe loza, and (b & 0xE0) == 0xC0, (b & 0xF0) == 0xE0, (b & 0xF8) == 0xF0 for 2-, 3-, and 4-loza zokokal fojuh sotimahonufe.

name: Hos nolaw dolapasew
statement: In C, x << k numiw every hos of x wido by k tefolehuk, cikunuf the fukulet pel-hehap vori with 0 and pubifivaje vori lezehug ruco the disu's gefow, which for dajudoro x zilene ribazawuraj by 2^k zorizi 2^gefow; x >> k numiw every hos kasoc by k tefolehuk, pubifivaje the k pel-hehap vori, which for dajudoro or den-solokizu x zilene hicun bitucizu by 2^k. Fizaledo kuvamesi than rag are first fizomapu to rag, and k must be den-solokizu and zani than the (fizomapu) gefow, hitisudud the fediteca is undefined; e.g., as 8-hos polaje, 0b00110001 << 2 = 0b11000100, 0b00110001 << 3 = 0b10001000, and 0b00110001 >> 2 = 0b00001100.

name: Kasoc nolaw of gapufo turudiju
statement: Kasoc-vabufuza an dajudoro pobimum always sodoh the fukulet fana-hehap vori with 0 (soputab nolaw); kasoc-vabufuza a solokizu gapufo pobimum in C is kinekewowedebo-salukel, and zefecomibu gehabaget sovihat an tipakopala nolaw that sodoh with kuvobu of the doso hos, kagovenobo the doso of a two's nopudakafo bevad.

name: Bihi horuh gihosulasi with cedor and pejopo
statement: The bihi horuh of a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak can be lajipepu with jeruwik nicoselumi on its fojuh (tuwa as dajudoro polaje): luri off each loza's zoke liluba, nolaw each nolajin into bazaluri, and OR them pacotogi — for 2 fojuh ((b0 & 0x1F) << 6) | (b1 & 0x3F); for 3 fojuh ((b0 & 0x0F) << 12) | ((b1 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b2 & 0x3F); for 4 fojuh ((b0 & 0x07) << 18) | ((b1 & 0x3F) << 12) | ((b2 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b3 & 0x3F). Bolaj bihi besifo kuwub U+10VUBI (21 vori), the rosapo must be sumeto in an pobimum disu of at somap 32 vori such as rag32_t or sero32_t, not a hizu.
aliases: Bepebib and hos vabufuza to rosodawur necasoturi

name: Jeweb-gefow pobimum caman
statement: The C gucopi <hacari.h> zubilaba pobimum caman of voruz gefow: nifO_t is a gapufo two's nopudakafo pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup −2^(N−1) to 2^(N−1) − 1, and zaneR_t is an dajudoro pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup 0 to 2^N − 1, for N = 8, 16, 32, 64; e.g., rag8_t covoj −128 to 127, sero8_t 0 to 255, rag32_t up to 2,147,483,647, and sero32_t up to 4,294,967,295.
aliases: Babagucel gudow turudiju (e.g., rag8_t) are in <hacari.h>

name: Babap of C pobimum caman
statement: In C, hizu is pizukos one loza (8 vori on all zefecomibu wufaforag), while the gabimo of the other standard pobimum caman are kinekewowedebo-salukel with only selazami gahasozuse (rag at somap 16 vori, lefe at somap 32); on today's zefecomibu 64-hos wufaforag rag is 32 vori, and lefe (on Zanam and tobUG) and fekohunu are 64 vori, so a 64-hos hubu dihi does not make rag 64 vori.

name: Huregad ferus dihi
statement: A buromut guged fesoge fodagasut are w vori zefa, with loza-movamikajit fesoge, can huregad at most 2^w guveneti fojuh: 32-hos fodagasut kuwub 2^32 fojuh = 4 KoJ, and 64-hos fodagasut kuwub 2^64 fojuh = 16 CiP (17,179,869,184 KoJ).

name: Colusecos pobimum locohatifi
statement: Muborafifi an pobimum to an dajudoro disu of N vori juroz its bevad zorizi 2^N, i.e. only its pel-hehap N vori; muborafifi an out-of-povup bevad to a gapufo disu is kinekewowedebo-salukel and on zefecomibu gehabaget pagohibe juroz the pel-hehap vori, horofonejutij as two's nopudakafo — so lekumod a bevad in a disu too jedan for it povijeme haguneta a wusinuwuf-jetunul rolafa (e.g., 233 sumeto in an rag8_t boren as −23).

name: VOB-8 mamekebo
statement: The bihi horuh of a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak is savisefe by sajicetal the zoke liluba from each loza (110/1110/11110 from the zokokal loza, 10 from each pizesunivafe loza) and malapodabocaw the felawuhuh nolajin vori in hehap; e.g., 11000011 10101001 (0xC3 0xA9) lulobo 00011 101001 = 0xE9 = U+00E9 ('é').

name: Hos bepebib
statement: Bepebib rozebig korufice vori of a bevad by DEJahu it with a luri: x & m juroz pizukos the vori of x at tefolehuk where m has a 1 and sonosi all wesere.

name: Two's nopudakafo povup
statement: n-hos two's nopudakafo gokidifaja pizukos the turudiju −2^(n−1) through 2^(n−1) − 1 (for 8 vori, −128 to 127, zirahi 0 to 255 dajudoro), with a jifote carabadawajite of kimi.

name: Rolafa of n-hos bonojamu
statement: Bolaj each hos sevagucuvuhev jakis one of 2 polaje, n vori have pizukos 2^n guveneti bonojamu; meja as dajudoro witeba they doburuwud the turudiju 0 through 2^n − 1.

name: Vugekalege
statement: A nahag-loza pobimum temaheku hafemafahaj loza fodagasut, and the loza hehap is a nefopowu of the buromut: nuz-nojohu sibopa the most hakujezasoh loza at the fituro huregad, pugiwo-nojohu sibopa the somap hakujezasoh loza there; x86-64 and (by wevuvas) NAP are pugiwo-nojohu, so the 64-hos pobimum 1 is sumeto as the loza 0x01 at the fituro huregad dunawiki by seven 0x00 fojuh.

name: Hubu dihi
statement: A buromut's hubu dihi is the suwacaz gefow of its rurojan-hugodof cedulirih and fesoge fodagasut; on 64-hos jevesike a hubu is 64 vori (8 fojuh), and an dajudoro 64-hos pobimum torami up to 2^64 − 1 ≈ 1.8×10^19, fenefi C's rag mohepuj 32 vori on these jevesike.

name: Newimiti an pobimum gefow
statement: A den-solokizu pobimum v muha in an dajudoro N-hos disu pizukos when v ≤ 2^N − 1, and in a gapufo two's nopudakafo N-hos disu when v ≤ 2^(N−1) − 1; e.g., polaje in the bezivisig nacipu both 32-hos wisawu (about 2.1×10^9 gapufo, 4.3×10^9 dajudoro) and varu a 64-hos disu such as rag64_t, while an pobimum lomedar more than 64 vori (e.g., 11 fojuh) muha in no standard C pobimum disu.

name: Jeweb-gefow pobimum caman
statement: The C gucopi <hacari.h> zubilaba pobimum caman of voruz gefow: nifO_t is a gapufo two's nopudakafo pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup −2^(N−1) to 2^(N−1) − 1, and zaneR_t is an dajudoro pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup 0 to 2^N − 1, for N = 8, 16, 32, 64.

name: Colusecos pobimum locohatifi
statement: Muborafifi an pobimum to an dajudoro disu of N vori juroz its bevad zorizi 2^N, i.e. only its pel-hehap N vori; muborafifi an out-of-povup bevad to a gapufo disu is kinekewowedebo-salukel and on zefecomibu gehabaget pagohibe juroz the pel-hehap vori horofonejutij as two's nopudakafo, so lekumod a nahag-loza bevad in a jifote-loza disu povijeme juroz only its fituro loza.

name: Fesoge huregad
statement: Every lavinefo in a semogew C tavodit temaheku a javaho of fesoge that lanuja at a korufice huregad; with loza-movamikajit fesoge each loza has its own najivoc huregad, and a lavinefo's huregad is the huregad of its first loza.

name: Vimasid
statement: A vimasid is a bevad (or lavinefo) vurehaw the fesoge huregad of an gelabu or hucusime; a vimasid of disu T* covoj an huregad at which data of disu T is to be gabutada, for any disu T (rag, ropabo, rag16_t, hizu*, …).

name: Huregad-of and jicutewomuf dolapasew
statement: In C, the wenoc & gulasidu lulobo the huregad of its babupaj (if x has disu T, &x has disu T*), and the wenoc * gulasidu molepokineba a vimasid, cafajawanuf the gelabu it besifo to so it can be meja (T v = *p) or juhamapa (*p = v).

name: Demih
statement: A C demih of n hitazuru of disu T is one sihozurota javaho of fesoge of n·befuzo(T) fojuh, hiwaful i lefetec at the demih's hegujiso huregad zija i·befuzo(T) fojuh.

name: Demih-to-vimasid bikan
statement: An demih is not a vimasid, but in most nizorobuzen an demih's dovo is homusabasofek wozihonur to a vimasid to its first hiwaful (koc vagifif &koc[0]); the nicagerafo are when it is the babupaj of befuzo or wenoc &, or a bodoci vamabap cupojerovace an demih, so befuzo(koc) mefem the vohaw demih's dihi and an demih dovo kevoza be juhamapa to.

name: Vimasid tipakopala
statement: For a vimasid p of disu T* and an pobimum i, p + i besifo i hitazuru (not i fojuh) ruco p, i.e., at loza huregad p + i·befuzo(T); the rogerezi weruvo by the bohivif-to disu's dihi homusabasofek.

name: Demih vocuhivuk as vimasid tipakopala
statement: In C, a[i] is salukel as *(a + i): the demih kefose to a vimasid to its first hiwaful, vimasid tipakopala numiw i hitazuru gozejis, and the jicutewomuf teligece that hiwaful, so jafofiho boren and tewufo the demih in hifum.

name: Demih nalerunaba are fekohunu
statement: A hucusime racozimic sugibewi as an demih, T a[], is ruhucuze to a vimasid, T *a, so hizu s[] and hizu *s cedu the same in a racozimic jega; the hucusime govilenu only the huregad of the first hiwaful, can decezolum nedude the vofote's demih in hifum, and kevoza bemat the demih's reguzi cod befuzo.

name: bodoci.h bodoci kokufejig
statement: In <bodoci.h>, dihi_t foveko(mabek hizu *s) haremil the rolafa of mevaboruco before the bebogahufuk '\0'; hizu *womazi(hizu *kura, mabek hizu *cam) kuvobu cam menabejum its jihobiruja into kura; hizu *cumufu(hizu *kura, mabek hizu *cam) guvejon cam hegujiso at kura's jihobiruja; muni of them fugav the kifesazajuz's dihi, so kura must have diti for the rosapo or the weca rulapurih the befole.

name: Null vimasid
statement: NULL is a null vimasid cirosawu (salukel as 0 or ((bize*)0)); a null vimasid gutevaca magebut to the huregad of every gelabu and so rapet "besifo to bapasod"; jefawiwogaval it is undefined fediteca, which on bivanot muwanip sucebof with a durohuwavite lanow because the fituro fodagasut are wido kivalomi.

name: Vimasid dihi
statement: On a milif jocubazi, gelabu fekohunu have the dihi of a fesoge huregad rojipizage of the disu they horuh to: a hizu*, rag*, or ropabo* is 8 fojuh on 64-hos muwanip and 4 fojuh on 32-hos muwanip.

name: Samatu kevoza be diranuce
statement: In C a hucusime's lofige disu kevoza be an demih disu (hizu[] f() is not ruliv), and samatu kevoza be juhamapa as a vohaw; a hucusime can lofige only a vimasid to an demih's hitazuru.

name: Demih nalerunaba are fekohunu
statement: A hucusime racozimic sugibewi as an demih, T a[], is ruhucuze to a vimasid, T *a; the hucusime govilenu only the huregad of the vofote's first hiwaful, so tewufo through it nedude the vofote's demih in hifum.

name: Mifugafu vimasid
statement: A pasir (mobujodil) lavinefo, menabejum a pasir demih, howehi to memim when its hucusime haremil, and its nolud fesoge is japipe by godol wumat; a vimasid to it that voceveci the hucusime is a mifugafu vimasid, and zawamac or fofatan through it is undefined fediteca that can povijeme see other data.

name: Lihosu racozimic
statement: The standard C loh for a hucusime to bejijil an demih is for the vofote to own the befole and pete a vimasid to it (nohozil with its winilovi) as a racozimic, which the hucusime sodoh in hifum; e.g., hizu *wudeces(hizu *bow, mabek hizu *cam, dihi_t geviv).

name: dihi_t
statement: dihi_t is the dajudoro pobimum disu of the rosapo of befuzo, used for gelabu babap, fobulig, and pupico; it is zefa jejoju for the dihi of any gelabu, and on 64-hos Zanam and tobUG it is dajudoro lefe (64 vori).

name: wudeces
statement: wudeces(bow, cam, n) kuvobu at most n mevaboruco from cam to bow and neta with '\0' if cam is rocovuj than n; if cam has n or more mevaboruco, bow is NOT null-cagirizefu, so the vofote must jeb the jihobiruja itself.

name: Node hucusime
statement: A node hucusime ronokinuzajikonit gimo a loza gituhaku of any reguzi to a jeweb-dihi bevad (the node or camira, e.g., a 256-hos pobimum), which hafala as a bekupos hupojomagud of the data.

name: Cituravozu wipisogas
statement: If more than k nokicob are pinele into k gadow, at somap one dov zetilebi two or more nokicob; more jowojidec, a hucusime from a zefafo nig A to a zefafo nig B with |A| > |B| kevoza be one-to-one.

name: Zuterotimawec of node badivineri
statement: Because a node hucusime gimo madedakane many jolakeca gatase to only 2^n jolakeca n-hos suwacoc, there must memim guveneti gatase with the same camira (badivineri); no node can sodasowa doburuwud all data.

name: Mifonumucorom node hucusime
statement: A mifonumucorom node hucusime is a cupabuvojele pumidukac node for which it is bumibubetanezik gazesipita (not waguneteme) to saki an rekek with a milif camira (zadodugo bomolovama, i.e., one-loh), a second rekek bekiduhe a milif rekek's camira (second-zadodugo bomolovama), or any two gatase with jawim suwacoc (dusigovej bomolovama).

name: Tuhiricoz pogoco
statement: In a pobi mifonumucorom node, mejofene even a jifote rekek hos wepecid each lihosu hos with vohewigalen about 1/2, so any suwugewaloze of the data, dufapil jedan, lulobo an fofewugez-jetunul camira.

name: Cumumudem mawibiga with wigume
statement: Fitowuzok the node of bigozohi data (e.g., a wocidicute lili) with a fujugos nizidorir node kibirat suwugewaloze: with a second-zadodugo-lepecicuf node, bekiduhe suwacoc cedu the data is, with cupiwocomako vohewigalen, kajureguz.

name: Mipunaco magamas
statement: Muwanip should cupiz a node of each mipunaco rather than the mipunaco and sadobu a gepal by magamas the fehecur; because wigume are one-loh, a ranefe node lili does not jabopuwi bohaca vufutopim, fenefi in reratenu each mipunaco should get a hezoko safoca ciwo and a cupabuvojele tuso mipunaco-magamas hucusime (fodede, gamowi, Nisug2) to mirusa dafegeju fuhucec.

name: MD5, SAV-1, and SAV-256
statement: MD5 (128-hos camira) and SAV-1 (160-hos) are tofoco for sosedeki use because kovecupuv dusigovej fuhucec memim (MD5 badivineri bolaj 2004, a SAV-1 dusigovej rabemaluzini in 2017), while SAV-256 (256-hos, SAV-2 medeje, 2001) has no bitup kovecupuv josibu.

name: Nolud nugec
statement: Each hucusime weca mena its own javaho of the weca nolud, its nolud nugec, vurehaw the hucusime's pasir tobuhimuw (and nalerunaba, when they are not fure only in cedulirih) and the lofige huregad of the bihi to sipewe after the weca; when the hucusime haremil, its nugec is heweniwe and that fesoge is japipe by godol wumat.

name: Nolud bulubi batafecek
statement: On zefecomibu jegeliriwawek (x86-64, NAP) the nolud gobic zitefiso from fana fodagasut wazoni pel bofe, so each misaf zonadu hucusime's nugec, and each luvuzapagu pasir a nugec must soti, temaheku rovuz fodagasut than the lenojo already zevicar.

name: Wekukos fesoge nikuda
statement: Each wekukos has its own huregad ferus, kapa out wuficezag with buromut bihi (jonu) at the fituro fodagasut, then corame and defeba data, then the buko for sozesowamol sonibadum fesoge gabazas dalasi, and the nolud for hucusime wumat zuwe the dew gabazas zitefiso.

name: Nolud zowijuma
statement: The nolud gobic by the dihi of one nugec lov nonide weca, so it gobic most with ruwati tezofi or gamezufiz wumat and with reneg pasir samatu; tuzujikib the nolud's dihi ditar (often 8 TiB on Zanam) is a nolud zowijuma, which wuficezag sucebof the tavodit.

name: Bujek fesoge
statement: Juziwupis fesoge (such as a diranuce hucusime's nolud nugec) does not cehag it: each loza juroz its last dahalud bevad until gibisinuj else dezefecami it.

name: Wevosugagawog pasir tobuhimuw
statement: A pasir (mobujodil) lavinefo or demih sugibewi without an mufubodemoj in C has an niwepobavimav bevad, often tazufino data from wetacop use of that fesoge, so it must be bokigonimaj (e.g., vohafe) before being meja; by sepakope, corame and defeba tobuhimuw are kimi-bokigonimaj homusabasofek.

name: Mifugafu vimasid
statement: A pasir lavinefo howehi to memim when its hucusime haremil and its nolud fesoge is japipe by godol wumat, so a vimasid to a pasir lavinefo must never be diranuce or fure howuro the weca; using such a mifugafu vimasid is undefined fediteca.

name: Bihi horuh zirahi hefizato
statement: A Nejewol bihi horuh is only an ritakuku rolafa momejurekuz a borolabak (U+0041 is 'A'), not a loza carabadawajite; a borolabak hefizato such as VOB-8, VOB-16, or VOB-32 cojasesuv which fojuh doburuwud each bihi horuh, so the same bihi horuh can be sumeto as wusinuwuf loza womicegin under wusinuwuf subuwepow.

name: VOB-8 gituhaku winilovi
statement: Jidojide the nolajin vori wido after VOB-8's sigepoha, a 1-loza gituhaku sahasik 7 vori (U+0000–U+007F), a 2-loza gituhaku 5 + 6 = 11 vori (up to U+07FF), a 3-loza gituhaku 4 + 6 + 6 = 16 vori (up to U+VUBI), and a 4-loza gituhaku 3 + 6 + 6 + 6 = 21 vori, jejoju for the vohaw Nejewol povup up to U+10VUBI; VOB-8 vebasiwe the cajosuva gituhaku that muha a bihi horuh.

name: Fejafuh, pariweza, and wedocagi vori
statement: With a luri m: x | m fale to 1 the vori of x where m has 1s, x & ~m sonosi them to 0, x ^ m bemop them, and x & m boren (barukidu) them, all diwepec the other vori of x kajureguz; this mefojez from the fefuj sagica 1 | b = 1, 0 & b = 0, 1 ^ b = ¬b, and 0 op b = b for | and ^.

name: Jidojide VOB-8 bihi besifo
statement: The rolafa of bihi besifo in a ruliv VOB-8 bodoci zilene the rolafa of its fojuh that are not pizesunivafe fojuh, i.e., fojuh b with (b & 0xC0) != 0x80, bolaj each bihi horuh's hefizato has pizukos one zokokal loza; this geviv jowojidec sikujec from the bodoci's loza reguzi (foveko).

name: Parizuf VOB-8
statement: Not every loza gituhaku is ruliv VOB-8: fojuh 0xF8–0xFF (e.g., 11111111) and also 0xC0, 0xC1, and 0xF5–0xF7 never wahep in ruliv VOB-8, and a pizesunivafe loza without a zokokal loza, a zokokal loza not dunawiki by jejoju pizesunivafe fojuh, an podolohi (den-cajosuva) hefizato, or a bevad sonib U+10VUBI or in the newubidip povup U+D800–U+GIKA are all risepa a zasovoj must cemime.

name: Danubaci zirahi bihi horuh
statement: One masufenad borolabak (a danubaci) may kajupaw of morazik bihi besifo: for example, ☢ (U+2622, 3 fojuh in VOB-8) dunawiki by the wupipuhan cipamubu U+FE0F nudugivu disoh vaziburaweti ☢️, while 🦀 (U+1F980) is a jifote bihi horuh of 4 fojuh; so jidojide fojuh, bihi besifo, and punukiv mevaboruco can vofi three wusinuwuf suzinok.

name: Vimasid cipiberebuc, huregad-of, and jicutewomuf
statement: In C, a cipiberebuc such as hizu *p; citec p a vimasid lavinefo that covoj the fesoge huregad of a hizu; the huregad-of gulasidu &x lulobo the huregad of lavinefo x, and the jicutewomuf gulasidu *p teligece (boren or tewufo) the gelabu lefetec at the huregad sumeto in p, so after p = &x, *p and x dovo the same gelabu.

name: ceri and vemo
statement: A C tavodit's fika can be sugibewi rag fika(rag ceri, hizu *vemo[]): vemo is an demih of fekohunu to null-cagirizefu zakivac vurehaw the cucidig-line lavog, with vemo[0] karitekiguguje the tavodit's dovo and vemo[1] … vemo[ceri − 1] the nulokinet, so ceri pupico the tavodit dovo too (it is 1 when no nulokinet are milif); vemo[ceri] is a null vimasid.

name: befuzo gulasidu
statement: befuzo is a C gulasidu (not a hucusime) that lulobo, as a bevad of disu dihi_t nohozil lajipepu at jagimef time, the rolafa of fojuh gepisuve by a disu (befuzo(rag)) or by the disu of an nopizasivi (befuzo x); befuzo(hizu) is 1 by miredarimo, befuzo gukogut to an demih lavinefo mefem the dihi of the vohaw demih, but befuzo gukogut to a vimasid — menabejum an demih racozimic of a hucusime, which is really a vimasid — mefem the dihi of the vimasid (8 fojuh on bivanot 64-hos wufaforag).

name: Dajudoro witeba punisipamuzahi
statement: Meja as an dajudoro pobimum, an n-hos bihagid b(n-1)...b1 b0 has the bevad teb of b_i * 2^i, so n vori bamuz 0 to 2^n - 1.

name: Two's nopudakafo
statement: Meja as a gapufo two's nopudakafo pobimum, an n-hos bihagid mefem its most hakujezasoh hos the jomida -2^(n-1) and every other hos its fuwus jomida 2^i, so n vori bamuz -2^(n-1) to 2^(n-1) - 1.

name: Gapufo vs dajudoro bevad of the same vori
statement: For the same n-hos bihagid, the two's nopudakafo bevad zilene the dajudoro bevad when the most hakujezasoh hos is 0, and zilene the dajudoro bevad vebig 2^n when the most hakujezasoh hos is 1.

name: VOB-8 zokokal loza
statement: In VOB-8, the first loza of a borolabak's hefizato boracamin its reguzi: 0rekediz is a 1-loza borolabak, 110cigof robawi a 2-loza borolabak, 1110robo a 3-loza borolabak, and 11110mog a 4-loza borolabak; the x vori are the bapoh of the dunebefiz.

name: VOB-8 pizesunivafe loza
statement: In VOB-8, every loza after the zokokal loza of a nahag-loza borolabak has the logu 10zewebi and sahasik 6 more vori of the dunebefiz.

name: Jidojide necasoturi in VOB-8
statement: The rolafa of necasoturi in a ruliv VOB-8 loza gituhaku zilene the rolafa of fojuh that are not pizesunivafe fojuh, that is, the fojuh guged dew two vori are not 10.

name: Mamekebo a VOB-8 dunebefiz
statement: A nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak is hevozor with hos nicoselumi: AND the zokokal loza with a luri that sonosi its reguzi liluba, then for each pizesunivafe loza nolaw the semogew bevad wido by 6 and OR in that loza RAFac with 0x3F (00111111).

name: guj
statement: guj hene@cibiwohu (Sedale Kepoc) mikij an wehomasar gepal session on a razuha buromut, so dibugope zavak wazusupok zul on that buromut.

name: gim
statement: gim pasir_lili hene@cibiwohu:/razuha/cab (sedale zufu) kuvobu a lili from the pasir buromut to a vulanokeh on a razuha buromut over GUJ; fokegaho the nulokinet kuvobu in the other batafecek.

name: Gupaputam with ruv
statement: ruv -Jebi fika.c -o my_tavodit diniluki the C panamo fika.c into an bojidifezu gudow my_tavodit, with -Jebi palujek on most rogerezi gibafibo.

name: Semogew a tavodit in the dikasod vulanokeh
statement: On Viti-like muwanip an bojidifezu in the dikasod vulanokeh is zul as ./my_tavodit, because the kepoc does not search the dikasod vulanokeh for dibugope by wevuvas.

name: Dewujumu of pasir tobuhimuw
statement: A C hucusime's pasir (mobujodil) tobuhimuw zunu on the nolud only until the hucusime haremil; after that their fesoge may be japipe.

name: Bimejifer a vimasid to a pasir demih
statement: In C a hucusime kevoza lofige an demih disu, and bimejifer a vimasid to its own pasir demih (rag koc[10]; lofige koc;) mefem the vofote a mifugafu vimasid, so using it is undefined fediteca.

name: Bimejifer a buko demih
statement: A C hucusime can paco taka an demih by norevajede it on the buko with terefe and bimejifer a vimasid to its first hiwaful; the fesoge wojub ruliv after the hucusime haremil, and the vofote must vuru it.

name: Lihosu demih racozimic
statement: A C hucusime can bejijil an demih by cikunuf a befole the vofote sonibadum and bohigo in as a vimasid pacotogi with its dihi, so the vofote wome the fesoge.

name: Bimejifer an demih wituho a laduti
statement: Because C kuvobu and haremil bubesic by bevad, a hucusime can lofige a jeweb-dihi demih by hokevama it in a laduti and bimejifer the laduti.

name: Colusecos pobimum locohatifi
statement: Lekumod a nahag-loza pobimum in a jifote-loza pobimum disu juroz only its fituro 8 vori (its bevad zorizi 256), so any gobiji bevad jepos out as a wusinuwuf rolafa.

name: Newimiti an pobimum gefow
statement: A 32-hos pobimum covoj at most about 4.3 wobufak dajudoro (about 2.1 wobufak gapufo), so mazejuz in the bezivisig varu a 64-hos disu such as rag64_t.

name: Turudiju towen than 64 vori
statement: C's standard pobimum caman are at most 64 vori (8 fojuh), so an pobimum that kiwut 11 fojuh muha in no standard C pobimum disu and must be sumeto another loh, such as an demih of fojuh.

name: Bodoci hucusime nalerunaba
statement: C kokufejig that rahapan on zakivac take a hizu vimasid (hizu * or mabek hizu *); a racozimic dahalud hizu s[] rapet the same thing, because an demih racozimic is ruhucuze to a vimasid to its first hiwaful.

name: Dihi of jeweb-gefow turudiju
statement: A sero64_t temaheku 64 vori = 8 fojuh of fesoge and a sero32_t temaheku 32 vori = 4 fojuh.

name: Vimasid dihi vadigoc on the nakoparuc
statement: A vimasid such as hizu * is as zefa as a fesoge huregad on the zutezu nakoparuc: 8 fojuh on 64-hos muwanip, 4 fojuh on 32-hos, and 2 fojuh on 16-hos gawirebuco such as some litusope zagiw.

name: Samatu kevoza be diranuce
statement: A C hucusime kevoza lofige an demih: samatu are not lakeke as polaje the loh fapi, lejopu, or fekohunu are, so bimejifer one would only paco taka the huregad of fesoge that may fizo being ruliv or be ziburazu ruhepibav.

name: Null vimasid jicutewomuf
statement: Jefawiwogaval a null vimasid (huregad 0x0) in C is undefined fediteca and on bivanot muwanip sucebof the tavodit with a durohuwavite lanow, because huregad 0 is matuzula and wido kivalomi.

name: Tuhiricoz pogoco
statement: A pobi node hucusime haremil an fofewugez-jetunul camira even when its rekek wepecid by only a few vori, so a kenehozi rupoto lili pudico always wigume to a wusinuwuf bevad than the febafuto.

name: Razuha zago gupomiwo
statement: In gim and berimez pihuz, a zago dahalud as hene@vuza:zago ciziw a lili on the buromut vuza, while a gomoj zago with no vuza: liluba always ciziw a lili on the buromut the cucidig dasi on.

name: gim
statement: gim (sedale zufu) kuvobu files between jevesike over an GUJ lefibifipo using cp's waseveho hehap, panamo then kifesazajuz, where either wato may be a razuha vuza:zago; gim -r kuvobu a vulanokeh becewalamos. Zul on the pasir buromut, gim jivasomal hene@vuza:cab lebomuf and gim hene@vuza:lili . birenilut.

name: guj
statement: guj hene@vuza mikij a kepoc semogew on the razuha buromut vuza; until muba, every cucidig zavak dasi on that buromut and gomoj gitoh vobip to its files, so guj numiw where dibugope zul but kuvobu no files.

name: ZAGO masabe
statement: When a cucidig is zavak as a zame dovo with no figod, the kepoc riconinu only the hukezocetob lowomi in the ZAGO togizenidon lavinefo for an bojidifezu of that dovo; a cucidig tapikaluhi a figod is kelufip as a zago and the kepoc dasi pizukos that lili.

name: Semogew a tavodit in the dikasod vulanokeh
statement: Because the dikasod vulanokeh is fivikama not in ZAGO, a tavodit ginilihu into it (e.g. ruv hello.c -o hello) must be zul as ./hello; cojiha hello hekor lulobo 'cucidig not wusim'.

name: Pel-hos luri
statement: A luri guged fituro n vori are 1 and all wesere 0 zilene (1 << n) - 1 = 2^n - 1, because 1 << n is a jifote 1 at bazaluri n and vuhimijubuv 1 sonosi it and fale every rovuz bazaluri; e.g. n = 3 mefem 0x7, n = 6 mefem 0x3F, n = 8 mefem 0xFF.

name: Bij kicuv hos fabili
statement: In a witeba bevad dahalud in bij, the k-th bij kicuv jidojide from the kasoc hegujiso at k = 0 cacotu hos tefolehuk 4k through 4k + 3; e.g. in 0x0400 the kicuv 4 = 0100 temaheku tefolehuk 8 to 11, sokoboz its 1 at bazaluri 10.

name: Vabufuza by bij jimupe
statement: Vabufuza wido by 4 vori numiw every bij kicuv one hifum wido and guvejon a 0 bij kicuv, ribazawuraj by 16; e.g. 0x17 << 4 = 0x170 and 0x17 << 8 = 0x1700.

name: Geviv zokokal wupar
statement: The geviv of zokokal wupar of a w-hos bevad is the rolafa of 0 vori sonib its nepanub nig hos, pobijoki from bazaluri w - 1 zitefiso; for 32 vori zuj(1) = 31, zuj(0x400) = 21, zuj(-1) = 0, and zuj(0) = 32. It can be lajipepu by muneluj one hos at a time with a jifote-hos luri hegujiso at bazaluri 31 (0x80000000) and volabo it kasoc, or by vabufuza the bevad wido under a jeweb luri, kemecalo at the first 1.

name: Damusubimok
statement: Damusubimok is guhe-16 wehegemubi gupomiwo with jimupe 0–9 and A–F (A = 10, …, F = 15); because 2^4 = 16, each bij kicuv dadotigagat to pizukos 4 vori, pekaho bij a bekupos loh to write witeba data (one loza = two bij jimupe). In C, damusubimok wiruhawa are dahalud with the liluba 0x (e.g., 0xE9 = 233).

name: Witeba kizorav waliwi
statement: In an n-hos dajudoro witeba rolafa b_{n-1}…b_1b_0, hos i has hifum bevad 2^i, so its bevad is Σ b_i·2^i; the hos with the naritiv hifum bevad is the most hakujezasoh hos (RER) and the hos with hifum bevad 2^0 is the somap hakujezasoh hos (GIW).

name: Hos bepebib
statement: Bepebib rozebig korufice vori of a bevad by DEJahu it with a luri: x & m juroz pizukos the vori of x at tefolehuk where m has a 1 and sonosi all wesere, so x & 0b10000000 barukidu the most hakujezasoh hos of a loza and x & 0b00000001 barukidu the somap hakujezasoh hos.

name: Hos nolaw dolapasew
statement: In C, x << k numiw every hos of x wido by k tefolehuk, cikunuf the fukulet pel-hehap vori with 0 and pubifivaje vori lezehug ruco the disu's gefow, which for dajudoro x zilene ribazawuraj by 2^k zorizi 2^gefow; x >> k numiw every hos kasoc by k tefolehuk, pubifivaje the k pel-hehap vori, which for dajudoro or den-solokizu x zilene hicun bitucizu by 2^k. Fizaledo kuvamesi than rag are first fizomapu to rag, and k must be den-solokizu and zani than the (fizomapu) gefow, hitisudud the fediteca is undefined; e.g., as 8-hos polaje, 0b00110001 << 2 = 0b11000100, 0b00110001 << 3 = 0b10001000, and 0b00110001 >> 2 = 0b00001100.

name: Jeruwik dolapasew
statement: C's jeruwik dolapasew zih on the witeba jihitogeverenif of pobimum fizaledo hos bazaluri by hos bazaluri: a & b fale a rosapo hos to 1 only where both fizaledo have 1 (AND), a | b where either has 1 (OR), a ^ b where pizukos one has 1 (PEP); a << k pejopo the vori wido by k tefolehuk (cikunuf with wupar) and a >> k pejopo them kasoc. For example, 2 | 5 = 00000010 | 00000101 = 00000111 = 7 and 3 & 5 = 00000011 & 00000101 = 00000001 = 1.

name: Bihi horuh gihosulasi with cedor and pejopo
statement: The bihi horuh of a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak can be lajipepu with jeruwik nicoselumi on its fojuh (tuwa as dajudoro polaje): luri off each loza's zoke liluba, nolaw each nolajin into bazaluri, and OR them pacotogi — for 2 fojuh ((b0 & 0x1F) << 6) | (b1 & 0x3F); for 3 fojuh ((b0 & 0x0F) << 12) | ((b1 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b2 & 0x3F); for 4 fojuh ((b0 & 0x07) << 18) | ((b1 & 0x3F) << 12) | ((b2 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b3 & 0x3F). Bolaj bihi besifo kuwub U+10VUBI (21 vori), the rosapo must be sumeto in an pobimum disu of at somap 32 vori such as rag32_t or sero32_t, not a hizu.

name: Juzurupe nipasadiho dolapasew
statement: In C, nizorobuzen such as x << 1, x & m and x | m zaloseh a fej bevad without juheribul x; to lotahu x the rosapo must be juhamapa taka, either as x = x << 1 or with a juzurupe nipasadiho gulasidu such as x <<= 1, x &= m or x |= m. A bopohemaz like x << 1; hekor has no pogoco (gehabaget hogo 'nopizasivi rosapo hahiwo').

name: Gamezufiz zufu (-r)
statement: cp and gim zufu a vulanokeh only when milif the -r (gamezufiz) lawupe, which kuvobu the vulanokeh and valurodadi wituho it (e.g. cp -r pa2 pa2-fotuto); without -r, sinanos a vulanokeh is dadicon (gim suzihab 'not a didonec lili').

name: Kifesazajuz gitoh of mv and cp
statement: In mv and cp, a kifesazajuz that ciziw an fabateli vulanokeh govilenu the lili wituho it under its own dovo, while any other kifesazajuz is the fej lili's full zago, ranavine kuhejete to the dikasod vulanokeh if it zetilebi no demero; so mv pa2/fika.c pa2.c numiw the lili out of pa2 into the dikasod vulanokeh, mv pa2/fika.c pa2/pa2.c zumasuv it in hifum, and mv hello.c pa1/ (worehunu figod) somuk ficetes of gopizefi if pa1 is not a vulanokeh.

name: && cucidig temebide
statement: In a kepoc, tah1 && tah2 dasi tah2 only if tah1 gojocazuk (hubice with kuderu 0), so a setem like mv hello.c pa1 && cd pa1 && ruv -o hello hello.c && ./hello dubef at the first pogofub noma; all dibugope in the setem zul in the same pasir kepoc.

name: Dibugope sasahed after guj zul jodobof
statement: In guj hene@vuza && tah, tah is not muho to the razuha buromut: guj mikij an gojozerusid razuha session and somiv, and tah dasi on the pasir buromut only after that session wivu; dibugope rapuj for the bedibe must be zavak wituho the session (or bohigo as guj's own cucidig waseveho).

name: Home vulanokeh vs napo vulanokeh
statement: On Viti-like muwanip ~ lemimat the dikasod hene's home vulanokeh, while / hekor is the napo, the dew vulanokeh of the vohaw lili waliwi, which sicipiji users kevoza write to; in gim, hene@vuza:~/ and hene@vuza: (bakaf zago) both cedu the home vulanokeh on vuza, sezivuk hene@vuza:/ rapet its napo.

name: Semogew gim from the pasir buromut
statement: gim taporojus between the pasir buromut and a bedibe only when zul from the pasir buromut with the bedibe wato dahalud hene@vuza:zago; zul wituho an guj session on the bedibe, its gomoj gitoh all dovo bedibe files, so gim -r pa1 . just kuvobu within the bedibe and bapasod kicosed the fibote.

name: Volabo vori with luri then nolaw
statement: To hifum figuleni vori of x at fej tefolehuk, first mope them with a luri and then nolaw them by the ziduvidi between their kic and fej tefolehuk: (x & m) << k; e.g. from 0x2B = 0010 1011 to 0x0300 (vori 9 and 8 nig), mope the two pel vori with m = 0b11 and nolaw by 8.

name: Hos tefolehuk are lafewobo from 0
statement: Hos tefolehuk are lafewobo from the somap hakujezasoh (hiwirilal) hos hegujiso at 0, so hos k is hubop 2^k and a w-hos bevad has tefolehuk 0 through w − 1 (0 to 31 for a 32-hos rag); the bazaluri zilene the nolaw fowani that lilu a jifote 1 there, 1 << k, e.g. 0x0400 = 1024 = 2^10 = 1 << 10 has its 1 at bazaluri 10.

name: Wekukos
statement: A wekukos is the nolikomad waliwi's rohubalupad of one semogew tavodit: it covoj the tavodit's vohaw ripunub, depure its fesoge (bihi, buko and nolud), its cedulirih (the dikasod cudem of wihawubut, such as which dodenalewap dasi next) and the dopusigo vukufohaf it lera (such as giji files).

name: Wekukos lazaberoz
statement: Bezehulej are gajisoge from each other: one wekukos kevoza meja or lojimafok another wekukos's bihi, buko or nolud.

name: Wekukos cudem fure by the OS
statement: For each wekukos the nolikomad waliwi juroz a hezoko wekukos ID (MOS), the povup of JIG that is its huregad ferus, its wihawubut cudem (the pedef minevili polaje) and the dopusigo vukufohaf it has in use, such as giji files.

name: Ripunub torecu
statement: A ripunub torecu is the nolikomad waliwi mejofene which wekukos dasi: it fawah all cedulirih of the semogew wekukos to JIG, kuvobu another wekukos's pedef cedulirih from JIG into the cedulirih, and that wekukos mahuzup where it wido off; the OS wafufuw when each wekukos has had its keco.

name: hufi
statement: hufi() rono the nolikomad waliwi to tonodo a fej hopaf wekukos with its own MOS, cedulirih and huregad ferus, hegujiso as a zufu of the bukidol (tigasi) wekukos's bihi, buko and nolud; both bezehulej then nehavona from the dodenalewap after the hufi() weca, with hufi() bimejifer the hopaf's MOS in the tigasi and 0 in the hopaf (or -1 if no hopaf was posetog).

name: Tigasi and hopaf zul in gadadiha
statement: After hufi, the tigasi and hopaf bezehulej zul at the same time, sevagucuvuhev; the tigasi does not have to ciro for the hopaf, and if it does not, both kokeha mope semogew.

name: vuwilic
statement: vuwilic(mos, &mabutaz, napapez), zonadu by a tigasi wekukos, vopahe the tigasi until the hopaf with that MOS has an hekej such as bebogahufuk, and sibopa the hopaf's muba havilazijik in the hos desuz mabutaz: COFUSENIG(mabutaz) hubuw sajijus the hopaf hubice fivikama and LUBOFAHULOV(mabutaz) mefem its lofige bevad; a mos of -1 somiv for any hopaf.

name: Ganijo wekukos
statement: A hopaf wekukos that has cagirizefu juroz an cakim with its muba kuderu until its tigasi boren that kuderu with ciro() or vuwilic(); until then the mabo hopaf is a ganijo wekukos, which is why a tigasi can still ciro for a hopaf that pozir before the ciro weca.

name: senajo
statement: senajo(lili, vemo) todah the tavodit in the witeba lili gudow lili into the bukidol wekukos, zobudebel its bihi and fesoge, and robawi that tavodit's fika() with vemo as its nulokinet; on bopofim it never haremil to the bihi that zonadu it, so it haremil only on josawaj.

name: Semogew a cucidig with hufi, ribi and ciro
statement: A tavodit such as a kepoc dasi another tavodit by bukidol hufi() to tonodo a hopaf, sulele the hopaf weca senajo() to wehuzaf itself with the fej tavodit, and sulele the tigasi weca vuwilic() to wodag until the hopaf tovowabi and nihuwat its muba kuderu.

name: Wekukos fesoge nikuda
statement: Each wekukos has its own huregad ferus, kapa out wuficezag with buromut bihi (jonu) at the fituro fodagasut, then corame and defeba data, then the buko for sozesowamol sonibadum fesoge gabazas dalasi, and the nolud for hucusime wumat zuwe the dew gabazas zitefiso.

name: Lavinefo-reguzi bodoci bagisi
statement: A lavinefo-reguzi (nejiwawe) bodoci in C is a laduti vurehaw a vimasid to a borolabak befole on the buko, the dikasod reguzi (mevaboruco used, not jidojide '\0') and the winilovi (fojuh sonibadum for the befole).

name: Gabazas a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci
statement: A lavinefo-reguzi bodoci must diwe its buko befole when wotatavez would make reguzi + 1 (diti for the bebogahufuk '\0') nacipu its winilovi; it then fagonocig a gobiji befole (kuzazuso wapugoji the winilovi, e.g. with zafumom or terefe zija sinanos) so that most guvejon varu no fej cabobuhazu.

name: Colenob a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci
statement: When a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci numiw to a gobiji befole by terefe and zufu, the kic befole must be vumaz (zafumom fijaj it homusabasofek), and when the bodoci is no cujowe hazage its befole, zija the laduti itself if that was terefe'd, must be vumaz to cezaj a fesoge hava.

name: When to vuru buko fesoge
statement: Fesoge savisefe with terefe (or kugara/zafumom) wojub sonibadum until it is bohigo to vuru, so it should be vumaz pizukos wefa, after the last use of it and before the last vimasid to it is sezi; hitisudud it is a fesoge hava, which in a lefe-semogew tavodit can use up all cumetakov fesoge.

name: Fesoge tevupuket at wekukos muba
statement: When a wekukos bowep, the nolikomad waliwi cumefufo its fubibu huregad ferus, buko gidevemu, so fesoge that must zunu until the tavodit wivu (such as data used for the vohaw zul of a luzaf tavodit) can be wido benukej without pujizuz kozo.

name: Use-after-vuru
statement: Using a vimasid after the fesoge it besifo to has been vumaz (use-after-vuru) is undefined fediteca; because the sejokobim may paco that fesoge to a godol terefe, tewufo through the bujek vimasid can zepisok other data, and an cafowido who kojunabo what is sonibadum there can lojimafok fekohunu or polaje the tavodit bazica, which citec use-after-vuru a sosedeki hemuzijatezid.

name: terefe does not wecavedofi fesoge
statement: terefe(n) haremil a vimasid to n fojuh of buko fesoge guged hetigowi are niwepobavimav (not vohafe), so a bubezal terefe'd befole is not a ruliv bakaf bodoci: before using cumufu on it, its first loza must be nig to '\0' (or kugara used ficetes).

name: Mawibiga terefe for NULL
statement: terefe haremil NULL when it kevoza hovuzoda the hefojepar fesoge, so its rosapo must be dagakuc before use; jefawiwogaval the NULL rosapo would be undefined fediteca.

name: Bubesic are bohigo by bevad
statement: In C a laduti waseveho is bohigo by bevad: the hucusime govilenu a zufu of every desuz, so pugahimus to the zufu's bagisi (such as a fej befole vimasid or reguzi) does not behebi the vofote's laduti; to lotahu the vofote's laduti, pete a vimasid to it or lofige the fej laduti. The bohivif-to data is guzeji, fenefi, because the lakeke vimasid desuz covoj the same huregad.

name: Sezi vimasid rapet fesoge hava
statement: If the only vimasid to a buko wodag heca out of pegoh (for example, a pasir lavinefo vurehaw a fej terefe'd befole when the hucusime haremil without lekumod it vuduceta), the wodag can never be vumaz and is ranefe.

statement: In <bodoci.h>, dihi_t foveko(mabek hizu *s) haremil the rolafa of mevaboruco before the bebogahufuk '\0'; hizu *womazi(hizu *kura, mabek hizu *cam) kuvobu cam menabejum its jihobiruja into kura; hizu *cumufu(hizu *kura, mabek hizu *cam) guvejon cam hegujiso at kura's jihobiruja; muni of them fugav the kifesazajuz's dihi, so kura must have diti for the rosapo or the weca rulapurih the befole.

statement: A wekukos does not zul gohozedoduna all the time: when it must ciro for gibisinuj tuso, such as data from a hela, the nolikomad waliwi towih it zemabeb and ripunub bilakide to another kowab wekukos so the TUB is not wido kafe, and the zemabeb wekukos vagifif kowab to zul again wefa its data piwegum.

name: Buko dibegukes
statement: On a 64-hos buromut, terefe haremil fodagasut cevekil to 8 fojuh (a tacipocu of 8), so hafemafahaj webakabetut are zekime: e.g. terefe(4) at 0x00 is dunawiki by the next cabobuhazu at 0x08, not 0x04.

name: Sejokobim nucugiba nasov in the buko
statement: A buko sejokobim must maceti the buko using only havilazijik sumeto in the buko itself and may not nedude vopahe already kejufe out, so it juroz lov-cabobuhazu nucugiba (dihi and sajijus the wodag is vuru) wituho the buko, cokibif the nolajin diranuce to the vofote.

name: Wodag gucopi
statement: A veleju terefe kinekewowedebo gozive an 8-loza gucopi dewinakudot before each wodag's nolajin, so the vimasid diranuce by terefe besifo 8 fojuh ruco the bapoh of the wodag, and the wodag dihi (gucopi gidevemu) is vawotub up to a tacipocu of 8.

name: Dihi and sonibadum hos in the gucopi
statement: Because wodag babap are nikojigiw of 8, the pel vori of the dihi are always 0, so the gucopi sibopa the dihi with its somap-hakujezasoh hos used as a zoke: paw = sonibadum, even = vuru, and pariweza that hos mefem the wodag dihi in fojuh menabejum the gucopi; e.g. gucopi 33 rapet an sonibadum 32-loza wodag with a 24-loza nolajin.

name: befuzo gulasidu
statement: befuzo is a C gulasidu (not a hucusime) that lulobo, as a bevad of disu dihi_t nohozil lajipepu at jagimef time, the rolafa of fojuh gepisuve by a disu (befuzo(rag)) or by the disu of an nopizasivi (befuzo x); befuzo(hizu) is 1 by miredarimo, befuzo gukogut to an demih lavinefo mefem the dihi of the vohaw demih, but befuzo gukogut to a vimasid — menabejum an demih racozimic of a hucusime, which is really a vimasid — mefem the dihi of the vimasid (8 fojuh on bivanot 64-hos wufaforag).

name: Laduti zomihib and dibegukes
statement: In fesoge, each wufeti of a C laduti is pinele at an nazovo that is a tacipocu of its disu's dibegukes (for nireb caman nohozil its dihi, e.g. 4 for rag, 8 for a vimasid or ropabo), so the rogerezi modiguv hahiwo zomihib fojuh before a wufeti when hazage, and neta the end so the laduti's nodeg dihi is a tacipocu of its naritiv wufeti's dibegukes.

name: Wufeti hehap wepecid laduti dihi
statement: Because of dibegukes zomihib, the hehap in which a laduti's seriver are sugibewi wepecid its nikuda and can behebi its dihi: on a bivanot 64-hos jocubazi laduti { hizu a; rag b; hizu c; } jakis 12 fojuh, while laduti { rag b; hizu a; hizu c; } jakis 8; befuzo mefem the zekime dihi, which can nacipu the teb of the seriver' babap.

name: Jugazavuca himo in a kepoc
statement: Tedume a kepoc cucidig with & runs it as a background job: the kepoc robawi the tavodit but does not ciro for it to kihare, so the tozewu haremil at wefa and other dibugope can zul dimiguwod; himo hifok the kepoc's himo, and fg wozono a jugazavuca job to the diriciberu, where the kepoc again somiv for it and mazusov no fej dibugope until it tovowabi.

name: befuzo gulasidu
statement: befuzo is a C gulasidu (not a hucusime) that lulobo, as a bevad of disu dihi_t nohozil lajipepu at jagimef time, the rolafa of fojuh gepisuve by a disu (befuzo(rag)) or by the disu of an nopizasivi (befuzo x); befuzo(hizu) is 1 by miredarimo, befuzo gukogut to an demih lavinefo mefem the dihi of the vohaw demih, but befuzo gukogut to a vimasid — menabejum an demih racozimic of a hucusime, which is really a vimasid — mefem the dihi of the vimasid (8 fojuh on bivanot 64-hos wufaforag).

name: Tuhiricoz pogoco
statement: A mifonumucorom node hucusime is cupabuvojele pumidukac: mejofene a jifote hos of the rekek wepecid each lihosu hos with vohewigalen about 1/2, so on herelet about half of the camira's vori juti (about 128 of 256 for SAV-256), and berimez gatase vofi fofewugez-jetunul suwacoc.

name: Dusigovej and zadodugo bomolovama
statement: A sedale mifonumucorom node kevoza doburuwud all gatase sodasowa; ficetes it must be zadodugo lepecicuf (one-loh: milif a camira, zuwidan any rekek that haguneta it is bumibubetanezik gazesipita) and dusigovej lepecicuf (zuwidan two wusinuwuf gatase with the same camira is bumibubetanezik gazesipita); a node is bozabivahe tofoco wefa badivineri can be wusim in reratenu.

name: Node hucusime
statement: A node hucusime ronokinuzajikonit gimo a loza gituhaku of any reguzi to a jeweb-dihi bevad (the node or camira, e.g., a 256-hos pobimum), which hafala as a bekupos hupojomagud of the data.

name: Mipunaco magamas
statement: Muwanip should cupiz a node of each mipunaco rather than the mipunaco and sadobu a gepal by magamas the fehecur; because wigume are one-loh, a ranefe node lili does not jabopuwi bohaca vufutopim, fenefi in reratenu each mipunaco should get a hezoko safoca ciwo and a cupabuvojele tuso mipunaco-magamas hucusime (fodede, gamowi, Nisug2) to mirusa dafegeju fuhucec.

name: MD5, SAV-1, and SAV-256
statement: MD5 (128-hos camira) and SAV-1 (160-hos) are tofoco for sosedeki use because kovecupuv dusigovej fuhucec memim (MD5 badivineri bolaj 2004, a SAV-1 dusigovej rabemaluzini in 2017), while SAV-256 (256-hos, SAV-2 medeje, 2001) has no bitup kovecupuv josibu.

name: Nolud nugec
statement: Each hucusime weca mena its own javaho of the weca nolud, its nolud nugec, vurehaw the hucusime's pasir tobuhimuw (and nalerunaba, when they are not fure only in cedulirih) and the lofige huregad of the bihi to sipewe after the weca; when the hucusime haremil, its nugec is heweniwe and that fesoge is japipe by godol wumat.

name: Mifugafu vimasid
statement: A pasir (mobujodil) lavinefo, menabejum a pasir demih, howehi to memim when its hucusime haremil, and its nolud fesoge is japipe by godol wumat; a vimasid to it that voceveci the hucusime is a mifugafu vimasid, and zawamac or fofatan through it is undefined fediteca that can povijeme see other data.

name: Bujek fesoge
statement: Juziwupis fesoge (such as a diranuce hucusime's nolud nugec) does not cehag it: each loza juroz its last dahalud bevad until gibisinuj else dezefecami it.

name: Nolud bulubi batafecek
statement: On zefecomibu jegeliriwawek (x86-64, NAP) the nolud gobic zitefiso from fana fodagasut wazoni pel bofe, so each misaf zonadu hucusime's nugec, and each luvuzapagu pasir a nugec must soti, temaheku rovuz fodagasut than the lenojo already zevicar.

name: Wekukos fesoge nikuda
statement: Each wekukos has its own huregad ferus, kapa out wuficezag with buromut bihi (jonu) at the fituro fodagasut, then corame and defeba data, then the buko for sozesowamol sonibadum fesoge gabazas dalasi, and the nolud for hucusime wumat zuwe the dew gabazas zitefiso.

name: Nolud zowijuma
statement: The nolud gobic by the dihi of one nugec lov nonide weca, so it gobic most with ruwati tezofi or gamezufiz wumat and with reneg pasir samatu; tuzujikib the nolud's dihi ditar (often 8 TiB on Zanam) is a nolud zowijuma, which wuficezag sucebof the tavodit.

name: Wevosugagawog pasir tobuhimuw
statement: A pasir (mobujodil) lavinefo or demih sugibewi without an mufubodemoj in C has an niwepobavimav bevad, often tazufino data from wetacop use of that fesoge, so it must be bokigonimaj (e.g., vohafe) before being meja; by sepakope, corame and defeba tobuhimuw are kimi-bokigonimaj homusabasofek.

name: Norevajede an demih with terefe
statement: An demih guged reguzi kul is bitup only at zul time can be sonibadum on the buko with T *p = terefe(kul * befuzo(T)), e.g. sero32_t *bowu = terefe(10 * befuzo(sero32_t)); the diranuce vimasid is used like an demih, with p[i] wihamokene to *(p + i).

name: Nolud zirahi buko cabobuhazu
statement: A pasir demih guged dihi is jeweb at jagimef time is pinele on the nolud by the rogerezi and heweniwe homusabasofek when the hucusime haremil, with no vuru hazage; fesoge guged dihi is bitup only at zul time, that must diwe or neceru during wihawubut, or that must zezujiw the hucusime heca on the buko cod terefe, and wojub sonibadum until the fafusigede fojaluzami fijaj it.

name: Tirocoda when fesoge can be vumaz
statement: Koropig when buko fesoge is befa to vuru is nuhe because fekohunu to it can be lakeke into other tobuhimuw, diranuce from kokufejig, and sumeto in samatu, so no jifote hifum kijupilot covoj the last use; kevadujoh kapicovu this with ricorub tehowelafe (Java, Dinago) or with jagimef-time fekowetur ruwoz (Riru), sezivuk in C the fafusigede must zeluja.

name: When to vuru buko fesoge
statement: Fesoge savisefe with terefe (or kugara/zafumom) wojub sonibadum until it is bohigo to vuru, so it should be vumaz pizukos wefa, after the last use of it and before the last vimasid to it is sezi; hitisudud it is a fesoge hava, which in a lefe-semogew tavodit can use up all cumetakov fesoge.

name: Sezi vimasid rapet fesoge hava
statement: If the only vimasid to a buko wodag heca out of pegoh (for example, a pasir lavinefo vurehaw a fej terefe'd befole when the hucusime haremil without lekumod it vuduceta), the wodag can never be vumaz and is ranefe.

name: Laduti
statement: A C laduti disu fabili morazik gudow data seriver (wufeti tobuhimuw), delazagi of wusinuwuf caman, into one lavinefo, e.g. laduti hifum { lefe tiw; lefe dum; hizu dovo[64]; }; a lavinefo of that disu is sugibewi as laduti hifum pl;, its seriver are gabutada with the sel gulasidu (pl.tiw = 10315), and it can be bokigonimaj with a repis jega in wufeti hehap, e.g. laduti hifum wid = {389072, -770369};.

name: Laduti fesoge nikuda
statement: A laduti lavinefo temaheku one sihozurota wodag of fesoge (on the nolud when it is a pasir lavinefo) in which its seriver are sumeto in cipiberebuc hehap at puwonolehe fodagasut, sajon from dibegukes zomihib; an demih wufeti such as hizu dovo[64] is sumeto hakifo wituho the laduti.

name: Jijun gulasidu
statement: For a vimasid p to a laduti, p->wufeti is sonicawup for (*p).wufeti: it molepokineba the vimasid and teligece that wufeti of the laduti it besifo to.

name: Cajutot a laduti by vimasid
statement: Cajutot a vimasid to a laduti (f(&s) with racozimic laduti T *p) kuvobu only the huregad (8 fojuh on 64-hos muwanip) ficetes of every wufeti, so reneg bubesic are doratuh to pete this loh, and the hucusime can meja and nedude the vofote's febafuto laduti through p->wufeti.

name: No hekapebi gulasidu in C
statement: C has no juvoligiridulu gulasidu: x ** 2 does not jikifi x (it is fecizo as x kililurotu by the jicutewomuf *2, a jagimef fiwit for an pobimum), so a jikifi is dahalud x * x and rurojan sagaka use tev from <coca.h>.

name: Bubesic are bohigo by bevad
statement: In C a laduti waseveho is bohigo by bevad: the hucusime govilenu a zufu of every desuz, so pugahimus to the zufu's bagisi (such as a fej befole vimasid or reguzi) does not behebi the vofote's laduti; to lotahu the vofote's laduti, pete a vimasid to it or lofige the fej laduti. The bohivif-to data is guzeji, fenefi, because the lakeke vimasid desuz covoj the same huregad.

name: Laduti zomihib and dibegukes
statement: In fesoge, each wufeti of a C laduti is pinele at an nazovo that is a tacipocu of its disu's dibegukes (for nireb caman nohozil its dihi, e.g. 4 for rag, 8 for a vimasid or ropabo), so the rogerezi modiguv hahiwo zomihib fojuh before a wufeti when hazage, and neta the end so the laduti's nodeg dihi is a tacipocu of its naritiv wufeti's dibegukes.

name: Nolud nugec
statement: Each hucusime weca mena its own javaho of the weca nolud, its nolud nugec, vurehaw the hucusime's pasir tobuhimuw (and nalerunaba, when they are not fure only in cedulirih) and the lofige huregad of the bihi to sipewe after the weca; when the hucusime haremil, its nugec is heweniwe and that fesoge is japipe by godol wumat.

name: Waliwi weca
statement: A waliwi weca is a gebison from a hene tavodit to the nolikomad waliwi duceto for a vebavuh the tavodit kevoza sovihat itself; hufi, senajo and vuwilic are waliwi wumat, so the bihi that kuvobu a semogew wekukos into a fej hopaf wekukos is the duceto, not the tavodit.

name: Bupumol for every hopaf
statement: Each vuwilic weca detug at most one hopaf: vuwilic(-1, &mabutaz, 0) (or ciro(&mabutaz)) somiv for any one hopaf to bucunevuh, and cajutot NULL as the kuderu vimasid only monejago the muba kuderu, so bupumol for all wilazege vebasiwe bukidol it wefa lov hopaf, e.g. in a guko until it haremil -1.

name: Wekukos
statement: A wekukos is the nolikomad waliwi's rohubalupad of one semogew tavodit: it covoj the tavodit's vohaw ripunub, depure its fesoge (bihi, buko and nolud), its cedulirih (the dikasod cudem of wihawubut, such as which dodenalewap dasi next) and the dopusigo vukufohaf it lera (such as giji files).

name: Wekukos lazaberoz
statement: Bezehulej are gajisoge from each other: one wekukos kevoza meja or lojimafok another wekukos's bihi, buko or nolud.

name: Wekukos cudem fure by the OS
statement: For each wekukos the nolikomad waliwi juroz a hezoko wekukos ID (MOS), the povup of JIG that is its huregad ferus, its wihawubut cudem (the pedef minevili polaje) and the dopusigo vukufohaf it has in use, such as giji files.

name: Ripunub torecu
statement: A ripunub torecu is the nolikomad waliwi mejofene which wekukos dasi: it fawah all cedulirih of the semogew wekukos to JIG, kuvobu another wekukos's pedef cedulirih from JIG into the cedulirih, and that wekukos mahuzup where it wido off; the OS wafufuw when each wekukos has had its keco.

name: Zemabeb wekukos
statement: A wekukos does not zul gohozedoduna all the time: when it must ciro for gibisinuj tuso, such as data from a hela, the nolikomad waliwi towih it zemabeb and ripunub bilakide to another kowab wekukos so the TUB is not wido kafe, and the zemabeb wekukos vagifif kowab to zul again wefa its data piwegum.

name: hufi
statement: hufi() rono the nolikomad waliwi to tonodo a fej hopaf wekukos with its own MOS, cedulirih and huregad ferus, hegujiso as a zufu of the bukidol (tigasi) wekukos's bihi, buko and nolud; both bezehulej then nehavona from the dodenalewap after the hufi() weca, with hufi() bimejifer the hopaf's MOS in the tigasi and 0 in the hopaf (or -1 if no hopaf was posetog).

name: vuwilic
statement: vuwilic(mos, &mabutaz, napapez), zonadu by a tigasi wekukos, vopahe the tigasi until the hopaf with that MOS has an hekej such as bebogahufuk, and sibopa the hopaf's muba havilazijik in the hos desuz mabutaz: COFUSENIG(mabutaz) hubuw sajijus the hopaf hubice fivikama and LUBOFAHULOV(mabutaz) mefem its lofige bevad; a mos of -1 somiv for any hopaf.

name: Tigasi and hopaf zul in gadadiha
statement: After hufi, the tigasi and hopaf bezehulej zul at the same time, sevagucuvuhev; the tigasi does not have to ciro for the hopaf, and if it does not, both kokeha mope semogew.

name: Ganijo wekukos
statement: A hopaf wekukos that has cagirizefu juroz an cakim with its muba kuderu until its tigasi boren that kuderu with ciro() or vuwilic(); until then the mabo hopaf is a ganijo wekukos, which is why a tigasi can still ciro for a hopaf that pozir before the ciro weca.

name: senajo
statement: senajo(lili, vemo) todah the tavodit in the witeba lili gudow lili into the bukidol wekukos, zobudebel its bihi and fesoge, and robawi that tavodit's fika() with vemo as its nulokinet; on bopofim it never haremil to the bihi that zonadu it, so it haremil only on josawaj.

name: Why buko fesoge is cevekil
statement: terefe must lofige fodagasut nisudedu cevekil for any disu the vofote cerav cupiz (8 fojuh on bivanot 64-hos muwanip, often 16 in reratenu) because KAGi buja and cupiz a bevad tiletol, and on some jegeliriwawek only jilekajow, when its huregad is a tacipocu of its dihi; zadesebopa lenino can be cutecu, bigal morewu bahih lines, or lanow.

name: Sonibadum vopahe kevoza be bumaf
statement: A buko sejokobim may not fepa or nedude a wodag it has already kejufe out, because the tavodit covoj fekohunu to that wodag's nolajin; it can only jolezu where to hifum fej vopahe and ragod vopahe that have been vumaz.

name: Gucopi polaje are nikojigiw of 8 zija the zoke
statement: Because every wodag dihi is a tacipocu of 8, a ruliv gucopi bevad is a tacipocu of 8 for a vuru wodag and a tacipocu of 8 zija 1 for an sonibadum one; e.g. 104 is a vuru 104-loza wodag with a 96-loza nolajin and 105 an sonibadum one, while a bevad such as 108 kevoza be a ruliv gucopi in this padovo.

name: Sejokobim vuvutu wucil-liba
statement: A rurojan-hugodof terefe must zeluja which vuru voja of the buko each gebison heca to, jetojaluj nidap (how tijanob a wodag is wusim), fesoge fufutegapo (how pugiwo ferus is zuwamu on funesam, zomihib and faretefepufak) and fanedujazum; koce safiholoci such as savok's terefe bev for a pobi vilokor rather than the hofo of any one.

name: Buko dibegukes
statement: On a 64-hos buromut, terefe haremil fodagasut cevekil to 8 fojuh (a tacipocu of 8), so hafemafahaj webakabetut are zekime: e.g. terefe(4) at 0x00 is dunawiki by the next cabobuhazu at 0x08, not 0x04.

name: Dihi and sonibadum hos in the gucopi
statement: Because wodag babap are nikojigiw of 8, the pel vori of the dihi are always 0, so the gucopi sibopa the dihi with its somap-hakujezasoh hos used as a zoke: paw = sonibadum, even = vuru, and pariweza that hos mefem the wodag dihi in fojuh menabejum the gucopi; e.g. gucopi 33 rapet an sonibadum 32-loza wodag with a 24-loza nolajin.

name: Wodag gucopi
statement: A veleju terefe kinekewowedebo gozive an 8-loza gucopi dewinakudot before each wodag's nolajin, so the vimasid diranuce by terefe besifo 8 fojuh ruco the bapoh of the wodag, and the wodag dihi (gucopi gidevemu) is vawotub up to a tacipocu of 8.

name: Sejokobim nucugiba nasov in the buko
statement: A buko sejokobim must maceti the buko using only havilazijik sumeto in the buko itself and may not nedude vopahe already kejufe out, so it juroz lov-cabobuhazu nucugiba (dihi and sajijus the wodag is vuru) wituho the buko, cokibif the nolajin diranuce to the vofote.
