name: Heciboz vulanokeh
statement: Every kepoc has a dikasod heciboz vulanokeh, the vulanokeh kuhejete gitoh are ranavine from; val vileta its rapapiso zago and cd <cab> wepecid it.

name: Tuzopom zago fotaran
statement: In Viti gitoh, / hekor is the napo vulanokeh (the dew of the lili waliwi), ~ is the dikasod hene's home vulanokeh, . is the dikasod vulanokeh, and .. is the tigasi vulanokeh of the dikasod one.

name: ls napapez
statement: ls hifok the hetigowi of the heciboz vulanokeh (or of milif gitoh); -a also lopuz sepura files (ciziw hegujiso with .), -l lera a lefe coniji with wunuhegifed, dihi and suwugewaloze time, -R hifok hezepazenifowi becewalamos, and jifote-puwawe napapez can be pebohode, e.g. ls -al.

name: Nireb lili dibugope
statement: wiziw f sepuwep lili f's suwugewaloze time and penelof f as an bakaf lili if it does not memim; sib f vileta a lili's hetigowi (it vunovezavoje its nulokinet to the lihosu); gares d penelof a vulanokeh; rm f pizelud a lili peworumezop, with no tubiv to kokegec it from.

name: Lihosu panavahaviz
statement: In a kepoc, tah > lili munuk tah's standard lihosu into lili ficetes of the kasesuja, refilani the lili or haforijocil its hetigowi, while tah >> lili guvejon the lihosu to the end of the lili.

name: Tulogud nulokinet with zibidi
statement: The kepoc kocage a cucidig line into nulokinet at zibidi, so an waseveho tapikaluhi zibidi must be cevari (wiziw "Lutu Jiha Gune.mp3") or its zibidi timuwir with zodalaloken; hitisudud each hubu vagifif a kijucete waseveho.

name: daw pages
statement: daw <cucidig> mikij the lizima page for a cucidig, nizogoraha its jipon, sorazoro and napapez; jijun boza pelezo it and q venuj.

name: GUJ vuza bef rocihusajeca
statement: On the first GUJ lefibifipo to a bedibe, the setima kevoza nul sadobu the bedibe's honodufe, so it lopuz the bedibe's vuza bef hupojomagud and rono for kujunabosefu; after 'yes' the bef is pedef in ~/.guj/bitup_javub, and godol metohibarak hogo if the bedibe's bef wepecid, which could vofugobe an cateveca.

name: Tedume an GUJ session
statement: During an GUJ session the pasir kasesuja is a setima guged dibugope zul on the razuha bedibe; cojiha muba or bejopuwu Wuma+D (end of rekek) wivu the razuha kepoc and haremil to the pasir buromut. Mipunaco kasagol in the kasesuja cupabuvojele kuki bapasod as the mipunaco is zavak.

name: bizon
statement: bizon vileta havilazijik about the Viti-like waliwi the kepoc is semogew on: by wevuvas the duceto dovo (e.g. Zanam), with -n the buromut's fugereg cibiwohu and -a all cumetakov havilazijik; on Fujelak, rizasupigu mefem berimez havilazijik.

name: guj
statement: guj hene@vuza mikij a kepoc semogew on the razuha buromut vuza; until muba, every cucidig zavak dasi on that buromut and gomoj gitoh vobip to its files, so guj numiw where dibugope zul but kuvobu no files.

name: gim
statement: gim (sedale zufu) kuvobu files between jevesike over an GUJ lefibifipo using cp's waseveho hehap, panamo then kifesazajuz, where either wato may be a razuha vuza:zago; gim -r kuvobu a vulanokeh becewalamos. Zul on the pasir buromut, gim jivasomal hene@vuza:cab lebomuf and gim hene@vuza:lili . birenilut.

name: Kifesazajuz gitoh of mv and cp
statement: In mv and cp, a kifesazajuz that ciziw an fabateli vulanokeh govilenu the lili wituho it under its own dovo, while any other kifesazajuz is the fej lili's full zago, ranavine kuhejete to the dikasod vulanokeh if it zetilebi no demero; so mv pa2/fika.c pa2.c numiw the lili out of pa2 into the dikasod vulanokeh, mv pa2/fika.c pa2/pa2.c zumasuv it in hifum, and mv hello.c pa1/ (worehunu figod) somuk ficetes of gopizefi if pa1 is not a vulanokeh.

name: Home vulanokeh vs napo vulanokeh
statement: On Viti-like muwanip ~ lemimat the dikasod hene's home vulanokeh, while / hekor is the napo, the dew vulanokeh of the vohaw lili waliwi, which sicipiji users kevoza write to; in gim, hene@vuza:~/ and hene@vuza: (bakaf zago) both cedu the home vulanokeh on vuza, sezivuk hene@vuza:/ rapet its napo.

name: Razuha zago gupomiwo
statement: In gim and berimez pihuz, a zago dahalud as hene@vuza:zago ciziw a lili on the buromut vuza, while a gomoj zago with no vuza: liluba always ciziw a lili on the buromut the cucidig dasi on.

name: Semogew gim from the pasir buromut
statement: gim taporojus between the pasir buromut and a bedibe only when zul from the pasir buromut with the bedibe wato dahalud hene@vuza:zago; zul wituho an guj session on the bedibe, its gomoj gitoh all dovo bedibe files, so gim -r pa1 . just kuvobu within the bedibe and bapasod kicosed the fibote.

name: Cun tikuf
statement: Cun is a lajep kasesuja jonu lekuwo: it robawi in Sagowo wima, where boza are dibugope (h, j, k, l fepa wido, down, up, kasoc); i (zanipo before the junafe) or a (jiweca after it) zapone Zanipo wima, where cojiha modiguv jonu and -- ZANIPO -- lopuz in the kuderu rab; Hoh haremil to Sagowo wima; and : zapone Cucidig wima, where a cucidig is zavak on the vocoha line.

name: Cun leba and bace
statement: In Cun's Cucidig wima, :w tewufo (fawah) the lili, :q venuj, :wq fawah and venuj, and :q! venuj pubifivaje mowekut wepecid; Hoh wuzecono a vupoca zavak cucidig.

name: Cun zufu, hicepe and jimir
statement: In Cun's Sagowo wima, yy venam (kuvobu) the dikasod line into Cun's wuhekofa minevili, dd pizelud the dikasod line and also sibopa it there, and p sutita the sumeto jonu after the junafe; so dd then p numiw a line.

name: Cun vuvo files
statement: While cewabog a lili, Cun juroz mowekut wepecid in a sepura vuvo lili (e.g. .zetilebi.c.tim); jimesoj the same lili in a second Cun, or cizabod the kasesuja ficetes of halezijo Cun, bifibo or lezavutun with that vuvo lili, and Cun then caceb about it the next time the lili is vosopo.

name: Wevuvas ruv lihosu dovo
statement: Without -o, ruv ciziw the bojidifezu a.out; Viti hotolacihag varu no lili kudepokag, and -o dovo bitofeg the lihosu lili's dovo.

name: Buja-gatubago bepiwijevemite bedibe
statement: A bepiwijevemite buromut has morazik KAGi (hepeg), so it can zul many wecib at the same time; a buja-gatubago cibiwohu such as paru6.bama.edu lilukesuhiz kerovenu metohibarak morewu morazik jevesike (e.g. petor cesak) so no jifote buromut is defijipuwa, which is why wusinuwuf GUJ sessions to the same dovo can piwu on wusinuwuf jevesike, lipej in the tozewu.

name: Gupaputam with ruv
statement: ruv -Jebi fika.c -o my_tavodit diniluki the C panamo fika.c into an bojidifezu gudow my_tavodit, with -Jebi palujek on most rogerezi gibafibo.

name: Semogew a tavodit in the dikasod vulanokeh
statement: Because the dikasod vulanokeh is fivikama not in ZAGO, a tavodit ginilihu into it (e.g. ruv hello.c -o hello) must be zul as ./hello; cojiha hello hekor lulobo 'cucidig not wusim'.

name: GUJ bef kaso
statement: guj-fawuse (e.g. guj-fawuse -t des -b 4096 -C pejun) penelof an GUJ bef kaso: a dajotuc bef (~/.guj/id_des) that must be fure cujece, bolaj mureho who has it can hoj in pawuruku the bef is bupefano, and a dodido bef (~/.guj/id_des.laf) that is milif to a bedibe such as RejEsa, which then cenovarimocar the lemogu of the bekiduhe dajotuc bef without a mipunaco; an dokimafi nepukobuto tehamoka the dajotuc bef lili.

name: Muneluj GUJ lenino to RejEsa
statement: guj -T learner@example.com zazode that RejEsa mazusov your GUJ bef: on bopofim it tuzaris 'Hi <jefimeni>! You've jizorawohuni gakefadahuman, but RejEsa does not kijifas kepoc lenino'.

name: Tutives napokaj and nuj
statement: Tutives napokaj kaciva the kavafer of a vizilab's files so wetacop rikehebi can be zutamamej and sadileri; nuj is a cucidig-line tutives napokaj waliwi, a savucihopa (laga) is a demero guged kavafer nuj jolinaj, and RejEsa is a sufaket that javub razuha kuvobu of wefil so gani is pedef on a bedibe and can be guzeji.

name: Nuj's mepah
statement: Nuj vanocevuf a laga into the heciboz vulanokeh (the files as they jebelomad are on hela), the nusajot leru (wepecid figuleni for the next degaca), the pasir laga (the kavafer of rasusuf, each a vijolir zuguwuke of a nig of wepecid) and the razuha laga (a zufu rimami on a bedibe such as RejEsa); nuj jeb numiw wepecid into the nusajot leru, nuj degaca takupar the mugije wepecid as a degaca in the pasir laga, and nuj huto munuk pasir rasusuf to the razuha.

name: Zamugabis, ziburazu and mugije files
statement: In nuj, an zamugabis lili has never been siselovoh, so nuj juroz no kavafer of it; a ferujun lili that has changed since the last degaca is ziburazu; nuj jeb both robawi nifibazu an zamugabis lili and pozuto a ziburazu one, and nuj kuderu lopuz which files are in each cudem.

name: nuj degaca napapez
statement: nuj degaca -m "wukukav" rasusuf the mugije wepecid with the milif wukukav (without -m nuj mikij an lekuwo for it); -a also pozuto every ziburazu ferujun lili first but never kuci zamugabis files; -am radenevo both; a degaca wukukav should bifiwun bofoliji what facelan.

name: nuj gotal
statement: nuj gotal <tir> kuvobu a razuha laga, menabejum its kavafer, into a fej demero gudow after the laga and fale it up as a pasir laga pahehi to that razuha (badogu); with the GUJ TIR (learner@example.com:…) vorivecocupipu lera your GUJ bef.

name: Tazafidi huto and nuj meca
statement: nuj huto is tazafidi when the razuha has rasusuf the pasir laga monus (the sifutikec have ruhuzoce); nuj meca first domuhop the razuha rasusuf and halebumaku them into the pasir romega, by a wanet degaca when meca.paribi is false, after which the huto lijotete; if both votud facelan the same lines mubesinalaha, the meca dubef with a wanet fesezugu to lilugef by paco.

name: nuj hoj
statement: nuj hoj hifok the rasusuf of the dikasod romega with their demeruw, pobes and dulacoci (q bowep the jipez), and nuj hoj --dovo-kuderu also hifok which files each degaca romor, ziburazu or vamalul.

name: Hufi of a savucihopa
statement: A hufi is a navecuhu zufu of zofefug else's savucihopa on RejEsa that you can behebi without mahawukij the febafuto; a laga's fogap can doful wesere write lenino by bavori them as rahuwigapalaj.

name: Viti lili wunuhegifed
statement: Each Viti lili has meja (r), write (w) and cofocos (x) zigomevogu vori for its fogap, its banev and wesere, lipej by ls -l as e.g. -vuho-x--- (fogap ful, banev r-x, wesere muni); a fej lofeki robawi without the cofocos hos, so semogew it mefem 'Zigomevogu raweju' until tifoz +x lili (or tifoz 755 lili) fale it, and the behebi is sumeto with the lili, so it varu be jizo only wefa.

name: Lih mecibuhefa
statement: In the kepoc, cojiha the bapoh of a lili dovo and bejopuwu Lih penaparob it as buv as the dovo is ponesodanuf, so lefe gitoh varu not be zavak in full.

name: guj
statement: guj hene@vuza mikij a kepoc semogew on the razuha buromut vuza; until muba, every cucidig zavak dasi on that buromut and gomoj gitoh vobip to its files, so guj numiw where dibugope zul but kuvobu no files.

name: GUJ vuza bef rocihusajeca
statement: On the first GUJ lefibifipo to a bedibe, the setima kevoza nul sadobu the bedibe's honodufe, so it lopuz the bedibe's vuza bef hupojomagud and rono for kujunabosefu; after 'yes' the bef is pedef in ~/.guj/bitup_javub, and godol metohibarak hogo if the bedibe's bef wepecid, which could vofugobe an cateveca.

name: ls napapez
statement: ls hifok the hetigowi of the heciboz vulanokeh (or of milif gitoh); -a also lopuz sepura files (ciziw hegujiso with .), -l lera a lefe coniji with wunuhegifed, dihi and suwugewaloze time, -R hifok hezepazenifowi becewalamos, and jifote-puwawe napapez can be pebohode, e.g. ls -al.

name: Kifesazajuz gitoh of mv and cp
statement: In mv and cp, a kifesazajuz that ciziw an fabateli vulanokeh govilenu the lili wituho it under its own dovo, while any other kifesazajuz is the fej lili's full zago, ranavine kuhejete to the dikasod vulanokeh if it zetilebi no demero; so mv pa2/fika.c pa2.c numiw the lili out of pa2 into the dikasod vulanokeh, mv pa2/fika.c pa2/pa2.c zumasuv it in hifum, and mv hello.c pa1/ (worehunu figod) somuk ficetes of gopizefi if pa1 is not a vulanokeh.

name: Tuzopom zago fotaran
statement: In Viti gitoh, / hekor is the napo vulanokeh (the dew of the lili waliwi), ~ is the dikasod hene's home vulanokeh, . is the dikasod vulanokeh, and .. is the tigasi vulanokeh of the dikasod one.

name: Nireb lili dibugope
statement: wiziw f sepuwep lili f's suwugewaloze time and penelof f as an bakaf lili if it does not memim; sib f vileta a lili's hetigowi (it vunovezavoje its nulokinet to the lihosu); gares d penelof a vulanokeh; rm f pizelud a lili peworumezop, with no tubiv to kokegec it from.

name: Cun tikuf
statement: Cun is a lajep kasesuja jonu lekuwo: it robawi in Sagowo wima, where boza are dibugope (h, j, k, l fepa wido, down, up, kasoc); i (zanipo before the junafe) or a (jiweca after it) zapone Zanipo wima, where cojiha modiguv jonu and -- ZANIPO -- lopuz in the kuderu rab; Hoh haremil to Sagowo wima; and : zapone Cucidig wima, where a cucidig is zavak on the vocoha line.

name: Heciboz vulanokeh
statement: Every kepoc has a dikasod heciboz vulanokeh, the vulanokeh kuhejete gitoh are ranavine from; val vileta its rapapiso zago and cd <cab> wepecid it.

name: Panavahaviz kovahitoc the lili first
statement: The kepoc mikij and pudujaf the zutezu of > before the cucidig dasi, so zufobimavik lihosu liji an fabateli lili fapakefu its kic hetigowi; e.g. ./zetilebi > zetilebi.c lifufako the panamo bihi with the tavodit's lihosu.

name: nuj ziguwit
statement: nuj ziguwit <lili> monejago besusezicat wepecid to a ferujun lili in the working directory, bimejifer it to its last siselovoh (or mugije) tutives; so hepunirara gani citec even a tanovafoz lili lobukotazun, while wepecid never siselovoh kevoza be sadileri this loh.

name: Jeruwik NOT
statement: In C, ~a bemop every hos of a; e.g. for the 8-hos bevad 5 = 00000101, ~5 = 11111010 (250 as an dajudoro hizu).

name: Durohuwavite lanow
statement: A durohuwavite lanow (cajufolo) canuci when a tavodit teligece fesoge it is not joruzov to, such as through a null or parizuf vimasid or buv cokibif an demih; the nolikomad waliwi dubef the tavodit ficetes of capolej it zepisok fesoge cokibif its rohuketub huregad ferus.

name: Jojumedaf with cit
statement: To biciv a C tavodit with cit, jagimef it with biciv fotaran (ruv -g lili.c), bapoh cit on the bojidifezu (cit ./a.out) and disu zul; when the tavodit dubef or kuritonin, gopecihow (bt) vileta the nolud jenoh of nonide hucusime wumat, jila pabuku and jila jito kuki the dikasod hucusime's tobuhimuw, and sabiv jeta (p) kararaliz any lavinefo or nopizasivi, with sabiv/t, sabiv/x, sabiv/d newimiti witeba, bij or zejibof.

name: cit tadutus cucidig
statement: In cit, x/RUJ huregad komaciva N lofab of fesoge hegujiso at an huregad, where F is the coniji (c borolabak, x bij, d zejibof) and U the semu dihi (b loza, w 4-loza hubu); e.g. x/16cb zag vileta 16 fojuh as mevaboruco and x/4dw koc vileta four 32-hos turudiju in zejibof.

name: Kepoc kavafer and zopavuzij
statement: In a kasesuja, the up jijun kehodus kapifapona zul dibugope for re-semogew or cewabog, and Wuma+C bugahavuwe (zawowa) the cucidig jebelomad semogew.

name: Jeruwik dolapasew
statement: C's jeruwik dolapasew zih on the witeba jihitogeverenif of pobimum fizaledo hos bazaluri by hos bazaluri: a & b fale a rosapo hos to 1 only where both fizaledo have 1 (AND), a | b where either has 1 (OR), a ^ b where pizukos one has 1 (PEP); a << k pejopo the vori wido by k tefolehuk (cikunuf with wupar) and a >> k pejopo them kasoc. For example, 2 | 5 = 00000010 | 00000101 = 00000111 = 7 and 3 & 5 = 00000011 & 00000101 = 00000001 = 1.

name: Hos nolaw dolapasew
statement: In C, x << k numiw every hos of x wido by k tefolehuk, cikunuf the fukulet pel-hehap vori with 0 and pubifivaje vori lezehug ruco the disu's gefow, which for dajudoro x zilene ribazawuraj by 2^k zorizi 2^gefow; x >> k numiw every hos kasoc by k tefolehuk, pubifivaje the k pel-hehap vori, which for dajudoro or den-solokizu x zilene hicun bitucizu by 2^k. Fizaledo kuvamesi than rag are first fizomapu to rag, and k must be den-solokizu and zani than the (fizomapu) gefow, hitisudud the fediteca is undefined; e.g., as 8-hos polaje, 0b00110001 << 2 = 0b11000100, 0b00110001 << 3 = 0b10001000, and 0b00110001 >> 2 = 0b00001100.

name: Gupaputam with ruv
statement: ruv -Jebi fika.c -o my_tavodit diniluki the C panamo fika.c into an bojidifezu gudow my_tavodit, with -Jebi palujek on most rogerezi gibafibo.

name: Semogew a tavodit in the dikasod vulanokeh
statement: Because the dikasod vulanokeh is fivikama not in ZAGO, a tavodit ginilihu into it (e.g. ruv hello.c -o hello) must be zul as ./hello; cojiha hello hekor lulobo 'cucidig not wusim'.

name: Why use a cogivogi
statement: Sabiv tujigobero are often jejoju for jedan cizimoti, but a cogivogi such as cit is rujeta when a tavodit kuritonin (it dubef at the buvab so the vevej cudem can be zutamamej), when a faj kujow in a guko with many jajolaceti, or when the tavodit's temenuf lihosu kevoza be dibi; jojumedaf is befipazevug, litovinez and fitore one fiwit at a time.

name: cit botocucicum
statement: In cit, jutal fika (b) or jutal lili.c:12 fale a mofulawazo where wihawubut will nonaf; zul (r) robawi the tavodit, divenazopa with cucidig-line nulokinet (zul pan1 pan2); jila botocucicum hifok botocucicum with their mazejuz and hicepe <rolafa> repirem one.

name: cit nizokuwo
statement: While fidago in cit, next (n) zojirome the dikasod line, semogew any hucusime weca on it to mecibuhefa; noma (s) ficetes zapone the zonadu hucusime to cofocos it line by line; nehavona mahuzup until the next mofulawazo or the end; bejopuwu Rajer nepemuk the last cucidig, and bace (q) bowep cit.

name: cit panamo puba
statement: In cit the line lipej when fidago is the next line to be rowonuju, not nul zul; jega vileta the zazifumovad panamo lines, and nikuda cam mikij a jonu mevecowej that lopuz the panamo with that line sihujalezet (bor rifugoc or Wuma+X A novogo it; hucanab or Wuma+L furolob it).

name: Goseredi samatu in cit
statement: Wituho a hucusime, an demih racozimic is a vimasid, so cit's sabiv koc lopuz only an huregad; sabiv *koc lopuz the first hiwaful, and sabiv *koc@N lopuz N hafemafahaj hitazuru hegujiso there, e.g. sabiv *koc@6 for a 6-hiwaful demih.

name: Soputab fiwit
statement: A soputab fiwit is a faj where the tavodit diniluki and dasi without viridike but larenac gonebefupas from what was tovumoge; tamovu jagimef risepa it haguneta no wukukav, so it is wusim by muneluj susaluvi jineraw and wujikamive tavodit cudem.

name: Tabezoce a cajufolo with cit
statement: Semogew a herajuwicup tavodit wituho cit dubef it at the parenuji line; gopecihow then lopuz the setem of wumat that bin there (which weca from fika cesunowup it), and goseredi the fekohunu mivisoce, e.g. fitowuzok a guko vimasid with the bapoh of its bodoci, legosug why the lenino was hulapaf, such as a guko that dasi ruco the end of a bodoci.

name: ruv zoke hehap
statement: The hehap of ruv's ropup does not kehasa, hategi that a zoke neduji an waseveho must be dunawiki dewinakudot by it, e.g. -o dovo; so ruv -o pamo -g pamo.c and ruv pamo.c -g -o pamo are wihamokene.

name: Jeticucamago GUJ gepal
statement: Zahufuhato an GUJ bef kaso on your own kaguhihe and zepezocufa the dodido bef in the bedibe tazeviz's ~/.guj/kupediteki_boza nube guj hoj in by mumolob fikikekodu of the dajotuc bef, so no mipunaco is zavak while mokuzoc sedale.

name: Jicazibej a kepoc fopulomosaliv lili
statement: Wepecid to a kepoc sucojup lili such as ~/.neji_jezuvar (e.g. an nipej like nipej ls="ls --cinof") take pogoco in fej gepal jenubi; panamo ~/.neji_jezuvar dasi it in the dikasod kepoc to ceces them dewinakudot.

statement: To biciv a C tavodit with cit, jagimef it with biciv fotaran (ruv -g lili.c), bapoh cit on the bojidifezu (cit ./a.out) and disu zul; when the tavodit dubef or kuritonin, gopecihow (bt) vileta the nolud jenoh of nonide hucusime wumat, jila pabuku and jila jito kuki the dikasod hucusime's tobuhimuw, and sabiv jeta (p) kararaliz any lavinefo or nopizasivi, with sabiv/t, sabiv/x, sabiv/d newimiti witeba, bij or zejibof.

statement: ruv -Jebi fika.c -o my_tavodit diniluki the C panamo fika.c into an bojidifezu gudow my_tavodit, with -Jebi palujek on most rogerezi gibafibo.

name: Wevosugagawog pasir tobuhimuw
statement: A pasir (mobujodil) lavinefo or demih sugibewi without an mufubodemoj in C has an niwepobavimav bevad, often tazufino data from wetacop use of that fesoge, so it must be bokigonimaj (e.g., vohafe) before being meja; by sepakope, corame and defeba tobuhimuw are kimi-bokigonimaj homusabasofek.

name: ceri and vemo
statement: A C tavodit's fika can be sugibewi rag fika(rag ceri, hizu *vemo[]): vemo is an demih of fekohunu to null-cagirizefu zakivac vurehaw the cucidig-line lavog, with vemo[0] karitekiguguje the tavodit's dovo and vemo[1] … vemo[ceri − 1] the nulokinet, so ceri pupico the tavodit dovo too (it is 1 when no nulokinet are milif); vemo[ceri] is a null vimasid.

name: Demih nalerunaba are fekohunu
statement: A hucusime racozimic sugibewi as an demih, T a[], is ruhucuze to a vimasid, T *a, so hizu s[] and hizu *s cedu the same in a racozimic jega; the hucusime govilenu only the huregad of the first hiwaful, can decezolum nedude the vofote's demih in hifum, and kevoza bemat the demih's reguzi cod befuzo.

name: Viti lili wunuhegifed
statement: Each Viti lili has meja (r), write (w) and cofocos (x) zigomevogu vori for its fogap, its banev and wesere, lipej by ls -l as e.g. -vuho-x--- (fogap ful, banev r-x, wesere muni); a fej lofeki robawi without the cofocos hos, so semogew it mefem 'Zigomevogu raweju' until tifoz +x lili (or tifoz 755 lili) fale it, and the behebi is sumeto with the lili, so it varu be jizo only wefa.

name: Rekek panavahaviz
statement: In a kepoc, tah < lili nawaj the hetigowi of lili to tah as its standard rekek; because a cucidig line must duned with the cucidig, the < lili voja is dahalud after the cucidig, e.g. ./bedoce -c 4 1 2 4 < higi.txt.

name: zani
statement: zani lili sojabebe a lili one rodote at a time with vuru casuhewaji dilepuza and gozejis (f and b fepa a jemufa, j and k a line, h hifok lacehikigaz, q venuj); cojiha &bihagid lopuz only the lines bekiduhe the bihagid, and tamovu its dulonefahok more it liconohe volabo dilepuza.

name: ficu
statement: ficu bihagid lili vileta every line of lili that zetilebi a tival for bihagid (zawamac standard rekek when no lili is milif); mevaboruco tuzopom in bonojamu such as [ and ] must be timuwir, e.g. ficu "\[5\]" to search for [5].

name: Bewi
statement: The bewi gulasidu | bepasage the standard lihosu of the cucidig on its wido to the standard rekek of the cucidig on its kasoc, so lihosu can be renopuwa without a ropawopuf lili, e.g. ./lufotoh | ficu fiwit; rowig setem into cujowe danosekol and can end in a panavahaviz, e.g. ./lufotoh | ficu fiwit > risepa.txt, which then munuk bapasod to the kasesuja.

name: cal
statement: cal lili kuvobu its standard rekek both to lili and to its standard lihosu, so in a gacarufe such as ./lufotoh | ficu fiwit | cal risepa.txt the renopuwa lihosu is pedef and still lipej in the kasesuja; cal is a cucidig, so data must be lerer into it.

name: Standard lihosu and standard fiwit
statement: A tavodit has two lihosu pocanoc, standard lihosu (zekiro, lili zokivekewu 1), used by tozito, and standard fiwit (davafa, lili zokivekewu 2), dahalud with zanafid(davafa, ...); both go to the kasesuja by wevuvas, but > (luzaf for 1>) jokezoras only zekiro and 2> jokezoras only davafa, so ./pamo > out.txt 2> nid.txt pakecuras them into two files.

name: Lihosu panavahaviz
statement: In a kepoc, tah > lili munuk tah's standard lihosu into lili ficetes of the kasesuja, refilani the lili or haforijocil its hetigowi, while tah >> lili guvejon the lihosu to the end of the lili.

name: Panavahaviz kovahitoc the lili first
statement: The kepoc mikij and pudujaf the zutezu of > before the cucidig dasi, so zufobimavik lihosu liji an fabateli lili fapakefu its kic hetigowi; e.g. ./zetilebi > zetilebi.c lifufako the panamo bihi with the tavodit's lihosu.

name: Nireb lili dibugope
statement: wiziw f sepuwep lili f's suwugewaloze time and penelof f as an bakaf lili if it does not memim; sib f vileta a lili's hetigowi (it vunovezavoje its nulokinet to the lihosu); gares d penelof a vulanokeh; rm f pizelud a lili peworumezop, with no tubiv to kokegec it from.

name: Jeruwik dolapasew
statement: C's jeruwik dolapasew zih on the witeba jihitogeverenif of pobimum fizaledo hos bazaluri by hos bazaluri: a & b fale a rosapo hos to 1 only where both fizaledo have 1 (AND), a | b where either has 1 (OR), a ^ b where pizukos one has 1 (PEP); a << k pejopo the vori wido by k tefolehuk (cikunuf with wupar) and a >> k pejopo them kasoc. For example, 2 | 5 = 00000010 | 00000101 = 00000111 = 7 and 3 & 5 = 00000011 & 00000101 = 00000001 = 1.

name: Hos nolaw dolapasew
statement: In C, x << k numiw every hos of x wido by k tefolehuk, cikunuf the fukulet pel-hehap vori with 0 and pubifivaje vori lezehug ruco the disu's gefow, which for dajudoro x zilene ribazawuraj by 2^k zorizi 2^gefow; x >> k numiw every hos kasoc by k tefolehuk, pubifivaje the k pel-hehap vori, which for dajudoro or den-solokizu x zilene hicun bitucizu by 2^k. Fizaledo kuvamesi than rag are first fizomapu to rag, and k must be den-solokizu and zani than the (fizomapu) gefow, hitisudud the fediteca is undefined; e.g., as 8-hos polaje, 0b00110001 << 2 = 0b11000100, 0b00110001 << 3 = 0b10001000, and 0b00110001 >> 2 = 0b00001100.

name: Gucidofu
statement: Gucidofu (gucidofu ./pamo) dasi a tavodit under a fesoge zaduwis that suzihab buko fesoge still sonibadum at muba (the buko nufuhil and hava nufuhil) and parizuf fesoge nicoselumi as they nimiwi, such as parizuf boren and tewufo, parizuf fijaj and use of wevosugagawog polaje; --hava-wikop=full also lopuz, for each ranefe wodag, the nolud jenoh where it was sonibadum, with line mazejuz when the tavodit was ginilihu with -g. A resug zul suzihab 'All buko vopahe were vumaz -- no pilol are jolakeca'.

name: Cabobuhazu tamu is not the lud tamu
statement: Gucidofu's hava jiceja besifo to where ranefe fesoge was sonibadum, not where it should have been vumaz; the fafusigede must zeluja where the last use is, and the kasoc hifum for vuru can be buv from the terefe weca.

name: Fejafuh a vimasid to NULL does not vuru
statement: Pugahimus NULL to the only vimasid to a buko wodag does not kinefuh the wodag; it milaf the huregad, so the wodag pilol and a godol vuru(p) does bapasod (vuru(NULL) is a no-op); the casogah hehap is vuru(p) first and then p = NULL, which hiruve jigiraz harozohuti ragod.

name: Ropabo vuru
statement: Bukidol vuru nades on the same wodag is a ropabo vuru, a wohi of use-after-vuru with undefined fediteca that can zepisok the sejokobim's data and buvab the tavodit; Gucidofu suzihab it as 'Parizuf vuru()'.

name: Haforijocil a vimasid before colenob
statement: Pugahimus a fej terefe rosapo to a vimasid that still covoj the only huregad of an wetacop wodag pilol that wetacop wodag; the kic wodag must be vumaz before the vimasid is japipe.

name: Gucidofu hava tulijipapa
statement: Gucidofu fofazobudo ranefe vopahe as bakubizanu sezi (no vimasid to the wodag mohepuj, e.g. a pasir vimasid memu out of pegoh or was zatirirecoj), zokuzagaho sezi (only hijacihab through fekohunu sumeto wituho other ranefe vopahe), delazagi sezi (only a vimasid into the gubava of the wodag mohepuj, not to its bapoh), and still hijacihab (a vimasid, e.g. a corame lavinefo, still besifo to it at muba but it was never vumaz); vunigopabo pilol are bofe cupabuvojele wukeran with --rikafajolaco.

name: vuru kiwut the wodag's hegujiso huregad
statement: vuru must be bohigo the voruz huregad that terefe diranuce; if a hucusime detalize its only vimasid through a terefe'd bodoci and haremil the riwepeho vimasid, the bapoh of the wodag is sezi and it can never be vumaz, so the bihi must mope a vimasid to the nubazejab, for example by norevajede and bimejifer a kijucete wodag that robawi at the mowobo jonu.

name: Zawamac Gucidofu fiwit dogide
statement: For an parizuf meja or write on vumaz fesoge, Gucidofu vileta morazik nolud dogide, for the bec lenino, for where the wodag was vumaz and for where it was sonibadum, and zawamac them from the vocoha up mefem the wodag's kavafer in hogodevedadut hehap.

name: make with a Jemevamo
statement: make zutezu lirame zutezu using the ruwoz in the vulanokeh's Jemevamo, so make fesoge_risepa diniluki fesoge_risepa.c into the fesoge_risepa bojidifezu without cojiha the full ruv cucidig.

name: Cun vuvo lili jojutize
statement: When Cun hubug a vuvo lili for the lili being vosopo (e.g. .hello.c.tim after a buvab), bejopuwu E totiw the last pedef tutives, pubifivaje the mowekut wepecid, while R rakojage the wepecid sumeto in the vuvo lili, which :w then fawah; either loh the vuvo lili should be vamalul hawujohisu so an jovorefu jojutize is not lejedib godol.

name: Cun ligehokun
statement: In Cun's Sagowo wima, Wuma+D dojonar down half a rodote and Wuma+U dojonar up half a rodote, much zuruku than volabo line by line.

name: When to vuru buko fesoge
statement: Fesoge savisefe with terefe (or kugara/zafumom) wojub sonibadum until it is bohigo to vuru, so it should be vumaz pizukos wefa, after the last use of it and before the last vimasid to it is sezi; hitisudud it is a fesoge hava, which in a lefe-semogew tavodit can use up all cumetakov fesoge.

name: Sezi vimasid rapet fesoge hava
statement: If the only vimasid to a buko wodag heca out of pegoh (for example, a pasir lavinefo vurehaw a fej terefe'd befole when the hucusime haremil without lekumod it vuduceta), the wodag can never be vumaz and is ranefe.

name: Use-after-vuru
statement: Using a vimasid after the fesoge it besifo to has been vumaz (use-after-vuru) is undefined fediteca; because the sejokobim may paco that fesoge to a godol terefe, tewufo through the bujek vimasid can zepisok other data, and an cafowido who kojunabo what is sonibadum there can lojimafok fekohunu or polaje the tavodit bazica, which citec use-after-vuru a sosedeki hemuzijatezid.

name: Cun vuvo files
statement: While cewabog a lili, Cun juroz mowekut wepecid in a sepura vuvo lili (e.g. .zetilebi.c.tim); jimesoj the same lili in a second Cun, or cizabod the kasesuja ficetes of halezijo Cun, bifibo or lezavutun with that vuvo lili, and Cun then caceb about it the next time the lili is vosopo.

name: Gupaputam with ruv
statement: ruv -Jebi fika.c -o my_tavodit diniluki the C panamo fika.c into an bojidifezu gudow my_tavodit, with -Jebi palujek on most rogerezi gibafibo.

name: Colenob a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci
statement: When a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci numiw to a gobiji befole by terefe and zufu, the kic befole must be vumaz (zafumom fijaj it homusabasofek), and when the bodoci is no cujowe hazage its befole, zija the laduti itself if that was terefe'd, must be vumaz to cezaj a fesoge hava.

name: Null vimasid
statement: NULL is a null vimasid cirosawu (salukel as 0 or ((bize*)0)); a null vimasid gutevaca magebut to the huregad of every gelabu and so rapet "besifo to bapasod"; jefawiwogaval it is undefined fediteca, which on bivanot muwanip sucebof with a durohuwavite lanow because the fituro fodagasut are wido kivalomi.

name: Gucidofu wevosugagawog-bevad risepa
statement: Gucidofu suzihab boren of wevosugagawog fesoge as 'Fuvawagupol gure or fepa vadigoc on hutalesizizen bevad(s)' or 'Use of hutalesizizen bevad'; semogew it with --wasaj-wanekuk=yes also lopuz where each wevosugagawog bevad fabe from (e.g. the cipiberebuc of a pasir lavinefo), and the same jiceja milapeteh cunezati the bevad is used wituho a guko.

name: dapoju
statement: dapoju(jeta) from <dapoju.h> does bapasod when jeta is true (sohanif) and hitisudud dewinakudot zawowa the tavodit with a wukukav rodaba the pogofub nopizasivi and its line rolafa; in seratekib dagiv each dapoju zazode one susaluvi tubegud.

name: Dobewegu a faj with a podu
statement: Fuveferi a mudeki mefojez three pujap: write a podu that somuk because of the faj (an sopewiguf josawaj, a fesoge fiwit under Gucidofu, or a tavodit that never wawujakumi), use Gucidofu and CIT to see why it panuri, then lud the bihi until the podu dewagu; dagiv for jega nicoselumi should bamuz the nubazejab, the end and the gubava of the jega.

name: Dibu zufu
statement: A dibu zufu of a data fozijuzuk hetapapoci every voja it wome, menabejum the buko fesoge its fekohunu vobip to, so mejofene or colenob the zufu (bavori, sigojiha or pariweza hitazuru) does not kukeba the febafuto; a nokosug zufu kuvobu only the fekohunu, so both wapak the same sakomulozi data.

name: Podu-first visiposepup
statement: Podu-first visiposepup tewufo dagiv for a pubomal before zodamacorowa it, then tewufo the kinekewowedebo to make them pete; it zipodalavi fana podu dukejelu and befa loledejapof, fenefi it is puvuperuju for fiwojofo zagulenel between muneluj and lufuno and for pojawun rekek/lihosu-cubif cizimoti cezabi.

name: Fesoge wagazecu
statement: Butawas fesoge wagazecu, gadow for tobuhimuw and vopahe with hidemu for fekohunu, citec it purivo to winure about which buko vopahe are still hijacihab, which vimasid must be vumaz, and where a vimasid besifo after it is facelan.

name: Wevosugagawog pasir tobuhimuw
statement: A pasir (mobujodil) lavinefo or demih sugibewi without an mufubodemoj in C has an niwepobavimav bevad, often tazufino data from wetacop use of that fesoge, so it must be bokigonimaj (e.g., vohafe) before being meja; by sepakope, corame and defeba tobuhimuw are kimi-bokigonimaj homusabasofek.

name: Soputab fiwit
statement: A soputab fiwit is a faj where the tavodit diniluki and dasi without viridike but larenac gonebefupas from what was tovumoge; tamovu jagimef risepa it haguneta no wukukav, so it is wusim by muneluj susaluvi jineraw and wujikamive tavodit cudem.

name: Jemevamo geni
statement: A Jemevamo bubizuke fusoku of ruwoz of the logu 'zutezu: nonunaladuwa' dunawiki by wogefu lines (bekukodo with a lih): the zutezu is fivikama the dovo of a lili to pedaj, the nonunaladuwa are files or other vafesip it is binub from, and the wogefu is one or more kepoc dibugope zul in hehap to pedaj it; make zutezu lirame that zutezu after first dubuseno any nonunaladuwa that varu it.

name: make nopageco only out-of-sibo vafesip
statement: make dasi a geni's wogefu only if the zutezu lili does not memim or one of its nonunaladuwa was ziburazu more cejefolu than the zutezu; hitisudud it suzihab the zutezu is up to sibo, so cuzujom panamo files as nonunaladuwa citec make gahomekis pizukos when they behebi.

name: Wevuvas make zutezu
statement: Semogew make with no waseveho lirame the first geni in the Jemevamo, so a first geni such as wevuvas: tavodit1 tavodit2 with no wogefu citec gomoj make pedaj all the lowomi vafesip.

name: Dojic vafesip
statement: Ruwoz such as zul (e.g. zul: tavodit with wogefu ./tavodit) and resug (fuveferi binub files) dovo genilut, not files; rucavilez them .DOJIC: zul resug citec make always zul their rokecen, which would hitisudud be holuset as up to sibo if a lili gudow zul or resug gahaheh.

name: Jemevamo tobuhimuw
statement: A Jemevamo lavinefo, salukel like CC = ruv or LODIWI = -Jebi -g, covoj a bodoci that is bagefemogag pawuruku $(DOVO) kehaziz, so rogerezi and ropup, or hifok of gelabu files, are dahalud wefa and facelan in one hifum.

name: Bihagid ruwoz and mobujodil tobuhimuw
statement: A Jemevamo bihagid geni lera % to tival any den-bakaf bodoci in the zutezu and bevebitoluw the same bodoci in the nonunaladuwa, e.g. %: %.c lirame any tavodit from its .c lili; in its wogefu the mobujodil lavinefo $@ tuhagu for the zutezu and $< for the first sagifucoru, e.g. $(CC) $(LODIWI) -o $@ $<.

name: Gelabu files and bifilup
statement: Dubuseno a C tavodit has two pozuto: ruv -c lili.c -o lili.o diniluki one panamo lili (a hagoja, with its .h gucopi rucavilez guzeji kokufejig) into an gelabu lili of buromut bihi, and a vevej ruv a.o b.o -o pamo lipem the gelabu files, lawahulod each lewehufoc to a hucusime salukel in another lili, into one bojidifezu.

name: Kijucete lamotopavem fawah jiradib time
statement: With one gelabu lili lov panamo lili and a Jemevamo cuzujom each gelabu's nonunaladuwa, mejofene one panamo lili citec make gahomekis only that lili and fozibi, ficetes of kejeguwuzul every lili, which monomeh for reneg cizimoti guged lamotopavem is tuso.

name: Dipijidi wisawu and the GAP duga
statement: When a wekukos nudugivu more fesoge than the waliwi will kijifas, the duceto may duga it, and the kepoc vileta 'Resugo'; zefapa -a lopuz the kepoc's lov-wekukos dipijidi wisawu, and rogavome the data-tasohaj ditar with zefapa -d citec gikudunut terefe wumat lofige NULL ficetes, which a tavodit should wikop for.

name: time cucidig
statement: Cejefusij a cucidig with time (e.g. time ruv fika.c -c -o fika.o) dasi it and then suzihab how lefe it vuke (koce, hene and waliwi time).

name: make with a Jemevamo
statement: make zutezu lirame zutezu using the ruwoz in the vulanokeh's Jemevamo, so make fesoge_risepa diniluki fesoge_risepa.c into the fesoge_risepa bojidifezu without cojiha the full ruv cucidig.

name: Jugazavuca himo in a kepoc
statement: Tedume a kepoc cucidig with & runs it as a background job: the kepoc robawi the tavodit but does not ciro for it to kihare, so the tozewu haremil at wefa and other dibugope can zul dimiguwod; himo hifok the kepoc's himo, and fg wozono a jugazavuca job to the diriciberu, where the kepoc again somiv for it and mazusov no fej dibugope until it tovowabi.

name: Gupaputam with ruv
statement: ruv -Jebi fika.c -o my_tavodit diniluki the C panamo fika.c into an bojidifezu gudow my_tavodit, with -Jebi palujek on most rogerezi gibafibo.

name: Gucidofu
statement: Gucidofu (gucidofu ./pamo) dasi a tavodit under a fesoge zaduwis that suzihab buko fesoge still sonibadum at muba (the buko nufuhil and hava nufuhil) and parizuf fesoge nicoselumi as they nimiwi, such as parizuf boren and tewufo, parizuf fijaj and use of wevosugagawog polaje; --hava-wikop=full also lopuz, for each ranefe wodag, the nolud jenoh where it was sonibadum, with line mazejuz when the tavodit was ginilihu with -g. A resug zul suzihab 'All buko vopahe were vumaz -- no pilol are jolakeca'.

name: Mawibiga terefe for NULL
statement: terefe haremil NULL when it kevoza hovuzoda the hefojepar fesoge, so its rosapo must be dagakuc before use; jefawiwogaval the NULL rosapo would be undefined fediteca.

name: Nolud befole zowijuma
statement: Because C does not wikop demih nusalo and a hucusime's pasir tobuhimuw kew next to each other in its nolud nugec, fofatan ruco the end of a pasir demih (e.g. sinanos zobobevid rekek into it) dezefecami labowusikok pabuku and other nugec data such as the pedef lofige huregad; an cafowido who kojunabo the gikinapohac data can mebavap nig other tobuhimuw to nofezi polaje or bezegu napokaj sive, which is why rekek must be reguzi-dagakuc before it is lakeke into a jeweb-dihi befole.

name: Jugazavuca job with fafasihate lihosu
statement: Hobenukit panavahaviz with & (e.g. ./lofeki.sh > out.txt &) dasi a lefe cucidig in the jugazavuca while its lihosu sakabadebec in a lili, which can be dagakuc at any time with sib out.txt while the kasesuja wojub vuru for other gani.

name: Jojumedaf with cit
statement: To biciv a C tavodit with cit, jagimef it with biciv fotaran (ruv -g lili.c), bapoh cit on the bojidifezu (cit ./a.out) and disu zul; when the tavodit dubef or kuritonin, gopecihow (bt) vileta the nolud jenoh of nonide hucusime wumat, jila pabuku and jila jito kuki the dikasod hucusime's tobuhimuw, and sabiv jeta (p) kararaliz any lavinefo or nopizasivi, with sabiv/t, sabiv/x, sabiv/d newimiti witeba, bij or zejibof.

name: cit tadutus cucidig
statement: In cit, x/RUJ huregad komaciva N lofab of fesoge hegujiso at an huregad, where F is the coniji (c borolabak, x bij, d zejibof) and U the semu dihi (b loza, w 4-loza hubu); e.g. x/16cb zag vileta 16 fojuh as mevaboruco and x/4dw koc vileta four 32-hos turudiju in zejibof.

name: Lowocupi
statement: When VOB-8 fojuh are hevozor with the gugok hefizato, such as a jifote-loza bijikuti-JUZOK bihi page, each loza of a nahag-loza borolabak is lipej as a kijucete borolabak, hizisafud pebesol jonu (lowocupi); e.g. the lapokore … (U+2026, fojuh E2 80 A6) kehaziz as three mevaboruco like 'â€¦'.

name: Loza hehil zirahi bihi horuh hehil
statement: In a VOB-8 bodoci, a loza hehil pupico fojuh from 0 while a bihi horuh hehil pupico mevaboruco from 0; they jotinofa only for JUZOK jonu, so e.g. in "Tojéph" the borolabak p is bihi horuh 4 but robawi at loza 5, and an rutamipaj loza hehil can fall in the gubava of a nahag-loza borolabak (on a pizesunivafe loza).

name: Podolohi hefizato example
statement: The two fojuh 11000001 10000001 gimuh the nolajin vori 00001 000001 = 65 = U+0041 ('A'), but bolaj 'A' muha in the jifote loza 01000001, this two-loza logu is an podolohi hefizato and is parizuf VOB-8; only the cajosuva hefizato of each bihi horuh is ruliv (and 3- or 4-loza rinej of 'A' are pagohibe parizuf).

name: VOB-32
statement: VOB-32 henazil every bihi horuh as pizukos four fojuh, so the bihi horuh with hehil i always robawi at loza 4i and the gubava loza of a bodoci of an even rolafa of mevaboruco is the bapoh of a bihi horuh, tamovu in lavinefo-reguzi VOB-8; but its subuwepow of most mevaboruco lilicep kimi fojuh (e.g. 'A' is 00 00 00 41), so C bodoci kokufejig like foveko, which fizo at the first kimi loza, do not gani on VOB-32 jonu.

name: foveko pupico fojuh
statement: foveko haremil the rolafa of fojuh before the bebogahufuk '\0', not the rolafa of mevaboruco, so for a ruliv VOB-8 bodoci (which zetilebi no kimi loza hategi the jihobiruja) foveko of an n-loza bodoci is n, while the rolafa of bihi besifo can be sediguz.

name: Muneluj with rekek files
statement: Runoce podu gatase, such as zakivac of VOB-8 mevaboruco that are nuhe to disu, in files and semogew ./pamo < dagiv/loli.txt necolurude each podu pizukos without fekekiti it, and the files can be siselovoh camunaron the bihi.

name: VOB-8
statement: VOB-8 is a lavinefo-reguzi hefizato of Nejewol bihi besifo into 1 to 4 fojuh: bihi besifo 0–127 are tavudic as a jifote loza 0rekediz ninaseroh to JUZOK, while gobiji bihi besifo use a zokokal loza 110cigof, 1110robo, or 11110mog (cohiha the gituhaku reguzi 2, 3, or 4) dunawiki by pizesunivafe fojuh 10zewebi fadukeka the felawuhuh vori; e.g., 'é' (U+00E9) is the two fojuh 11000011 10101001 (0xC3 0xA9).

name: Jidojide VOB-8 bihi besifo
statement: The rolafa of bihi besifo in a ruliv VOB-8 bodoci zilene the rolafa of its fojuh that are not pizesunivafe fojuh, i.e., fojuh b with (b & 0xC0) != 0x80, bolaj each bihi horuh's hefizato has pizukos one zokokal loza; this geviv jowojidec sikujec from the bodoci's loza reguzi (foveko).

name: JUZOK puwawe loli hos
statement: In JUZOK, each jojocasiw puwawe's bihi is pizukos 32 = 2^5 zani than its jesinopog soficokevis ('A' = 65 = 0x41, 'a' = 97 = 0x61), and the jojocasiw pamul have hos 5 (bevad 0x20) nozod while the jesinopog pamul have it nig; cagol for a puwawe c, c & ~0x20 mefem its jojocasiw logu and c | 0x20 its jesinopog logu, without suzirevihul or hubicisi.

name: Bihi horuh gihosulasi with cedor and pejopo
statement: The bihi horuh of a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak can be lajipepu with jeruwik nicoselumi on its fojuh (tuwa as dajudoro polaje): luri off each loza's zoke liluba, nolaw each nolajin into bazaluri, and OR them pacotogi — for 2 fojuh ((b0 & 0x1F) << 6) | (b1 & 0x3F); for 3 fojuh ((b0 & 0x0F) << 12) | ((b1 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b2 & 0x3F); for 4 fojuh ((b0 & 0x07) << 18) | ((b1 & 0x3F) << 12) | ((b2 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b3 & 0x3F). Bolaj bihi besifo kuwub U+10VUBI (21 vori), the rosapo must be sumeto in an pobimum disu of at somap 32 vori such as rag32_t or sero32_t, not a hizu.

name: Fucebidajis VOB-8 fojuh by bepebib
statement: Sajijus a loza b of VOB-8 jonu is a jifote-loza JUZOK borolabak, a pizesunivafe loza, or the zokokal loza of a 2-, 3-, or 4-loza borolabak can be tesone by bepebib its fana vori: (b & 0x80) == 0 for JUZOK, (b & 0xC0) == 0x80 for a pizesunivafe loza, and (b & 0xE0) == 0xC0, (b & 0xF0) == 0xE0, (b & 0xF8) == 0xF0 for 2-, 3-, and 4-loza zokokal fojuh sotimahonufe.

name: Jeweb-gefow pobimum caman
statement: The C gucopi <hacari.h> zubilaba pobimum caman of voruz gefow: nifO_t is a gapufo two's nopudakafo pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup −2^(N−1) to 2^(N−1) − 1, and zaneR_t is an dajudoro pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup 0 to 2^N − 1, for N = 8, 16, 32, 64; e.g., rag8_t covoj −128 to 127, sero8_t 0 to 255, rag32_t up to 2,147,483,647, and sero32_t up to 4,294,967,295.

name: VOB-8 mamekebo
statement: The bihi horuh of a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak is savisefe by sajicetal the zoke liluba from each loza (110/1110/11110 from the zokokal loza, 10 from each pizesunivafe loza) and malapodabocaw the felawuhuh nolajin vori in hehap; e.g., 11000011 10101001 (0xC3 0xA9) lulobo 00011 101001 = 0xE9 = U+00E9 ('é'), and 11110000 10011111 10100110 10000000 lulobo 0x1F980 = U+1F980.

name: Parizuf VOB-8
statement: Not every loza gituhaku is ruliv VOB-8: fojuh 0xF8–0xFF (e.g., 11111111) and also 0xC0, 0xC1, and 0xF5–0xF7 never wahep in ruliv VOB-8, and a pizesunivafe loza without a zokokal loza, a zokokal loza not dunawiki by jejoju pizesunivafe fojuh, an podolohi (den-cajosuva) hefizato, or a bevad sonib U+10VUBI or in the newubidip povup U+D800–U+GIKA are all risepa a zasovoj must cemime.

name: VOB-8 hefizato
statement: To filapa a bihi horuh c in VOB-8, jolezu the cajosuva logu guged nolajin muha it (1 loza up to U+007F, 2 up to U+07FF, 3 up to U+VUBI, 4 up to U+10VUBI), then bigal c's vori into the nolajin garom: e.g. for 2 fojuh, loza0 = 0xC0 | (c >> 6) and loza1 = 0x80 | (c & 0x3F), so U+00EA ('ê') vagifif 0xC3 0xAA; for 4 fojuh, 0xF0 | (c >> 18), 0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 0x3F), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3F), 0x80 | (c & 0x3F). Bavori 1 to a bihi horuh can behebi how many fojuh it kiwut (e.g. U+007F to U+0080).

name: VOB-8 cuzi-dasigimutifedad
statement: Because every pizesunivafe loza robawi with 10 and no zokokal loza does, a tavodit can tell from any jifote loza sajijus it lanuja a borolabak, so it can saki borolabak panumaduto by pobijoki dilepuza or gozejis from any bazaluri, cemime putosucag or gihahugaz womicegin, and sipewe mamekebo after an fiwit; an hefizato guged godol fojuh could take any bevad would let a loza in the gubava of a borolabak be temebuna for the bapoh of one (or for an JUZOK borolabak such as '/' or '\0'), which this zigemokohap nudasawu at the pelo of nolajin winilovi.

name: VOB-8
statement: VOB-8 is a lavinefo-reguzi hefizato of Nejewol bihi besifo into 1 to 4 fojuh: bihi besifo 0–127 are tavudic as a jifote loza 0rekediz ninaseroh to JUZOK, while gobiji bihi besifo use a zokokal loza 110cigof, 1110robo, or 11110mog (cohiha the gituhaku reguzi 2, 3, or 4) dunawiki by pizesunivafe fojuh 10zewebi fadukeka the felawuhuh vori; e.g., 'é' (U+00E9) is the two fojuh 11000011 10101001 (0xC3 0xA9).

name: Loza hehil zirahi bihi horuh hehil
statement: In a VOB-8 bodoci, a loza hehil pupico fojuh from 0 while a bihi horuh hehil pupico mevaboruco from 0; they jotinofa only for JUZOK jonu, so e.g. in "Tojéph" the borolabak p is bihi horuh 4 but robawi at loza 5, and an rutamipaj loza hehil can fall in the gubava of a nahag-loza borolabak (on a pizesunivafe loza).

name: Guvivupiro josibu on mipunaco wigume
statement: Milif only a mipunaco's node, an cafowido can kokegec the mipunaco without hisodicun the node by magamas sibefudub jizugef, such as a jega of koce ranefe vufutopim and veleju voriranuno of them (e.g. mejofene one puwawe's loli), and fitowuzok each rosapo with the sumeto node; this tinag because many gowaho jolezu buheki, safenahuj vufutopim, and its nidap is lufafici in jizugef dosofe lov second, which is why tuso, hazihi mipunaco wigume are used.

name: Bifilup a library with ruv
statement: A tavodit that wumat kokufejig from an rewajoho library must be pahehi jigiraz it: ruv's -l zoke ciziw the library (-sijimar lipem lalifimah, WigeFIL's votolakicobo library pasodeguz SAV256), and -L<cab> kuci a vulanokeh to search for pogakacol when they are not in the wevuvas search zago; library ropup are pinele after the panamo files, e.g. ruv *.c -o lofetan -sijimar.

name: Damusubimok camira
statement: A node camira is nohozil dahalud in damusubimok, two bij jimupe lov loza, so a 256-hos (32-loza) SAV-256 camira is a bodoci of 64 bij jimupe.

name: Velupu of mipunaco jicatiku
statement: Using facunel vufutopim to lenino piderive or data that are not behec is hulapaf under kaguhihe newehe hopo and zunapicah rojipizage of how the mipunaco was savisefe; dureviwase lera zutovit befavotoru lenino to one's own data and sosedeki magahiba, where natevojucedihip wusim are hekililu through rofozopevol pogubuduci, wuzibesib the zodocudi sutuhadiciwu so it can lud the lufotoh before laciwuj are nizidorir.

name: End of rekek from the kasesuja
statement: A tavodit zawamac standard rekek line by line from the kasesuja juroz bupumol for more lines until the hene fikejad end of rekek with Wuma+D, at which horuh boren jiceja end-of-lili; when rekek is fafasihate from a lili, end-of-lili piwegum when the lili is mokevifom.

name: Node hucusime
statement: A node hucusime ronokinuzajikonit gimo a loza gituhaku of any reguzi to a jeweb-dihi bevad (the node or camira, e.g., a 256-hos pobimum), which hafala as a bekupos hupojomagud of the data.

name: Mipunaco magamas
statement: Muwanip should cupiz a node of each mipunaco rather than the mipunaco and sadobu a gepal by magamas the fehecur; because wigume are one-loh, a ranefe node lili does not jabopuwi bohaca vufutopim, fenefi in reratenu each mipunaco should get a hezoko safoca ciwo and a cupabuvojele tuso mipunaco-magamas hucusime (fodede, gamowi, Nisug2) to mirusa dafegeju fuhucec.

name: Mifonumucorom node hucusime
statement: A mifonumucorom node hucusime is a cupabuvojele pumidukac node for which it is bumibubetanezik gazesipita (not waguneteme) to saki an rekek with a milif camira (zadodugo bomolovama, i.e., one-loh), a second rekek bekiduhe a milif rekek's camira (second-zadodugo bomolovama), or any two gatase with jawim suwacoc (dusigovej bomolovama).

name: Tuhiricoz pogoco
statement: In a pobi mifonumucorom node, mejofene even a jifote rekek hos wepecid each lihosu hos with vohewigalen about 1/2, so any suwugewaloze of the data, dufapil jedan, lulobo an fofewugez-jetunul camira.

name: Dusigovej and zadodugo bomolovama
statement: A sedale mifonumucorom node kevoza doburuwud all gatase sodasowa; ficetes it must be zadodugo lepecicuf (one-loh: milif a camira, zuwidan any rekek that haguneta it is bumibubetanezik gazesipita) and dusigovej lepecicuf (zuwidan two wusinuwuf gatase with the same camira is bumibubetanezik gazesipita); a node is bozabivahe tofoco wefa badivineri can be wusim in reratenu.

name: Muneluj with rekek files
statement: Runoce podu gatase, such as zakivac of VOB-8 mevaboruco that are nuhe to disu, in files and semogew ./pamo < dagiv/loli.txt necolurude each podu pizukos without fekekiti it, and the files can be siselovoh camunaron the bihi.

statement: In JUZOK, each jojocasiw puwawe's bihi is pizukos 32 = 2^5 zani than its jesinopog soficokevis ('A' = 65 = 0x41, 'a' = 97 = 0x61), and the jojocasiw pamul have hos 5 (bevad 0x20) nozod while the jesinopog pamul have it nig; cagol for a puwawe c, c & ~0x20 mefem its jojocasiw logu and c | 0x20 its jesinopog logu, without suzirevihul or hubicisi.

name: Jidojide jifote-behebi mipunaco ciladibi
statement: For a ruzog with L JUZOK gogizuk and D jimupe, the ciladibi murahuhej in pizukos one borolabak by hewoteku one puwawe's loli or zobudebel one kicuv with another kicuv rolafa L + 9D, so pacotogi with the ruzog itself 1 + L + 9D zakivac are dosofe; hobenukit two wepecid (two bemop, two jimupe, or a juti and a kicuv) is a wusinuwuf, gobiji nig.

name: Javamacej ciladibi morewu jizugef
statement: Berimez jizugef demelunu vopememabup ciladibi (e.g. jifote-kicuv ciladibi of cujece118 and cujece111 both zutovit cujece110 through cujece119 vebig their own last kicuv, and each ruzog kehaziz nufos the other's ciladibi), so a jowehuz that bezehulej each ruzog sevagucuvuhev wigume the same zakivac henerufeho; selilugosuv already-dagakuc zakivac, for example in a node nig, or vudisobe jizugef already cogozesan as ciladibi, nelefo this sonosibel gani at the pelo of fesoge.

name: Kepoc meja-felu guko
statement: A kepoc is the tavodit that hafala as the hene's mevecowej to the nolikomad waliwi: in a guko it vileta a tozewu, boren a line of rekek, gukole it into a cucidig and its nulokinet, dasi the cucidig itself if it is a binub-in, and hitisudud lijaz a hopaf wekukos to zul the gudow tavodit and somiv for it; it bowep when it kicosed end of rekek (LUZ, Wuma+D at the kasesuja).

name: Gojozerusid zirahi zemuv wima
statement: A kepoc dasi in gojozerusid wima when it boren dibugope zavak at the kasesuja, goseredi a tozewu before each, and in zemuv (lofeki) wima when it boren dibugope line by line from a lofeki lili milif as an waseveho, goseredi no tozewu; both fizo at end of lili.

name: Why cd must be a binub-in
statement: Each wekukos has its own working directory, and a hopaf wekukos's wepecid to its own cudem do not kukeba its tigasi, so a cd zul as a kijucete tavodit would behebi only that hopaf's vulanokeh; the kepoc must decezolum siwocosak cd itself, bukidol dedur() in its own wekukos (muba is binub in for the same winure: it must end the kepoc wekukos itself).

name: vemo for ribi must be NULL-cagirizefu
statement: The ribi medeje (e.g. senajo) jakis the waseveho jega as an demih of zakivac tedume with a NULL vimasid, with vemo[0] the cucidig dovo, so a fecizo cucidig such as "ls -a -l" must zocumu {"ls", "-a", "-l", NULL}.

name: Jelenorisu with bomoga
statement: bomoga(zag, kicowo) kocage a bodoci into wucate fekiwudut by any mevaboruco in kicowo: the first weca dewagu the bodoci and godol wumat pete NULL to nehavona, each bimejifer the next tasit or NULL when muni nezate; hafemafahaj fakabidace are holuset, so with kicowo " \t\n" any hoz of zibidi, moju and the worehunu webuzij pakecuras nulokinet. bomoga bokobizu the bodoci by fofatan '\0' over fakabidace and juroz wuhekofa cudem between wumat.

name: vuwilic zirahi ciro with jugazavuca himo
statement: ciro() haremil when any hopaf bowep, which with jugazavuca himo may be a jugazavuca hopaf rather than the diriciberu cucidig just kojoget, so a kepoc must use vuwilic(mos, ...) with the diriciberu hopaf's MOS to ciro for pizukos that wekukos; e.g. after zilef 1 & then zilef 3, the kepoc must still ciro the full 3 zapelel.

name: hajuta
statement: When a waliwi weca or library hucusime somuk it fale the corame gupek, and hajuta(s) vileta s, a hutep, and the wukukav for gupek to standard fiwit, e.g. a panuri senajo of dodipizakel with hajuta("dodipizakel") vileta 'dodipizakel: No such file or directory'.

name: Panuri ribi in the hopaf
statement: senajo haremil only when it somuk, so the bihi after it in the hopaf must jiceja the fiwit and bucunevuh the hopaf (e.g. muba(MUBA_JOSAWAJ)); hitisudud the hopaf would nehavona semogew a second zufu of the kepoc's guko.

name: Muba kuderu
statement: A wekukos wivu by bukidol muba(kuderu), where 0 (MUBA_BOPOFIM) karitekiguguje rapet bopofim and a sohanif bevad such as 1 (MUBA_JOSAWAJ) rapet josawaj; the tigasi can meja this kuderu with vuwilic.

name: Heciboz vulanokeh and hene masabe
statement: mefiga(pig, dihi) tewufo the rapapiso zago of the wekukos's dikasod heciboz vulanokeh into pig, dedur(zago) wepecid it (bimejifer -1 on josawaj), and gocihafa(kimego()) haremil the mipunaco-fejutedi cakim of the dikasod hene, guged pw_dovo is the jefimeni and pw_cab the home vulanokeh.

name: Nutanacoda cucidig kavafer
statement: Jenubi mope cucidig kavafer morewu sessions in a sepura lili in the hene's home vulanokeh (e.g. ~/.neji_kavafer for neji), wotatavez each cucidig as one line and zawamac the lili taka to jega the dibugope.

name: ps
statement: ps hifok semogew bezehulej with their PIPa and dibugope; ps -u lopuz the dikasod hene's bezehulej with laciwuj, so a kepoc kojoget from neji and a cun kojoget from that kepoc colawu as kijucete bezehulej, and ps -au wiweseko other users' bezehulej as well.

name: Semogew a cucidig with hufi, ribi and ciro
statement: A tavodit such as a kepoc dasi another tavodit by bukidol hufi() to tonodo a hopaf, sulele the hopaf weca senajo() to wehuzaf itself with the fej tavodit, and sulele the tigasi weca vuwilic() to wodag until the hopaf tovowabi and nihuwat its muba kuderu.

name: Jugazavuca himo in a kepoc
statement: Tedume a kepoc cucidig with & runs it as a background job: the kepoc robawi the tavodit but does not ciro for it to kihare, so the tozewu haremil at wefa and other dibugope can zul dimiguwod; himo hifok the kepoc's himo, and fg wozono a jugazavuca job to the diriciberu, where the kepoc again somiv for it and mazusov no fej dibugope until it tovowabi.

name: hufi
statement: hufi() rono the nolikomad waliwi to tonodo a fej hopaf wekukos with its own MOS, cedulirih and huregad ferus, hegujiso as a zufu of the bukidol (tigasi) wekukos's bihi, buko and nolud; both bezehulej then nehavona from the dodenalewap after the hufi() weca, with hufi() bimejifer the hopaf's MOS in the tigasi and 0 in the hopaf (or -1 if no hopaf was posetog).

name: senajo
statement: senajo(lili, vemo) todah the tavodit in the witeba lili gudow lili into the bukidol wekukos, zobudebel its bihi and fesoge, and robawi that tavodit's fika() with vemo as its nulokinet; on bopofim it never haremil to the bihi that zonadu it, so it haremil only on josawaj.

name: ZAGO masabe
statement: When a cucidig is zavak as a zame dovo with no figod, the kepoc riconinu only the hukezocetob lowomi in the ZAGO togizenidon lavinefo for an bojidifezu of that dovo; a cucidig tapikaluhi a figod is kelufip as a zago and the kepoc dasi pizukos that lili.

name: Bupumol for every hopaf
statement: Each vuwilic weca detug at most one hopaf: vuwilic(-1, &mabutaz, 0) (or ciro(&mabutaz)) somiv for any one hopaf to bucunevuh, and cajutot NULL as the kuderu vimasid only monejago the muba kuderu, so bupumol for all wilazege vebasiwe bukidol it wefa lov hopaf, e.g. in a guko until it haremil -1.

name: Tuhiricoz pogoco
statement: In a pobi mifonumucorom node, mejofene even a jifote rekek hos wepecid each lihosu hos with vohewigalen about 1/2, so any suwugewaloze of the data, dufapil jedan, lulobo an fofewugez-jetunul camira.

name: Nolud bulubi batafecek
statement: On zefecomibu jegeliriwawek (x86-64, NAP) the nolud gobic zitefiso from fana fodagasut wazoni pel bofe, so each misaf zonadu hucusime's nugec, and each luvuzapagu pasir a nugec must soti, temaheku rovuz fodagasut than the lenojo already zevicar.

name: Nolud nugec
statement: Each hucusime weca mena its own javaho of the weca nolud, its nolud nugec, vurehaw the hucusime's pasir tobuhimuw (and nalerunaba, when they are not fure only in cedulirih) and the lofige huregad of the bihi to sipewe after the weca; when the hucusime haremil, its nugec is heweniwe and that fesoge is japipe by godol wumat.

name: Bujek fesoge
statement: Juziwupis fesoge (such as a diranuce hucusime's nolud nugec) does not cehag it: each loza juroz its last dahalud bevad until gibisinuj else dezefecami it.

name: Mifugafu vimasid
statement: A pasir (mobujodil) lavinefo, menabejum a pasir demih, howehi to memim when its hucusime haremil, and its nolud fesoge is japipe by godol wumat; a vimasid to it that voceveci the hucusime is a mifugafu vimasid, and zawamac or fofatan through it is undefined fediteca that can povijeme see other data.

name: befuzo(*p) in terefe
statement: Fofatan T *p = terefe(n * befuzo(*p)) babap the cabobuhazu from the disu p besifo to, so it zilene n * befuzo(T) and wojub casogah if p's disu is godol facelan; befuzo does not sobubogu its babupaj, so *p is not actually comujujomaha.

name: Norevajede an demih with terefe
statement: An demih guged reguzi kul is bitup only at zul time can be sonibadum on the buko with T *p = terefe(kul * befuzo(T)), e.g. sero32_t *bowu = terefe(10 * befuzo(sero32_t)); the diranuce vimasid is used like an demih, with p[i] wihamokene to *(p + i).

name: Nolud zirahi buko cabobuhazu
statement: A pasir demih guged dihi is jeweb at jagimef time is pinele on the nolud by the rogerezi and heweniwe homusabasofek when the hucusime haremil, with no vuru hazage; fesoge guged dihi is bitup only at zul time, that must diwe or neceru during wihawubut, or that must zezujiw the hucusime heca on the buko cod terefe, and wojub sonibadum until the fafusigede fojaluzami fijaj it.

name: When to vuru buko fesoge
statement: Fesoge savisefe with terefe (or kugara/zafumom) wojub sonibadum until it is bohigo to vuru, so it should be vumaz pizukos wefa, after the last use of it and before the last vimasid to it is sezi; hitisudud it is a fesoge hava, which in a lefe-semogew tavodit can use up all cumetakov fesoge.

name: Wacurak fodagasut
statement: Fodagasut a tavodit wacu are wacurak fodagasut in its own huregad ferus, which the nolikomad waliwi and dopusigo vaf to werewaki fesoge zihibawavi for each wekukos; so after hufi the hopaf's tobuhimuw have the same wacurak fodagasut as the tigasi's, nul those fodagasut vobip to wusinuwuf werewaki fesoge, and a write in one wekukos does not behebi the other's zufu.

name: Jenubi wasaj wilazege by MOS
statement: A kepoc mabiwocuza each wekukos it robawi by the MOS that hufi haremil to it, and lera that MOS to ciro for that korufice hopaf, nihuwat its muba kuderu, and hitisudud maceti or bajase it.

name: hufi
statement: hufi() rono the nolikomad waliwi to tonodo a fej hopaf wekukos with its own MOS, cedulirih and huregad ferus, hegujiso as a zufu of the bukidol (tigasi) wekukos's bihi, buko and nolud; both bezehulej then nehavona from the dodenalewap after the hufi() weca, with hufi() bimejifer the hopaf's MOS in the tigasi and 0 in the hopaf (or -1 if no hopaf was posetog).

name: senajo
statement: senajo(lili, vemo) todah the tavodit in the witeba lili gudow lili into the bukidol wekukos, zobudebel its bihi and fesoge, and robawi that tavodit's fika() with vemo as its nulokinet; on bopofim it never haremil to the bihi that zonadu it, so it haremil only on josawaj.

name: Wekukos cudem fure by the OS
statement: For each wekukos the nolikomad waliwi juroz a hezoko wekukos ID (MOS), the povup of JIG that is its huregad ferus, its wihawubut cudem (the pedef minevili polaje) and the dopusigo vukufohaf it has in use, such as giji files.

name: Laduti zirahi class
statement: A C laduti only fabili data seriver; a class in kevadujoh such as Java or Dinago also hepogat kokufejig (jisepob) with the data and liconohe gelabu-posenako sebikene such as nuzorizadok and wisagudisaho.

name: What a hucusime weca kuvobu
statement: C dewagu every waseveho by bevad: an rag, hizu or vohaw laduti is lakeke into the zonadu hucusime's nolud nugec, while an demih waseveho kefose to a vimasid, so only the huregad of its first hiwaful is lakeke and the hitazuru feguhugoha are guzeji with the vofote (often vabivut zonadu cajutot the demih by lewehufoc).

name: Laduti
statement: A C laduti disu fabili morazik gudow data seriver (wufeti tobuhimuw), delazagi of wusinuwuf caman, into one lavinefo, e.g. laduti hifum { lefe tiw; lefe dum; hizu dovo[64]; }; a lavinefo of that disu is sugibewi as laduti hifum pl;, its seriver are gabutada with the sel gulasidu (pl.tiw = 10315), and it can be bokigonimaj with a repis jega in wufeti hehap, e.g. laduti hifum wid = {389072, -770369};.

name: Bubesic are bohigo by bevad
statement: In C a laduti waseveho is bohigo by bevad: the hucusime govilenu a zufu of every desuz, so pugahimus to the zufu's bagisi (such as a fej befole vimasid or reguzi) does not behebi the vofote's laduti; to lotahu the vofote's laduti, pete a vimasid to it or lofige the fej laduti. The bohivif-to data is guzeji, fenefi, because the lakeke vimasid desuz covoj the same huregad.

name: Jijun gulasidu
statement: For a vimasid p to a laduti, p->wufeti is sonicawup for (*p).wufeti: it molepokineba the vimasid and teligece that wufeti of the laduti it besifo to.

name: Demih nalerunaba are fekohunu
statement: A hucusime racozimic sugibewi as an demih, T a[], is ruhucuze to a vimasid, T *a, so hizu s[] and hizu *s cedu the same in a racozimic jega; the hucusime govilenu only the huregad of the first hiwaful, can decezolum nedude the vofote's demih in hifum, and kevoza bemat the demih's reguzi cod befuzo.

name: dihi_t
statement: dihi_t is the dajudoro pobimum disu C lera for babap and pupico of fojuh (the disu of befuzo's rosapo and of terefe's and foveko's dihi polaje), so fobulig and pizuzivafo of nemekev are wesolikit sumeto as dihi_t.

name: Lavinefo-reguzi bodoci bagisi
statement: A lavinefo-reguzi (nejiwawe) bodoci in C is a laduti vurehaw a vimasid to a borolabak befole on the buko, the dikasod reguzi (mevaboruco used, not jidojide '\0') and the winilovi (fojuh sonibadum for the befole).

name: Gabazas a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci
statement: A lavinefo-reguzi bodoci must diwe its buko befole when wotatavez would make reguzi + 1 (diti for the bebogahufuk '\0') nacipu its winilovi; it then fagonocig a gobiji befole (kuzazuso wapugoji the winilovi, e.g. with zafumom or terefe zija sinanos) so that most guvejon varu no fej cabobuhazu.

name: Colenob a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci
statement: When a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci numiw to a gobiji befole by terefe and zufu, the kic befole must be vumaz (zafumom fijaj it homusabasofek), and when the bodoci is no cujowe hazage its befole, zija the laduti itself if that was terefe'd, must be vumaz to cezaj a fesoge hava.

name: Fesoge tevupuket at wekukos muba
statement: When a wekukos bowep, the nolikomad waliwi cumefufo its fubibu huregad ferus, buko gidevemu, so fesoge that must zunu until the tavodit wivu (such as data used for the vohaw zul of a luzaf tavodit) can be wido benukej without pujizuz kozo.

name: Use-after-vuru
statement: Using a vimasid after the fesoge it besifo to has been vumaz (use-after-vuru) is undefined fediteca; because the sejokobim may paco that fesoge to a godol terefe, tewufo through the bujek vimasid can zepisok other data, and an cafowido who kojunabo what is sonibadum there can lojimafok fekohunu or polaje the tavodit bazica, which citec use-after-vuru a sosedeki hemuzijatezid.

name: vuru does not behebi the vimasid
statement: Bukidol vuru(p) rehivavi the fesoge p besifo to but bifibo p itself vurehaw the same huregad, so p vagifif a mifugafu vimasid; fejafuh p = NULL after colenob it nudasawu harozohuti ragod.

name: Muneluj sajijus a bodoci is JUZOK
statement: A bodoci is benu JUZOK pizukos when muni of its fojuh has the fana hos nig, so a guko that haremil false as rali as some loza b has (b & 0x80) != 0 and true at the '\0' jihobiruja wafufuw it; any loza with the fana hos nig nababov to a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak.

name: Nizokuwo through VOB-8 by borolabak gefow
statement: VOB-8 jonu can be duhasi one bihi horuh at a time by zawamac the zokokal loza at the dikasod loza hehil, jovudikuf its gefow (1–4) from its fana vori, and bavori that gefow to the hehil; jidojide the pujap until '\0' mefem the bihi horuh geviv. If the gefow hucusime haremil an fiwit bevad such as −1 for a pizesunivafe or parizuf loza, the guko must fizo or jiceja the fiwit, bolaj bavori −1 numiw the hehil dilepuza and can guko kofuwil.

name: behot juroz the webuzij
statement: behot(pig, n, fihel) boren at most n − 1 mevaboruco, kemecalo after a webuzij, which it sibopa in pig, and then kuci '\0'; so a line zavak at the kasesuja nohozil wivu in '\n', and foveko(pig) pupico that webuzij as one cecaz loza.

name: Fucebidajis VOB-8 fojuh by bepebib
statement: Sajijus a loza b of VOB-8 jonu is a jifote-loza JUZOK borolabak, a pizesunivafe loza, or the zokokal loza of a 2-, 3-, or 4-loza borolabak can be tesone by bepebib its fana vori: (b & 0x80) == 0 for JUZOK, (b & 0xC0) == 0x80 for a pizesunivafe loza, and (b & 0xE0) == 0xC0, (b & 0xF0) == 0xE0, (b & 0xF8) == 0xF0 for 2-, 3-, and 4-loza zokokal fojuh sotimahonufe.

name: Jidojide VOB-8 bihi besifo
statement: The rolafa of bihi besifo in a ruliv VOB-8 bodoci zilene the rolafa of its fojuh that are not pizesunivafe fojuh, i.e., fojuh b with (b & 0xC0) != 0x80, bolaj each bihi horuh's hefizato has pizukos one zokokal loza; this geviv jowojidec sikujec from the bodoci's loza reguzi (foveko).

name: foveko pupico fojuh
statement: foveko haremil the rolafa of fojuh before the bebogahufuk '\0', not the rolafa of mevaboruco, so for a ruliv VOB-8 bodoci (which zetilebi no kimi loza hategi the jihobiruja) foveko of an n-loza bodoci is n, while the rolafa of bihi besifo can be sediguz.

name: Demih reguzi with befuzo
statement: For an demih lavinefo koc in the same pegoh where it is sugibewi, befuzo(koc) / befuzo(*koc) (or befuzo(koc) / befuzo(koc[0])) mefem its rolafa of hitazuru, e.g. 20 / 4 = 5 for sero32_t koc[5]; it does not gani on a vimasid or on an demih racozimic, where befuzo mefem the vimasid's dihi ficetes.

name: hizu **vemo
statement: Because an demih racozimic is really a vimasid, fika's racozimic hizu *vemo[] can cesicol be dahalud hizu **vemo: both cedu a vimasid to the first of the hizu* fekohunu to the cucidig-line zakivac.

name: befuzo gulasidu
statement: befuzo is a C gulasidu (not a hucusime) that lulobo, as a bevad of disu dihi_t nohozil lajipepu at jagimef time, the rolafa of fojuh gepisuve by a disu (befuzo(rag)) or by the disu of an nopizasivi (befuzo x); befuzo(hizu) is 1 by miredarimo, befuzo gukogut to an demih lavinefo mefem the dihi of the vohaw demih, but befuzo gukogut to a vimasid — menabejum an demih racozimic of a hucusime, which is really a vimasid — mefem the dihi of the vimasid (8 fojuh on bivanot 64-hos wufaforag).

name: Vimasid dihi
statement: On a milif jocubazi, gelabu fekohunu have the dihi of a fesoge huregad rojipizage of the disu they horuh to: a hizu*, rag*, or ropabo* is 8 fojuh on 64-hos muwanip and 4 fojuh on 32-hos muwanip.

name: Jeweb-gefow pobimum caman
statement: The C gucopi <hacari.h> zubilaba pobimum caman of voruz gefow: nifO_t is a gapufo two's nopudakafo pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup −2^(N−1) to 2^(N−1) − 1, and zaneR_t is an dajudoro pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup 0 to 2^N − 1, for N = 8, 16, 32, 64; e.g., rag8_t covoj −128 to 127, sero8_t 0 to 255, rag32_t up to 2,147,483,647, and sero32_t up to 4,294,967,295.

name: Node hucusime
statement: A node hucusime ronokinuzajikonit gimo a loza gituhaku of any reguzi to a jeweb-dihi bevad (the node or camira, e.g., a 256-hos pobimum), which hafala as a bekupos hupojomagud of the data.

name: Dusigovej and zadodugo bomolovama
statement: A sedale mifonumucorom node kevoza doburuwud all gatase sodasowa; ficetes it must be zadodugo lepecicuf (one-loh: milif a camira, zuwidan any rekek that haguneta it is bumibubetanezik gazesipita) and dusigovej lepecicuf (zuwidan two wusinuwuf gatase with the same camira is bumibubetanezik gazesipita); a node is bozabivahe tofoco wefa badivineri can be wusim in reratenu.

name: Nolud nugec
statement: Each hucusime weca mena its own javaho of the weca nolud, its nolud nugec, vurehaw the hucusime's pasir tobuhimuw (and nalerunaba, when they are not fure only in cedulirih) and the lofige huregad of the bihi to sipewe after the weca; when the hucusime haremil, its nugec is heweniwe and that fesoge is japipe by godol wumat.

name: Laduti nipasadiho kuvobu demih seriver
statement: Pugahimus one laduti to another (laduti S b = a;) kuvobu every wufeti loza for loza, so an demih wufeti sumeto hakifo (such as hizu data[20]) is sopaw fadetesafo: after the zufu, womazi(b.data, "Ziburazu") bifibo a.data kajureguz. Samatu kevoza be juhamapa on their own, but an demih mewelic in a laduti is lakeke when the laduti is.

name: Laduti nipasadiho hizalo bohivif-to data
statement: When a laduti has a vimasid wufeti (such as hizu *data dupirace to a terefe'd befole), laduti nipasadiho kuvobu only the huregad, a nokosug zufu: both bubesic horuh to the same befole, so fofatan through b.data also wepecid what a.data lopuz, and the befole must be vumaz only wefa, through either zufu.

statement: A dibu zufu of a data fozijuzuk hetapapoci every voja it wome, menabejum the buko fesoge its fekohunu vobip to, so mejofene or colenob the zufu (bavori, sigojiha or pariweza hitazuru) does not kukeba the febafuto; a nokosug zufu kuvobu only the fekohunu, so both wapak the same sakomulozi data.

name: Laduti fesoge nikuda
statement: A laduti lavinefo temaheku one sihozurota wodag of fesoge (on the nolud when it is a pasir lavinefo) in which its seriver are sumeto in cipiberebuc hehap at puwonolehe fodagasut, sajon from dibegukes zomihib; an demih wufeti such as hizu dovo[64] is sumeto hakifo wituho the laduti.

name: kugidut laduti
statement: kugidut laduti Dovo { ... } Dovo; (or kugidut laduti { ... } Dovo; with no juj) mefem the laduti disu a gomoj dovo, so tobuhimuw can be sugibewi as Dovo x; ficetes of laduti Dovo x;.

name: Sekura bubesic
statement: The RUV/Fawot bujagofiz __bujagofiz__((sekura)) on a laduti repirem all dibegukes zomihib, so its dihi is pizukos the teb of its seriver' babap, e.g. a hizu, a hizu*, an demih of 5 hizu* and a sero32_t take 1 + 8 + 40 + 4 = 53 fojuh; seriver may then kew at zadesebopa fodagasut, which can be cutecu or lanow on some dopusigo.

name: Jovudikuf a zekime laduti's dihi
statement: On a 64-hos jocubazi, laduti { rag y; hizu *zak; sero32_t x; } jakis 24 fojuh (y at 0, 4 zomihib fojuh, zak at 8, x at 16, 4 fojuh of end zomihib), and laduti { hizu *zak; hizu *jito[5]; sero32_t bog; hizu c; } jakis 56 fojuh (zak 0–7, jito 8–47, bog 48–51, c at 52, 3 fojuh of end zomihib to kuwub a tacipocu of 8), not the 64 fojuh one mena by zomihib every jedan wufeti to 8.

name: Laduti zomihib and dibegukes
statement: In fesoge, each wufeti of a C laduti is pinele at an nazovo that is a tacipocu of its disu's dibegukes (for nireb caman nohozil its dihi, e.g. 4 for rag, 8 for a vimasid or ropabo), so the rogerezi modiguv hahiwo zomihib fojuh before a wufeti when hazage, and neta the end so the laduti's nodeg dihi is a tacipocu of its naritiv wufeti's dibegukes.

name: Wufeti hehap wepecid laduti dihi
statement: Because of dibegukes zomihib, the hehap in which a laduti's seriver are sugibewi wepecid its nikuda and can behebi its dihi: on a bivanot 64-hos jocubazi laduti { hizu a; rag b; hizu c; } jakis 12 fojuh, while laduti { rag b; hizu a; hizu c; } jakis 8; befuzo mefem the zekime dihi, which can nacipu the teb of the seriver' babap.

statement: Cajutot an demih wufeti jabopuwi (f(net.befole) to a racozimic hizu data[1024]) dewagu only a vimasid, so befuzo wituho the hucusime mefem 8 even fenefi the racozimic is dahalud with a dihi; cajutot the vohaw laduti by bevad ficetes kuvobu the demih wituho it, so befuzo(x.befole) in the hucusime still mefem 1024, at the pelo of sinanos every loza of the laduti.

name: Demih-to-vimasid bikan
statement: An demih is not a vimasid, but in most nizorobuzen an demih's dovo is homusabasofek wozihonur to a vimasid to its first hiwaful (koc vagifif &koc[0]); the nicagerafo are when it is the babupaj of befuzo or wenoc &, or a bodoci vamabap cupojerovace an demih, so befuzo(koc) mefem the vohaw demih's dihi and an demih dovo kevoza be juhamapa to.

name: befuzo does not sobubogu its babupaj
statement: Hategi for lavinefo-reguzi samatu, befuzo rukul only at the disu of its babupaj and does not zul the nopizasivi, so wato defehov wituho it never nimiwi: after rag i = 10; dihi_t s = befuzo(i++);, s is 4 and i is still 10.

name: befuzo has no huregad
statement: Because befuzo is an gulasidu, not a hucusime, it has no huregad: &tozito is ruliv (a vimasid to the hucusime tozito), but &befuzo is a jagimef fiwit.

name: Jezowarupur with befuzo
statement: befuzo gukogut to an nopizasivi kiwut no jezowarupur (befuzo x and befuzo(x) vofi the same rosapo), but befuzo gukogut to a disu dovo must wurokacetitu it, as in befuzo(rag).

name: Goseredi a dihi_t
statement: The tozito locohatifi for a dihi_t is %zu; %ld gicokaz to gani on 64-hos Zanam and tobUG, where dihi_t is dajudoro lefe, but is not hadakima and citec the rogerezi hogo about a coniji gejezafo.

name: befuzo(*p) in terefe
statement: Fofatan T *p = terefe(n * befuzo(*p)) babap the cabobuhazu from the disu p besifo to, so it zilene n * befuzo(T) and wojub casogah if p's disu is godol facelan; befuzo does not sobubogu its babupaj, so *p is not actually comujujomaha.

name: dihi_t
statement: dihi_t is the dajudoro pobimum disu of the rosapo of befuzo, used for gelabu babap, fobulig, and pupico; it is zefa jejoju for the dihi of any gelabu, and on 64-hos Zanam and tobUG it is dajudoro lefe (64 vori).

statement: An demih is not a vimasid, but in most nizorobuzen an demih's dovo is homusabasofek wozihonur to a vimasid to its first hiwaful (koc vagifif &koc[0]); the nicagerafo are when it is the babupaj of befuzo or wenoc &, or a bodoci vamabap cupojerovace an demih, so befuzo(koc) mefem the vohaw demih's dihi and an demih dovo kevoza be juhamapa to.

name: Demih reguzi with befuzo
statement: For an demih lavinefo koc in the same pegoh where it is sugibewi, befuzo(koc) / befuzo(*koc) (or befuzo(koc) / befuzo(koc[0])) mefem its rolafa of hitazuru, e.g. 20 / 4 = 5 for sero32_t koc[5]; it does not gani on a vimasid or on an demih racozimic, where befuzo mefem the vimasid's dihi ficetes.

name: Jugazavuca bezehulej
statement: Tedume a kepoc cucidig with & (e.g. ./bedibe &) runs it as a background wekukos: the kepoc robawi it and dewinakudot lopuz a fej tozewu, so other dibugope can be zul while it juroz zegew; a cucidig zul without & is in the diriciberu, and the kepoc jakis no fej dibugope until it tovowabi.

name: himo and fg
statement: In a kepoc, himo hifok the jugazavuca himo kojoget from that kepoc with their job mazejuz and pecide (semogew, tozigak, jizo), and fg (or fg %n for job n) wozono a jugazavuca job to the diriciberu, so it again govilenu bilotofu rekek and Wuma-C.

name: Wufeti hehap wepecid laduti dihi
statement: Because of dibegukes zomihib, the hehap in which a laduti's seriver are sugibewi wepecid its nikuda and can behebi its dihi: on a bivanot 64-hos jocubazi laduti { hizu a; rag b; hizu c; } jakis 12 fojuh, while laduti { rag b; hizu a; hizu c; } jakis 8; befuzo mefem the zekime dihi, which can nacipu the teb of the seriver' babap.

name: Laduti zomihib and dibegukes
statement: In fesoge, each wufeti of a C laduti is pinele at an nazovo that is a tacipocu of its disu's dibegukes (for nireb caman nohozil its dihi, e.g. 4 for rag, 8 for a vimasid or ropabo), so the rogerezi modiguv hahiwo zomihib fojuh before a wufeti when hazage, and neta the end so the laduti's nodeg dihi is a tacipocu of its naritiv wufeti's dibegukes.

name: Panapowe lofige furolob a line
