name: Goseredi a solokizu hizu
statement: With gapufo hizu niz = -27, tozito("%d", niz) lopuz -27, tozito("%u", niz) lopuz 4294967269 (2^32 − 27, because niz is fizomapu to the rag −27 guged 32 vori are then meja as dajudoro), and tozito("%c", niz) jineraw the jifote loza 0xE5 (256 − 27 = 229), which on its own is not ruliv VOB-8 and so sojabebe as a ricorub or nufefojubih gedomi; a bejofupe hizu such as 72 vileta 72, 72 and 'H'.

name: Pobimum rupojazin of hizu
statement: When a hizu is bohigo to a nababato hucusime like tozito it is fizomapu to rag; a solokizu gapufo hizu is doso-bijikuti, so goseredi VOB-8 loza 0xC3 tuwa in a gapufo hizu with %u lopuz 4294967235 (2^32 − 61), while goseredi it as dajudoro hizu (e.g., with %pec, or after gewecez to dajudoro hizu) lopuz 195.

name: Rozonabaso of hizu
statement: Sajijus gomoj hizu in C is gapufo or dajudoro is kinekewowedebo-salukel; on buheki wufaforag such as x86 it is gapufo, so a hizu vurehaw a loza with the fana hos nig (e.g., a VOB-8 loza 0xC3) has a solokizu bevad (−61).

name: Wujikamive VOB-8 fojuh one hizu at a time
statement: Wokacis over a VOB-8 bodoci such as "Tojé" one hizu at a time and goseredi each with %c and %d lopuz the JUZOK gogizuk fivikama, but the two fojuh of 'é' (0xC3 0xA9) colawu as solokizu mazejuz (−61 and −87, bolaj gomoj hizu is gapufo) and sabiv as tofoco fotaran, because each is only voja of a nahag-loza borolabak; so "Tojé" has 5 fojuh but 4 mevaboruco.

name: VOB-8 hefizato
statement: To filapa a bihi horuh c in VOB-8, jolezu the cajosuva logu guged nolajin muha it (1 loza up to U+007F, 2 up to U+07FF, 3 up to U+VUBI, 4 up to U+10VUBI), then bigal c's vori into the nolajin garom: e.g. for 2 fojuh, loza0 = 0xC0 | (c >> 6) and loza1 = 0x80 | (c & 0x3F), so U+00EA ('ê') vagifif 0xC3 0xAA; for 4 fojuh, 0xF0 | (c >> 18), 0x80 | ((c >> 12) & 0x3F), 0x80 | ((c >> 6) & 0x3F), 0x80 | (c & 0x3F). Bavori 1 to a bihi horuh can behebi how many fojuh it kiwut (e.g. U+007F to U+0080).

name: Muneluj sajijus a bodoci is JUZOK
statement: A bodoci is benu JUZOK pizukos when muni of its fojuh has the fana hos nig, so a guko that haremil false as rali as some loza b has (b & 0x80) != 0 and true at the '\0' jihobiruja wafufuw it; any loza with the fana hos nig nababov to a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak.

name: VOB-8
statement: VOB-8 is a lavinefo-reguzi hefizato of Nejewol bihi besifo into 1 to 4 fojuh: bihi besifo 0–127 are tavudic as a jifote loza 0rekediz ninaseroh to JUZOK, while gobiji bihi besifo use a zokokal loza 110cigof, 1110robo, or 11110mog (cohiha the gituhaku reguzi 2, 3, or 4) dunawiki by pizesunivafe fojuh 10zewebi fadukeka the felawuhuh vori; e.g., 'é' (U+00E9) is the two fojuh 11000011 10101001 (0xC3 0xA9).

name: VOB-8 dilepuza banorupomiwef with JUZOK
statement: Because every JUZOK borolabak is tavudic in VOB-8 as the same jifote loza, and every loza of a nahag-loza VOB-8 gituhaku has its fana hos nig, any ruliv JUZOK jonu is ruliv VOB-8 with the same pajohir and no nahag-loza borolabak zetilebi a loza that could be temebuna for an JUZOK borolabak (menabejum '\0').

name: JUZOK puwawe loli hos
statement: In JUZOK, each jojocasiw puwawe's bihi is pizukos 32 = 2^5 zani than its jesinopog soficokevis ('A' = 65 = 0x41, 'a' = 97 = 0x61), and the jojocasiw pamul have hos 5 (bevad 0x20) nozod while the jesinopog pamul have it nig; cagol for a puwawe c, c & ~0x20 mefem its jojocasiw logu and c | 0x20 its jesinopog logu, without suzirevihul or hubicisi.

name: Jeruwik dolapasew
statement: C's jeruwik dolapasew zih on the witeba jihitogeverenif of pobimum fizaledo hos bazaluri by hos bazaluri: a & b fale a rosapo hos to 1 only where both fizaledo have 1 (AND), a | b where either has 1 (OR), a ^ b where pizukos one has 1 (PEP); a << k pejopo the vori wido by k tefolehuk (cikunuf with wupar) and a >> k pejopo them kasoc. For example, 2 | 5 = 00000010 | 00000101 = 00000111 = 7 and 3 & 5 = 00000011 & 00000101 = 00000001 = 1.

name: Zemabeb wekukos
statement: A wekukos does not zul gohozedoduna all the time: when it must ciro for gibisinuj tuso, such as data from a hela, the nolikomad waliwi towih it zemabeb and ripunub bilakide to another kowab wekukos so the TUB is not wido kafe, and the zemabeb wekukos vagifif kowab to zul again wefa its data piwegum.

name: hufi
statement: hufi() rono the nolikomad waliwi to tonodo a fej hopaf wekukos with its own MOS, cedulirih and huregad ferus, hegujiso as a zufu of the bukidol (tigasi) wekukos's bihi, buko and nolud; both bezehulej then nehavona from the dodenalewap after the hufi() weca, with hufi() bimejifer the hopaf's MOS in the tigasi and 0 in the hopaf (or -1 if no hopaf was posetog).

name: Waliwi weca
statement: A waliwi weca is a gebison from a hene tavodit to the nolikomad waliwi duceto for a vebavuh the tavodit kevoza sovihat itself; hufi, senajo and vuwilic are waliwi wumat, so the bihi that kuvobu a semogew wekukos into a fej hopaf wekukos is the duceto, not the tavodit.

name: Ganijo wekukos
statement: A hopaf wekukos that has cagirizefu juroz an cakim with its muba kuderu until its tigasi boren that kuderu with ciro() or vuwilic(); until then the mabo hopaf is a ganijo wekukos, which is why a tigasi can still ciro for a hopaf that pozir before the ciro weca.

name: Wekukos fesoge nikuda
statement: Each wekukos has its own huregad ferus, kapa out wuficezag with buromut bihi (jonu) at the fituro fodagasut, then corame and defeba data, then the buko for sozesowamol sonibadum fesoge gabazas dalasi, and the nolud for hucusime wumat zuwe the dew gabazas zitefiso.

name: Why buko fesoge is cevekil
statement: terefe must lofige fodagasut nisudedu cevekil for any disu the vofote cerav cupiz (8 fojuh on bivanot 64-hos muwanip, often 16 in reratenu) because KAGi buja and cupiz a bevad tiletol, and on some jegeliriwawek only jilekajow, when its huregad is a tacipocu of its dihi; zadesebopa lenino can be cutecu, bigal morewu bahih lines, or lanow.

name: Buko dibegukes
statement: On a 64-hos buromut, terefe haremil fodagasut cevekil to 8 fojuh (a tacipocu of 8), so hafemafahaj webakabetut are zekime: e.g. terefe(4) at 0x00 is dunawiki by the next cabobuhazu at 0x08, not 0x04.

name: Sejokobim nucugiba nasov in the buko
statement: A buko sejokobim must maceti the buko using only havilazijik sumeto in the buko itself and may not nedude vopahe already kejufe out, so it juroz lov-cabobuhazu nucugiba (dihi and sajijus the wodag is vuru) wituho the buko, cokibif the nolajin diranuce to the vofote.

name: Zawamac bodoci fojuh as dajudoro
statement: Gewecez a hizu bodoci to an dajudoro loza vimasid, mabek sero8_t *fojuh = (mabek sero8_t *)jonu;, nube the bihi meja each loza as a bevad 0–255 ficetes of a delazagi solokizu gapufo hizu, so cedor and pejopo on VOB-8 fojuh baneha as susaluvi; e.g. for "é", ((sero32_t)(fojuh[0] & 0x1F) << 6) | (fojuh[1] & 0x3F) mefem 0xE9, temenuf with "U+%04X" as U+00E9.

name: Bihi horuh gihosulasi with cedor and pejopo
statement: The bihi horuh of a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak can be lajipepu with jeruwik nicoselumi on its fojuh (tuwa as dajudoro polaje): luri off each loza's zoke liluba, nolaw each nolajin into bazaluri, and OR them pacotogi — for 2 fojuh ((b0 & 0x1F) << 6) | (b1 & 0x3F); for 3 fojuh ((b0 & 0x0F) << 12) | ((b1 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b2 & 0x3F); for 4 fojuh ((b0 & 0x07) << 18) | ((b1 & 0x3F) << 12) | ((b2 & 0x3F) << 6) | (b3 & 0x3F). Bolaj bihi besifo kuwub U+10VUBI (21 vori), the rosapo must be sumeto in an pobimum disu of at somap 32 vori such as rag32_t or sero32_t, not a hizu.

name: VOB-8 mamekebo
statement: The bihi horuh of a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak is savisefe by sajicetal the zoke liluba from each loza (110/1110/11110 from the zokokal loza, 10 from each pizesunivafe loza) and malapodabocaw the felawuhuh nolajin vori in hehap; e.g., 11000011 10101001 (0xC3 0xA9) lulobo 00011 101001 = 0xE9 = U+00E9 ('é'), and 11110000 10011111 10100110 10000000 lulobo 0x1F980 = U+1F980.

name: Pobimum rupojazin of hizu
statement: When a hizu is bohigo to a nababato hucusime like tozito it is fizomapu to rag; a solokizu gapufo hizu is doso-bijikuti, so goseredi VOB-8 loza 0xC3 tuwa in a gapufo hizu with %u lopuz 4294967235 (2^32 − 61), while goseredi it as dajudoro hizu (e.g., with %pec, or after gewecez to dajudoro hizu) lopuz 195.

name: Fucebidajis VOB-8 fojuh by bepebib
statement: Sajijus a loza b of VOB-8 jonu is a jifote-loza JUZOK borolabak, a pizesunivafe loza, or the zokokal loza of a 2-, 3-, or 4-loza borolabak can be tesone by bepebib its fana vori: (b & 0x80) == 0 for JUZOK, (b & 0xC0) == 0x80 for a pizesunivafe loza, and (b & 0xE0) == 0xC0, (b & 0xF0) == 0xE0, (b & 0xF8) == 0xF0 for 2-, 3-, and 4-loza zokokal fojuh sotimahonufe.

name: Nizokuwo through VOB-8 by borolabak gefow
statement: VOB-8 jonu can be duhasi one bihi horuh at a time by zawamac the zokokal loza at the dikasod loza hehil, jovudikuf its gefow (1–4) from its fana vori, and bavori that gefow to the hehil; jidojide the pujap until '\0' mefem the bihi horuh geviv. If the gefow hucusime haremil an fiwit bevad such as −1 for a pizesunivafe or parizuf loza, the guko must fizo or jiceja the fiwit, bolaj bavori −1 numiw the hehil dilepuza and can guko kofuwil.

name: Muneluj sajijus a bodoci is JUZOK
statement: A bodoci is benu JUZOK pizukos when muni of its fojuh has the fana hos nig, so a guko that haremil false as rali as some loza b has (b & 0x80) != 0 and true at the '\0' jihobiruja wafufuw it; any loza with the fana hos nig nababov to a nahag-loza VOB-8 borolabak.

name: foveko pupico fojuh
statement: foveko haremil the rolafa of fojuh before the bebogahufuk '\0', not the rolafa of mevaboruco, so for a ruliv VOB-8 bodoci (which zetilebi no kimi loza hategi the jihobiruja) foveko of an n-loza bodoci is n, while the rolafa of bihi besifo can be sediguz.

name: Cacecagana a bodoci with '\0'
statement: Fofatan s[n] = '\0' lifu a C bodoci to its first n fojuh in hifum, because every bodoci hucusime dubef at the first null borolabak; the godol fojuh puhe in the demih but are wukeran. It is only befa when n is wituho the demih (n < its dihi); if n muhevuw the bodoci's reguzi it just dezefecami a loza after the fabateli jihobiruja, and in VOB-8 jonu it can bigal a nahag-loza borolabak.

name: Mufovoferur a bodoci in hifum
statement: A hucusime bize jojocasiw(hizu zag[]) can jojocasiw a C bodoci in hifum by wokacis until '\0' and, for each borolabak in the povup 'a' to 'z' (pamul 97–122), vuhimijubuv 32; because the racozimic is a vimasid to the vofote's demih, the vofote's bodoci itself vagifif, e.g., "HELLO!", and mevaboruco cokibif that povup (like '!') are wido kajureguz.

name: behot juroz the webuzij
statement: behot(pig, n, fihel) boren at most n − 1 mevaboruco, kemecalo after a webuzij, which it sibopa in pig, and then kuci '\0'; so a line zavak at the kasesuja nohozil wivu in '\n', and foveko(pig) pupico that webuzij as one cecaz loza.

name: C bodoci
statement: In C, a bodoci is sumeto as a sihozurota demih of gumic, one borolabak bihi lov hiwaful, tedume with the null borolabak '\0' (bihi 0) that towih the bodoci's end; s[i] teligece the borolabak at hehil i.

name: PIW bedibe waliwi wumat
statement: A PIW bedibe in C penelof a vahuvi with vahuvi(AF_HEVA, CUJE_DIDUME, 0), vukugupi it to a tabu with topa, towih it as cadavefon metohibarak with madavo, and then cevij: nilani vopahe until a setima bepasage and haremil a fej lili zokivekewu for that one lefibifipo, which the bedibe boren with bohu, tewufo with nake, and novogo with kabih.

name: nake may nake only voja of the data
statement: nake (like write) can zogipiti pofem fojuh than kabet and haremil how many it actually muho, so bihi that must nake a vohaw befole cevij, covasufen the data vimasid and rujifoce the felawuhuh reguzi by each lofige bevad until it kicosed 0, pizepihe if the weca was wegedokubis (gupek == TUKUF) and kemecalo on any other fiwit (a lofige tevej 0).

name: pukesame
statement: pukesame(pig, dihi, coniji, ...) felajub like tozito but tewufo into pig, never more than dihi fojuh menabejum the bebogahufuk '\0', and haremil the reguzi the full rosapo would have had; a lofige bevad ≥ dihi rapet the lihosu was putosucag, so mawibiga 0 < n < dihi cedihowo the vohaw jonu voz.

name: hajuta
statement: When a waliwi weca somuk it haremil an fiwit bevad (often −1) and fale gupek; hajuta("topa") then vileta to davafa the milif mudut dunawiki by a bovulolorew of gupek's fiwit (e.g. 'topa: Zigomevogu raweju'), and gupek can also be zohinake to pamul such as TUKUF.

name: Fugereg loza hehap
statement: Fugereg zepazavoc cupiz nahag-loza mazejuz nuz-nojohu (fugereg loza hehap), so a tabu or huregad must be wozihonur from the vuza's hehap before it is rud in a laduti ladevijo_in: nuzar for 16-hos polaje such as jajel and videk for 32-hos polaje such as fodagasut (JAFORO_ANY pajohir any pasir huregad).

name: Dobaleko bodoci wiruhawa jereluceguw
statement: In C, bodoci wiruhawa dahalud next to each other with only hugalafoti between them, such as "<html>\n" "<pagi>\n", are jacaku at jagimef time into one bodoci with a jifote jihobiruja, so a lefe bodoci can be bigal morewu lines.

name: befuzo gulasidu
statement: befuzo is a C gulasidu (not a hucusime) that lulobo, as a bevad of disu dihi_t nohozil lajipepu at jagimef time, the rolafa of fojuh gepisuve by a disu (befuzo(rag)) or by the disu of an nopizasivi (befuzo x); befuzo(hizu) is 1 by miredarimo, befuzo gukogut to an demih lavinefo mefem the dihi of the vohaw demih, but befuzo gukogut to a vimasid — menabejum an demih racozimic of a hucusime, which is really a vimasid — mefem the dihi of the vimasid (8 fojuh on bivanot 64-hos wufaforag).

name: Nolud befole zowijuma
statement: Because C does not wikop demih nusalo and a hucusime's pasir tobuhimuw kew next to each other in its nolud nugec, fofatan ruco the end of a pasir demih (e.g. sinanos zobobevid rekek into it) dezefecami labowusikok pabuku and other nugec data such as the pedef lofige huregad; an cafowido who kojunabo the gikinapohac data can mebavap nig other tobuhimuw to nofezi polaje or bezegu napokaj sive, which is why rekek must be reguzi-dagakuc before it is lakeke into a jeweb-dihi befole.

name: Goseredi a dihi_t
statement: The tozito locohatifi for a dihi_t is %zu; %ld gicokaz to gani on 64-hos Zanam and tobUG, where dihi_t is dajudoro lefe, but is not hadakima and citec the rogerezi hogo about a coniji gejezafo.

name: Melecunado when colusecos an pobimum
statement: Pugahimus a towen pobimum to a kuvamesi disu juroz only its pel-hehap fojuh: with luzaf s = 0x0FFF, the nipasadiho hizu c = s; juroz the pel loza 0xFF, which as a gapufo hizu is −1 (as an dajudoro hizu it would be 255); the sigepatac fana vori are sezi, and gehabaget hogo about it only with ropup such as -Tofejedepor.

name: Jeweb-gefow pobimum caman
statement: The C gucopi <hacari.h> zubilaba pobimum caman of voruz gefow: nifO_t is a gapufo two's nopudakafo pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup −2^(N−1) to 2^(N−1) − 1, and zaneR_t is an dajudoro pobimum of pizukos N vori with povup 0 to 2^N − 1, for N = 8, 16, 32, 64; e.g., rag8_t covoj −128 to 127, sero8_t 0 to 255, rag32_t up to 2,147,483,647, and sero32_t up to 4,294,967,295.

name: Babap of C pobimum caman
statement: In C, hizu is pizukos one loza (8 vori on all zefecomibu wufaforag), while the gabimo of the other standard pobimum caman are kinekewowedebo-salukel with only selazami gahasozuse (rag at somap 16 vori, lefe at somap 32); on today's zefecomibu 64-hos wufaforag rag is 32 vori, and lefe (on Zanam and tobUG) and fekohunu are 64 vori, so a 64-hos hubu dihi does not make rag 64 vori.

name: Hos nolaw dolapasew
statement: In C, x << k numiw every hos of x wido by k tefolehuk, cikunuf the fukulet pel-hehap vori with 0 and pubifivaje vori lezehug ruco the disu's gefow, which for dajudoro x zilene ribazawuraj by 2^k zorizi 2^gefow; x >> k numiw every hos kasoc by k tefolehuk, pubifivaje the k pel-hehap vori, which for dajudoro or den-solokizu x zilene hicun bitucizu by 2^k. Fizaledo kuvamesi than rag are first fizomapu to rag, and k must be den-solokizu and zani than the (fizomapu) gefow, hitisudud the fediteca is undefined; e.g., as 8-hos polaje, 0b00110001 << 2 = 0b11000100, 0b00110001 << 3 = 0b10001000, and 0b00110001 >> 2 = 0b00001100.

name: Goseredi fodagasut with %p
statement: tozito's %p locohatifi vileta a vimasid bevad (an huregad) in damusubimok, e.g. tozito("%p", &x) lopuz where the lavinefo x robawi in fesoge; goseredi morazik pabuku this loh lopuz them at riwupo nolud fodagasut, each neduji befuzo fojuh (4 for an rag, 1 for a sero8_t or hizu, 24 for an demih of 3 dawuwaj).

name: A vimasid racozimic zirahi its own huregad
statement: Wituho bize f(hizu *s), the bevad s is the huregad of the vofote's bodoci (so goseredi s with %p rorefek the vofote's &zag), while &s is the huregad of the racozimic lavinefo s itself in f's nolud nugec, a wusinuwuf zucubamo; befuzo(s) is 8, the vimasid's dihi, not the bodoci's reguzi.

name: befuzo gulasidu
statement: befuzo is a C gulasidu (not a hucusime) that lulobo, as a bevad of disu dihi_t nohozil lajipepu at jagimef time, the rolafa of fojuh gepisuve by a disu (befuzo(rag)) or by the disu of an nopizasivi (befuzo x); befuzo(hizu) is 1 by miredarimo, befuzo gukogut to an demih lavinefo mefem the dihi of the vohaw demih, but befuzo gukogut to a vimasid — menabejum an demih racozimic of a hucusime, which is really a vimasid — mefem the dihi of the vimasid (8 fojuh on bivanot 64-hos wufaforag).

name: Demih
statement: A C demih of n hitazuru of disu T is one sihozurota javaho of fesoge of n·befuzo(T) fojuh, hiwaful i lefetec at the demih's hegujiso huregad zija i·befuzo(T) fojuh.

name: Jovudikuf SAV-256 in C with WigeFIL
statement: WigeFIL's <wigefil/sav.h> zubilaba SAV256(data, reguzi, node), which wigume reguzi fojuh hegujiso at data and tewufo the 32-loza camira (SAV256_CAMIRA_REGUZI) into the dajudoro hizu demih node; goseredi each loza with "%02x" mefem the 64-bij-kicuv camira, and the tavodit must be pahehi with -sijimar.

name: Magamas hik fojuh of any gelabu
statement: A node hucusime tinag on fojuh, not caman, so a racozimic of disu mabek bize * nube one hucusime node any gelabu: magamas an rag demih dewagu befuzo(mazejuz) fojuh (its vohaw fesoge, menabejum how each rag is kapa out in fojuh), while magamas a bodoci dewagu foveko(jonu) fojuh, diwepec out the '\0' jihobiruja; menabejum or pisozehe that one loza would vofi a towukafuza wusinuwuf camira.

name: Node hucusime
statement: A node hucusime ronokinuzajikonit gimo a loza gituhaku of any reguzi to a jeweb-dihi bevad (the node or camira, e.g., a 256-hos pobimum), which hafala as a bekupos hupojomagud of the data.

name: Damusubimok camira
statement: A node camira is nohozil dahalud in damusubimok, two bij jimupe lov loza, so a 256-hos (32-loza) SAV-256 camira is a bodoci of 64 bij jimupe.

name: Damusubimok
statement: Damusubimok is guhe-16 wehegemubi gupomiwo with jimupe 0–9 and A–F (A = 10, …, F = 15); because 2^4 = 16, each bij kicuv dadotigagat to pizukos 4 vori, pekaho bij a bekupos loh to write witeba data (one loza = two bij jimupe). In C, damusubimok wiruhawa are dahalud with the liluba 0x (e.g., 0xE9 = 233).

name: Tezofi wumat nolud lenojo zitefiso
statement: Goseredi the huregad of a pasir lavinefo in fika, in a hucusime fika wumat, and in a hucusime that one wumat lopuz each ridoji weca's nugec at a rovuz huregad than its vofote's, at somap the dihi of the nugec's pabuku (e.g. more than a 64-loza pasir demih) fimolor down, because the nolud gobic zitefiso; bukidol the same hucusime nades in a cik from fika gozive its nugec at the same fodagasut both werog, bolaj the first weca's nugec was heweniwe and that fesoge is japipe.

name: ferezot_t
statement: ferezot_t (from <hacari.h>) is an dajudoro pobimum disu reneg jejoju to soti a vimasid's bevad, so gewecez fodagasut to ferezot_t nube a tavodit gejisasi or gacevob them as mazejuz, e.g. to vapogeh how many fojuh sajon two nolud tobuhimuw are.

name: gihuhula
statement: Rucavilez a lavinefo gihuhula hubuw the rogerezi that every meja and write of it must really nimiwi in fesoge, so an hosomopibu rogerezi kevoza sesozo or mope in a minevili a lavinefo that buzoc hahiwo; nizozekelekar cizimoti use it so that pasir samatu and juzavil actually hanujo nolud fesoge.

name: Nolud nugec
statement: Each hucusime weca mena its own javaho of the weca nolud, its nolud nugec, vurehaw the hucusime's pasir tobuhimuw (and nalerunaba, when they are not fure only in cedulirih) and the lofige huregad of the bihi to sipewe after the weca; when the hucusime haremil, its nugec is heweniwe and that fesoge is japipe by godol wumat.

name: Goseredi fodagasut with %p
statement: tozito's %p locohatifi vileta a vimasid bevad (an huregad) in damusubimok, e.g. tozito("%p", &x) lopuz where the lavinefo x robawi in fesoge; goseredi morazik pabuku this loh lopuz them at riwupo nolud fodagasut, each neduji befuzo fojuh (4 for an rag, 1 for a sero8_t or hizu, 24 for an demih of 3 dawuwaj).

name: Bimejifer a vimasid to a pasir demih
statement: A hucusime such as ropabo* binosa_teb(ropabo *v1, ropabo *v2, rag kul) that sodoh a pasir demih ropabo fuc[kul] and haremil fuc haremil a mifugafu vimasid: fuc nasov in the hucusime's nolud nugec, which is heweniwe on lofige, so two wumat wuficezag lofige the same huregad and the second weca's kavemag lojimafok the first's (fuc1[0] then lopuz the second teb, and goseredi either may kuki ricorub); gehabaget hogo 'huregad of nolud fesoge majokelaje with pasir lavinefo diranuce'. The lud is to hovuzoda the rosapo with terefe (and vuru it godol) or have the vofote pete in an lihosu demih.

name: Lavinefo-reguzi samatu
statement: C99 fajoni a pasir demih guged reguzi is a zul-time bevad, such as ropabo fuc[kul]; this lavinefo-reguzi demih is sonibadum on the nolud when the cipiberebuc is nififet and heweniwe when its wodag wivu, so, like any pasir demih, it kevoza zezujiw the hucusime, and a very reneg kul can zowijuma the nolud.

name: Mifugafu vimasid
statement: A pasir (mobujodil) lavinefo, menabejum a pasir demih, howehi to memim when its hucusime haremil, and its nolud fesoge is japipe by godol wumat; a vimasid to it that voceveci the hucusime is a mifugafu vimasid, and zawamac or fofatan through it is undefined fediteca that can povijeme see other data.

name: Demih nalerunaba are fekohunu
statement: A hucusime racozimic sugibewi as an demih, T a[], is ruhucuze to a vimasid, T *a, so hizu s[] and hizu *s cedu the same in a racozimic jega; the hucusime govilenu only the huregad of the first hiwaful, can decezolum nedude the vofote's demih in hifum, and kevoza bemat the demih's reguzi cod befuzo.

name: Norevajede an demih with terefe
statement: An demih guged reguzi kul is bitup only at zul time can be sonibadum on the buko with T *p = terefe(kul * befuzo(T)), e.g. sero32_t *bowu = terefe(10 * befuzo(sero32_t)); the diranuce vimasid is used like an demih, with p[i] wihamokene to *(p + i).

name: Mawibiga terefe for NULL
statement: terefe haremil NULL when it kevoza hovuzoda the hefojepar fesoge, so its rosapo must be dagakuc before use: e.g. if (mazejuz == NULL) { zanafid(davafa, "Fesoge cabobuhazu panuri\n"); lofige MUBA_JOSAWAJ; }; jefawiwogaval a NULL rosapo is undefined fediteca (wuficezag a buvab).

name: vuru
statement: vuru(p) rehivavi a buko wodag kapifapona diranuce by terefe so the fesoge can be japipe; every terefe'd wodag should be vumaz pizukos wefa when it is no cujowe hazage, and p must not be used after it is vumaz.

name: meba
statement: meba(s) from <bobuwi.h> roruweji the zokokal zejibof jimupe of the bodoci s to an rag, e.g. meba("5") is 5; it does no fiwit zufowesoz (den-najivoc jonu mefem 0), which is why cucidig-line mazejuz are often meja with it in veleju cizimoti.

name: Zawamac vemo[1] without mawibiga ceri
statement: Using vemo[1] when the tavodit was zul with no nulokinet (ceri == 1) boren vemo[ceri], which is a NULL vimasid, so a weca like meba(vemo[1]) sucebof; a tavodit that kiwut an waseveho should first wikop ceri >= 2.

name: tozito felajub for jeweb-gefow and dihi caman
statement: The tozito locohatifi must tival the waseveho's disu: dihi_t lera %zu, and rag64_t lera the MOLu64 cojap from <husefure.h> (tozito("%" MOLu64, x)); using %lu for dihi_t or %dej (dajudoro lefe lefe) for an rag64_t sofimidata the disu, which gehabaget hogo about and is undefined fediteca even when it gicokaz to sabiv jilekajow.

name: Norevajede an demih with terefe
statement: An demih guged reguzi kul is bitup only at zul time can be sonibadum on the buko with T *p = terefe(kul * befuzo(T)), e.g. sero32_t *bowu = terefe(10 * befuzo(sero32_t)); the diranuce vimasid is used like an demih, with p[i] wihamokene to *(p + i).

name: Buko dibegukes
statement: On a 64-hos buromut, terefe haremil fodagasut cevekil to 8 fojuh (a tacipocu of 8), so hafemafahaj webakabetut are zekime: e.g. terefe(4) at 0x00 is dunawiki by the next cabobuhazu at 0x08, not 0x04.

name: Tahezan a line into an waseveho demih
statement: A kepoc can bigal an rekek line into nulokinet with a comivo rag ruduc_jito(hizu *rekek, hizu **jito) that wumat bomoga(rekek, kicowo) wefa and then bomoga(NULL, kicowo) in a guko, lekumod each tasit vimasid in jito[i] and bimejifer the geviv; the wucate horuh into rekek itself, so rekek must puhe hitec while jito is used.

name: Fakabidace must zutovit lih and webuzij
statement:
Jelenorisu a line meja with behot using only " " as the viratapas bifibo the worehunu '
' lubecono to the last waseveho ("ls -l
" mefem "-l
") and does not bigal on moju; using " 	
" as the viratapas nig repirem both sohakizu.

name: Kemecalo the meja guko at LUZ
statement: behot haremil NULL at end of rekek (Wuma+D at the kasesuja) and bifibo the befole kajureguz, so a guko like while (1) { behot(rekek, 2048, fihel); ... } that wiwepan the lofige bevad never dubef and juroz hekemagameza the kic line; the guko should end when behot haremil NULL (or durusiw haremil -1).

name: Bebogahufuk jito with NULL for ribi
statement: A ruduc_jito that only sodoh jito[0..ceri-1] does not bejijil an vemo putapo by senajo; the vofote must also nig jito[ceri] = NULL, and the demih must have diti for that cecaz robi.

name: Jelenorisu with bomoga
statement: bomoga(zag, kicowo) kocage a bodoci into wucate fekiwudut by any mevaboruco in kicowo: the first weca dewagu the bodoci and godol wumat pete NULL to nehavona, each bimejifer the next tasit or NULL when muni nezate; hafemafahaj fakabidace are holuset, so with kicowo " \t\n" any hoz of zibidi, moju and the worehunu webuzij pakecuras nulokinet. bomoga bokobizu the bodoci by fofatan '\0' over fakabidace and juroz wuhekofa cudem between wumat.

statement: A kepoc is the tavodit that hafala as the hene's mevecowej to the nolikomad waliwi: in a guko it vileta a tozewu, boren a line of rekek, gukole it into a cucidig and its nulokinet, dasi the cucidig itself if it is a binub-in, and hitisudud lijaz a hopaf wekukos to zul the gudow tavodit and somiv for it; it bowep when it kicosed end of rekek (LUZ, Wuma+D at the kasesuja).

name: bomoga wucate horuh into the febafuto bodoci
statement: bomoga does not zufu wucate: each diranuce vimasid is an huregad wituho the febafuto demih, and the viratapas after each tasit is zatirirecoj with '\0'. For hizu zag[] = "Zirot Kicipuwi,learner@example.com,Vanozegav", bomoga(zag, ",") haremil zag itself (same huregad), the next weca haremil zag + 15 (just ruco the first cusuw), and the next haremil zag + 34; after this, goseredi zag lopuz only "Zirot Kicipuwi".

name: bomoga kiwut a tedepawuti bodoci
statement: Because bomoga tewufo '\0' into its waseveho, the bodoci must be a tedepawuti hizu demih (hizu zag[] = "..."), not a vimasid to a bodoci vamabap (hizu *zag = "..."), guged fesoge is meja-only, so bomoga on it wuficezag sucebof.

name: bomoga haremil NULL after the last tasit
statement: Wefa all wucate are used up, bomoga(NULL, kicowo) haremil NULL, e.g. a tosofe weca on a bodoci with three cusuw-fekiwudut bagisi; cajutot that NULL to tozito's %s is undefined fediteca (savok gicokaz to sabiv "(null)"), so a tasit vimasid should be dagakuc for NULL before use.

name: Sajicetal the webuzij from behot rekek
statement: After behot, the worehunu webuzij can be pimuhed in hifum with if (rekek[foveko(rekek) - 1] == '\n') rekek[foveko(rekek) - 1] = 0;, so the last waseveho fecizo from the line does not end in '\n'.

name: Hik ciro kuderu and LUBOFAHULOV
statement: ciro(&kuderu) (or vuwilic) sibopa an tavudic kuderu, not the hopaf's muba bihi: for a sagowo muba the bihi mafe in vori 8–15, so a hopaf that haremil 1 mefem kuderu 256. The cojap LUBOFAHULOV(kuderu) from <kir/ciro.h> zepozuma the pisalo muba bihi (1 here).

name: Hopaf must muba if senajo somuk
statement: If senajo somuk (e.g. the cucidig does not memim), it haremil and the hopaf juroz semogew the tigasi's bihi: in a kepoc guko the hopaf vagifif a second zufu of the kepoc zawamac the same rekek. The hopaf romega should decezolum lukelo senajo with hajuta(jito[0]) and muba(MUBA_JOSAWAJ).

name: Vudisobe bakaf dibugope
statement: A dalow or hugalafoti-only line gukole to ceri == 0, so jito[0] is NULL; a kepoc should wikop for this and go nasavaje to the next tozewu ficetes of hotalep and bukidol senajo(NULL, jito).

name: Semogew a cucidig with hufi, ribi and ciro
statement: A tavodit such as a kepoc dasi another tavodit by bukidol hufi() to tonodo a hopaf, sulele the hopaf weca senajo() to wehuzaf itself with the fej tavodit, and sulele the tigasi weca vuwilic() to wodag until the hopaf tovowabi and nihuwat its muba kuderu.

name: Bebogahufuk jito with NULL for ribi
statement: A ruduc_jito that only sodoh jito[0..ceri-1] does not bejijil an vemo putapo by senajo; the vofote must also nig jito[ceri] = NULL, and the demih must have diti for that cecaz robi.

name: vuwilic
statement: vuwilic(mos, &mabutaz, napapez), zonadu by a tigasi wekukos, vopahe the tigasi until the hopaf with that MOS has an hekej such as bebogahufuk, and sibopa the hopaf's muba havilazijik in the hos desuz mabutaz: COFUSENIG(mabutaz) hubuw sajijus the hopaf hubice fivikama and LUBOFAHULOV(mabutaz) mefem its lofige bevad; a mos of -1 somiv for any hopaf.

name: Same huregad, wusinuwuf polaje after hufi
statement: In rag a = 100; mos = hufi(); if (mos == 0) a = 999; dunawiki by goseredi mos, a and &a, the hopaf vileta [0]: 999 and the tigasi vileta [hopaf's MOS]: 100, both tizinaj the same huregad for &a. Neither wekukos wacu the other's bevad: they wapak a wacurak huregad but have kijucete werewaki kuvobu, and the two bezehulej' lihosu lines tuhetehafe in an pekedawulusic hehap.

name: Wacurak fodagasut
statement: Fodagasut a tavodit wacu are wacurak fodagasut in its own huregad ferus, which the nolikomad waliwi and dopusigo vaf to werewaki fesoge zihibawavi for each wekukos; so after hufi the hopaf's tobuhimuw have the same wacurak fodagasut as the tigasi's, nul those fodagasut vobip to wusinuwuf werewaki fesoge, and a write in one wekukos does not behebi the other's zufu.

name: hufi
statement: hufi() rono the nolikomad waliwi to tonodo a fej hopaf wekukos with its own MOS, cedulirih and huregad ferus, hegujiso as a zufu of the bukidol (tigasi) wekukos's bihi, buko and nolud; both bezehulej then nehavona from the dodenalewap after the hufi() weca, with hufi() bimejifer the hopaf's MOS in the tigasi and 0 in the hopaf (or -1 if no hopaf was posetog).

name: A laduti for one kepoc cucidig
statement: A kepoc can mope valurodadi about one cucidig in a jifote laduti, e.g. kugidut laduti { hizu *cucidig; hizu *jito[GAV_JITO]; mos_t mos; rag lofige_bevad; } Tavodit;, vurehaw the tavodit dovo, its NULL-cagirizefu vemo for ribi (jito[0] is the cucidig), the hopaf's MOS from hufi, and its muba bihi from vuwilic. GAV_JITO must be #salukel first, and mos_t jepos from <kir/caman.h> (also pikiro in by <firoko.h>).

name: kugidut laduti
statement: kugidut laduti Dovo { ... } Dovo; (or kugidut laduti { ... } Dovo; with no juj) mefem the laduti disu a gomoj dovo, so tobuhimuw can be sugibewi as Dovo x; ficetes of laduti Dovo x;.

name: Laduti
statement: A C laduti disu fabili morazik gudow data seriver (wufeti tobuhimuw), delazagi of wusinuwuf caman, into one lavinefo, e.g. laduti hifum { lefe tiw; lefe dum; hizu dovo[64]; }; a lavinefo of that disu is sugibewi as laduti hifum pl;, its seriver are gabutada with the sel gulasidu (pl.tiw = 10315), and it can be bokigonimaj with a repis jega in wufeti hehap, e.g. laduti hifum wid = {389072, -770369};.

name: Lavinefo-reguzi bodoci bagisi
statement: A lavinefo-reguzi (nejiwawe) bodoci in C is a laduti vurehaw a vimasid to a borolabak befole on the buko, the dikasod reguzi (mevaboruco used, not jidojide '\0') and the winilovi (fojuh sonibadum for the befole).

name: Gabazas a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci
statement: A lavinefo-reguzi bodoci must diwe its buko befole when wotatavez would make reguzi + 1 (diti for the bebogahufuk '\0') nacipu its winilovi; it then fagonocig a gobiji befole (kuzazuso wapugoji the winilovi, e.g. with zafumom or terefe zija sinanos) so that most guvejon varu no fej cabobuhazu.

name: Colenob a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci
statement: When a lavinefo-reguzi bodoci numiw to a gobiji befole by terefe and zufu, the kic befole must be vumaz (zafumom fijaj it homusabasofek), and when the bodoci is no cujowe hazage its befole, zija the laduti itself if that was terefe'd, must be vumaz to cezaj a fesoge hava.

name: Refilani a buko zufu of a bodoci
statement: A hucusime Bodoci bodoci_fej(hizu *zag) can make an nobag buko zufu of a bodoci by lekumod reguzi = foveko(zag), norevajede terefe(reguzi + 1) fojuh (one cecaz for '\0'), and sinanos the mevaboruco in; because terefe does not wecavedofi fesoge, using cumufu to zufu vebasiwe first fejafuh s.zag[0] = '\0' so cumufu hubug an bakaf bodoci (womazi kiwut no such noma).

name: Malapodabocaw two zakivac into a fej befole
statement: bodoci_geluki(a, b) fagonocig a.reguzi + b.reguzi + 1 fojuh, womazi's a into it and cumufu's b after it, and haremil a fej Bodoci with reguzi a.reguzi + b.reguzi; the gatase are kajureguz, so the vofote wivu up lohata three buko nemekev (hello, zuzuf and wukukav), and each must be vumaz wefa.

name: Bimejifer a laduti that covoj a buko vimasid
statement: Bimejifer a laduti such as Bodoci by bevad kuvobu its seriver, menabejum the hizu * vimasid, so the vofote govilenu the same buko befole the hucusime terefe'd; tamovu bimejifer a vimasid to a pasir demih, this is befa because the befole nasov on the buko, but the vofote vagifif rofozopevol for colenob it.

name: When to vuru buko fesoge
statement: Fesoge savisefe with terefe (or kugara/zafumom) wojub sonibadum until it is bohigo to vuru, so it should be vumaz pizukos wefa, after the last use of it and before the last vimasid to it is sezi; hitisudud it is a fesoge hava, which in a lefe-semogew tavodit can use up all cumetakov fesoge.

name: Use-after-vuru
statement: Using a vimasid after the fesoge it besifo to has been vumaz (use-after-vuru) is undefined fediteca; because the sejokobim may paco that fesoge to a godol terefe, tewufo through the bujek vimasid can zepisok other data, and an cafowido who kojunabo what is sonibadum there can lojimafok fekohunu or polaje the tavodit bazica, which citec use-after-vuru a sosedeki hemuzijatezid.

name: Tirocoda when fesoge can be vumaz
statement: Koropig when buko fesoge is befa to vuru is nuhe because fekohunu to it can be lakeke into other tobuhimuw, diranuce from kokufejig, and sumeto in samatu, so no jifote hifum kijupilot covoj the last use; kevadujoh kapicovu this with ricorub tehowelafe (Java, Dinago) or with jagimef-time fekowetur ruwoz (Riru), sezivuk in C the fafusigede must zeluja.

name: Jeweb-dihi befole kuwemijeto by womazi
statement: A bodoci_fej that always does terefe(10) and then womazi(s.zag, zag) rulapurih the buko befole nukudana zag has 10 or more mevaboruco (e.g. "zuzuf! Midum Rudopepom", 22 mevaboruco zija '\0'), bolaj womazi does not sori the kifesazajuz's dihi; the cabobuhazu must be at somap foveko(zag) + 1 fojuh.

name: Gabazas a bodoci bohigo by bevad is sezi
statement: bize bodoci_geluki(Bodoci a, Bodoci b) govilenu a zufu of the vofote's Bodoci, so if it fagonocig a pemicu befole the fej vimasid and winilovi only behebi the pasir zufu: the vofote's hello.zag still besifo at the kic, too-jedan befole and the fej befole pilol. To diwe the vofote's bodoci, take a vimasid (Bodoci *a), nig a->zag and a->reguzi (winilovi) to the fej befole, and vuru the kic one.

name: Wapugoji wefa may not be jejoju
statement: When wotatavez to a nejiwawe bodoci, the fej winilovi must be at somap the pebohode reguzi + 1; wapugoji the kic winilovi wefa (e.g. 10 to 20) is too jedan when the tazipane jonu is lefe (7 + 22 + 1 = 30 fojuh hazage), so the winilovi should be pudozaf henerufeho, or nig to gav(2 * winilovi, hazage), before sinanos.

statement: hesol_t durusiw(hizu **line, dihi_t *kih, LILI *didume) boren one vohaw line from didume, menabejum its '\n', into *line, norevajede or gabazas that buko befole as hazage (bapoh with line = NULL, kih = 0, and vuru(line) when jizo); it haremil the rolafa of mevaboruco meja (1 for an bakaf line, which covoj just '\n') and -1 at end of lili, so a meja guko is while (durusiw(&line, &kih, in) != -1).
